short_description: The world as we knew it has been destroyed by the apocalypse... But the railroads have survived the war. And now you need to survive the post-apocalyptic era with their help.

name: Signal Decay
short_description: Assemble a cyber agent team to infiltrate procedurally-generated bases in this co-op stealth roguelike adventure. Master highly tactical combat, a cache of cyber weaponry, and teamwork to save humanity from mind-control.

name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms
short_description: Embark on a perilous journey across a realm forsaken by the gods and devastated by an arcane cataclysm. Accompanied by a hardy crew, you must trade, fight, and explore your way to success as the leader of a traveling company in Vagrus, an award-winning turn-based post-apocalyptic fantasy RPG.

name: Causal Nexus
short_description: Create your abilities, destroy your opponents, go as far as you can in this roguelite arcade shooter. Full solo experience with our regular challenges or show them who's the best with the special leaderboard challenges. Do your worst, embrace the infinity.

name: SUPER BOMBERMAN R 2
short_description: The latest title of the party battle games series SUPER BOMBERMAN R! With new adventures and game modes, it has the largest content volume in the series' history!

name: Six Temples
short_description: Carve through creatures of shadow, summon wicked spells, and reclaim relics in the Age of Apocalypse. Eternal glory is yours for the taking!

name: Grisaia Chronos Rebellion
short_description: The newest installment in the Grisaia visual novel series. All of the girls from Mihama, past and present, must face off against a new evil terrorist organization in an all-out war.

name: FINAL FANTASY XIV Online
short_description: Join over 30 million adventurers worldwide and take part in an epic and ever-changing FINAL FANTASY. Experience an unforgettable story, exhilarating battles, and a myriad of captivating environments to explore.

name: ONINAKI
short_description: The all-new Action-RPG, ONINAKI tells the story of one Watcher on a journey to protect Life, after Death.

name: Naval Action
short_description: Or were you deaf or were you blind when you left your two fine legs behind, Or was it sailing on the sea when you got the cannonball to your knee, I too was young and I was slim and I had a leg for every limb, But now I’ve got no legs at all, they were both shot away by a cannonball.

name: My Village Life
short_description: My Village Life is an open world village simulator vehicle driving game.

name: Australian Football Coach 2023-24
short_description: Coach your way to the premiership flag! Australian Football Coach 2023 comes packed with new features including local multiplayer and a database update.

name: Go Home Annie: An SCP Game
short_description: A twisted psychological thriller and an original story set in the SCP universe. As an employee of the SCP Foundation, test artificially created paranormal events, solve puzzles, interact with anomalies, and uncover the secrets of the Replication Division.

name: Meg's Monster
short_description: Take control of the Underworld’s grumpiest ghoul to help a lost little girl find her way home in this creepy-cute indie adventure. Just be warned: if she cries, the whole world dies.

name: Earthworm Jim
short_description: Jim wasn't always a studly super-worm. He was once just a spineless, dirt-eater with no real mission in his life... But then something unexpected happened. The evil Psy-Crow was transporting a super suit, built by the genius Professor Monkey-For-A-Head, to Queen Pulsating, Bloated, Festering, Sweaty, Pus-Filled, Malformed,...

name: Towers of Aghasba
short_description: Explore a stunning open-world filled with majestic creatures and quirky characters. Nurture the barren land into vibrant ecosystems and flex your creativity as you build a thriving civilization in balance with nature.

name: Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon
short_description: Delve with Shovel Knight into the depths of the Pocket Dungeon in an action-packed puzzle adventure mashup like none other!

name: Doors of Silence - the prologue
short_description: Built exclusively for VR. Explore a disturbing reality as you try to survive the dark presences. With few resources and weapons available you’ll have to fight for your survival in a mix of horror and action. Face deformed creatures and live into the nightmare where danger is waiting around every corner.

name: Magic Farm 3: The Ice Danger
short_description: 'Magic Farm 3: The Ice Danger' is a farming simulator game, with a simple-RPG system and quests. This is a continuation of the Magic Farm series for PC and Mac. You'll play as an Iris, a girl with an ability to grow magical plants who need to take care of her new farms.

name: Swordsman
short_description: This is a casual game with action gameplay designed to be highly consistent with the name

name: Hollywood Animal
short_description: Make movies, even if someone has to die. Take the helm of a major Hollywood studio at the dawn of sound cinema, and guide it through decades of creative achievements and glamor, debauchery and dark deeds, tough choices and unpleasant compromises.

name: Ares Virus2
short_description: The 'Ares Virus' series of games is widely acclaimed for its unique combat and individual style of painting. Now that the sequel is back, it will give you an unprecedented experience.

name: Gilded Shadows
short_description: A GxB visual novel that explores a whimsical, yet dangerous world which blends the solarpunk and cyberpunk aesthetics into a unique adventure. As you follow the MC on her journey, pursue various love interests in a stand-alone story unique to that route.

name: Sonic Frontiers
short_description: Experience Sonic like never before!

name: Triptych Book I: Blockhead
short_description: Triptych Book I: Blockhead is a graphical adventure set in an alternate version of World War One with simple point and click interface, easy to use controls & rip-roaring adventure in the skies!

name: Rift of the NecroDancer
short_description: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

name: Disc Golf Valley VR
short_description: Disc Golf Valley is home to some of the most beautiful and challenging disc golf courses in the world. Now you can experience them in spectacular VR! Fill up your disc bag, sign up for tournaments and challenge every course in the Valley.

name: Amber
short_description: Join Amber on a whimsical journey through the 5 kingdoms: Candy, Cake, Story, Rainbow, and Crystal. Spread love, restore balance with Amber Crystals, confront rulers, and set things right using the Mallet, Chocolate Staff, and Bubblegum Wand. Glide with the Rainbow Umbrella!

name: CRYMACHINA
short_description: CRYMACHINA is an action RPG where mechanical girls strive to survive in a post-apocalyptic world to become “Real Humans''. But what does it mean to be a “Real Human”?

name: Apostle: Rebellion
short_description: A sci-fi, turn-based RPG. Humanity has reached a point where the majority of people opt to become cyborgs called Roids. However, social inequality is once again at a breaking point.

name: Fortress Challenge : Fort Boyard
short_description: Return to Fort Boyard and take on the new challenges of Sir Fouras!

name: Gunner, HEAT, PC!
short_description: Gunner, HEAT, PC! (GHPC) is a simulation game about modern mounted combat, with special attention to authenticity and fun.

name: REQUISITION VR
short_description: REQUISITION VR is a first physics-based co-op game where you can use duct tape to link any objects together to create a unique weapon. You can experiment with crafting, connecting any unthinkable combinations: a katana + a circular saw, or an axe + a ball. Inspired by Dead Rising & Walking Dead: S&S

name: SparkChess
short_description: A game of chess everyone can enjoy!

name: Car Dealer Simulator
short_description: Uncover a goldmine in the used car market! Sniff out deals, buy low, modify, and sell high. Your journey from amateur grease monkey to car dealer magnate awaits. How fast will you rise in this lucrative venture?

name: BONELAB
short_description: BONELAB is an experimental physics action game. Explore a mysterious lab filled with weapons, enemies, challenges and secrets. Escape your reality, or wreak havoc. No wrong answers.

name: Mechanism
short_description: Mechanism - - an adventure game about a lonely robot. Dive into a depressive steampunk world which has been infected with a strange disease called 'Phlegm'.

name: Almost Alive
short_description: Almost Alive is redefining the role playing tactical games with an awesome fast paced but complexe real time combat system in a mad hand drawn post apocalyptic world that features character mental sanity, destructible environment, a cover system, tons of loot, a none linear story, and a lot of humor.

name: Anima: Gate of Memories - The Nameless Chronicles
short_description: Anima The Nameless Chronicles is a third person action RPG that tells the story of a man without name, an immortal being cursed to walk the world until the end of time. When a shadow of his past rises again in his path, he will be forced to take part in a conflict in which the very existence is in question. But...

name: Berries Challenge
short_description: Berries Challenge is a berries hunter simulator. Here you can walk around the forest and enjoy the nature, meet different animals and, of course, gather berries.

name: Pluto Lost Its Colors
short_description: Join Pluto in its quest to reclaim its colors in this chaotic yet rewarding experience! Pluto Lost Its Colors is a fast paced platformer with physics based controls. Master the unpredictable physics of Pluto as you roll, jump, and dash through challenges. This game is your next addiction.

name: GHOUL
short_description: What would you say regarding what you have been through; happenstance, or result of your actions ? We can not expect good things to happen to a thief who works with contracts, but this time what she will experience is even different from what you imagine.

name: Caesar's Revenge
short_description: Caesar’s Revenge is a die-and-retry retro FPS set in classical antiquity. Bring retribution to the greedy senator’s that betrayed you. Become the fall of Rome.

name: Otome Riron to Sono Shuuhen -École de Paris-
short_description: 《少女理论及其周边 -École de Paris-》是日本美少女游戏资深大厂Navel制作的超人气女装作品《近月少女的礼仪》的续作。讲述了前作主人公大藏游星为了陪同自己的妹妹里想奈前往巴黎留学而再次扮演小仓朝日成为女仆所展开的全新故事。本作曾在美少女游戏大赏荣获综合第3，剧本第1，作画第5等诸多奖项。

name: Isles of Etherion
short_description: A third-person open-world Voxel ARPG with Physics-based Magic and 100% dynamically destructible fantasy world, featuring Airships, Floating Islands, Dungeons, Voxel Combat and Spell Weaving. Created by a solo developer living the dream of making the game he wants to play.

name: Zombie Watch
short_description: Top-down open world single player / survival / RPG game with zombies and wildlife.

name: Saltsea Chronicles
short_description: It begins with a kidnapped captain and a stolen ship. Where it leads next? That’s up to you… In this story-driven adventure game you will explore strange and wonderful communities, uncover a deep conspiracy, and chart a journey through twists and turns, difficulties and delights.

name: Wands
short_description: WANDS® is a first-person VR experience that offers fast-paced magic duels against other players online.

name: Astronomics
short_description: Top-down action and space exploration meet asteroid mining automation! Navigate to randomly generated asteroids passing by and start mining. Impress your employer, upgrade your equipment, fight off pirates and save up for that ticket to Earth so you can finally come home... for the very first time.

name: Operation Armstrong
short_description: Your infiltration team must stop an army of lunar-bots from crashing the moon into our Earth! The field operative, wielding the VR headset, must sneak through each enemy outpost while their team of hackers will assist using their smartphones! Strap in for some Asymmetric-VR-Stealth-Party gameplay!

name: Steel Crew
short_description: Join a Tank as a Driver, Gunner or Commander and team up with and against other Tanks in Tank Vs Tank combat where tactics and communication is key

name: Alongside
short_description: Tower defense strategy in a hand-drawn atmospheric style. The action of which takes place in a fairy-tale world inhabited by animals. To survive, you will need to tactically consider the placement of units, control the hero, using his abilities to fight off the invading hordes of evil.

name: QualityScaler
short_description: Welcome to QualityScaler, your ultimate solution for enhancing, denoising, and upscaling images and videos using the power of AI (similar to Nvidia DLSS, for images and videos)

name: Jin Conception
short_description: Jin Conception is a social deduction fantasy thriller turn based souls-like JRPG. Go on an adventure not knowing which party member is friend or foe. Solve clues to progress the story.

name: Pure Football 2018
short_description: Pure Football 2018 is an American Football Simulator where you play GM, Coach, and Player. Play through endless seasons as you master player contracts, assembling your coaching staff, free agency, and the draft. Lead your players come game time or use the advanced game simulation system.

name: Z.O.N.A: Origin
short_description: Z.O.N.A: Origin is an immersive adventure in a harsh post-apocalyptic world. Dive into a captivating story, explore a stunning open world, avoid dangerous anomalies, and hunt for powerful artifacts. Every choice you make can be decisive in this unpredictable world.

name: sCATter
short_description: sCATter is the world's first VR shooting rhythm game with a new feel. Test your rhythm with music and compare rankings with people all over the world. Easy difficulty levels that anyone can enter, to Extra difficulty levels for rhythm game masters!

name: The Good Life
short_description: Enjoy everyday life while solving a murder mystery in Rainy Woods - known as the 'happiest town in the world' - in this all-new 'Debt Repayment RPG'!

name: Phantom Brigade
short_description: Phantom Brigade 2.0 is a cinematic, tactical mech strategy game with a revolutionary timeline-based command system. See the future, predict enemy actions, and plot your counterattack on the timeline! Recruit and level up your squad of rebels to retake war-torn Fyrland from the Kaskad occupation.

name: Cartomancy Anthology
short_description: Dive into the world of divination with the Cartomancy Anthology, a collection of introspective and compact digital experiences presented together in a virtual tarot deck.

name: Steel Armor: Blaze of War
short_description: Steel Armor: Blaze of War is realistic tank simulator with tactical elements. The game models Soviet T-62 tank and US M60A1 tank in detail. Each tank has interactive cockpit with crew. Player controls a tank, and commands a tank platoon and attached forces in 4 large scale dynamic campaigns.

name: Heart's Medicine - Doctor's Oath
short_description: Become a doctor in a romantic medical drama with aspiring intern Allison Heart!

name: SAMURAI MAIDEN
short_description: A young woman from the 21st century with sharp swordsmanship skills finds herself in Honnō-ji during the Sengoku period! Together with a trio of newfound ninja friends, she races through the Underworld beneath Honnō-ji, confronted by enraged corpses at every turn!

name: Legioncraft
short_description: Loslan needs you! The Legion is waiting for your call! Gather your strength, prepare your food, contribute your love, and pull out your gold coin!

name: Dimension of Dreams
short_description: 'Dimension of Dreams' is a unique strategy card game with rogue-like elements. You play an adventurer who embarks on an exhilarating journey through the dream world, where you engage in thrilling, fluid combat. Obtain and add cards strategically to your deck via exploration and upgrading existing cards.

name: Crisis on the Planet of the Apes
short_description: 5 years since its outbreak, the Simian Flu has wiped out half of humanity. You are an ape with advanced intelligence, captured and held prisoner in a remote scientific facility. Climb, jump and shoot through the chaos of an apocalyptical world to escape with your fellow apes and return home.

name: Ashes Cricket
short_description: Ashes Cricket is the officially licensed video game of cricket’s greatest rivalry. Bringing all the fast paced action, big hits and skill that you see in the greatest cricket competition on earth, you’ll be able to play in the men’s and women’s 2017/2018 Ashes tours.

name: Super Rude Bear Resurrection
short_description: Super Rude Bear Resurrection is an ultra-tight, masocore platformer that anyone can beat! Use your corpses to get ahead, or take on the ultimate challenge and try to defeat the entire game without dying!

name: Movavi Video Editor 2025
short_description: Your simple yet powerful editor for creating wow videos - Fast and easy editing: cut, crop, adjust colors and speed - One-click AI tools: auto subtitles, noise removal, and more - Hundreds of filters, transitions, titles, overlays

name: Mall Craze
short_description: Build, Customize & Manage your own shopping center! Choose from modern gaming hardware store to cozy flower shop. Hire skilled cashiers, secure financing through bank loans, and launch strategic advertising campaigns to make your mall thrive!

name: Canvas of Kings
short_description: Canvas of Kings is a minimalistic mapmaking tool that focuses on randomness and auto-generated elements on user-definable and interactive paths, plots and rooms.

name: RogueCraft Squadron
short_description: RogueCraft Squadron is a fast paced real-time strategy space adventure with roguelike elements. Play as a squadron commander fighting against a hostile alien race; collecting resources, researching new ships and building an armada as you fight to survive against overwhelming odds.

name: Unknown Rules
short_description: Unknown Rules is an independently created multiplayer online horror game that supports 1-4 players.

name: Prince of Persia The Lost Crown
short_description: Dash into a stylish and thrilling action-adventure platformer set in a mythological Persian world where the boundaries of time and space are yours to manipulate.

name: Life is Strange: Before the Storm Remastered
short_description: Life is Strange: Before the Storm returns with remastered visuals across characters & environments.

name: Survival Machine
short_description: Build your base on a moving Machine, travel through biomes with different resources, and prepare for the night when a zombie threat is much higher than during the day. Would you go solo or explore this new world with your best friends?

name: Abducted: The Night Hunters
short_description: Abducted: The Night Hunters is a horror-survival game where you must evade the relentless Grays and other enemies in the isolated Canela County. Gather resources, explore, and manage hunger, thirst, and sleep in a world invaded by aliens. Can you survive another night?

name: Monster Train 2
short_description: Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

name: Mexico, 1921. A Deep Slumber.
short_description: Immerse yourself in an emotional and intriguing narrative adventure video game about the awakening of a country.

name: Pro Basketball Manager 2017
short_description: Take on the role of coach of your own team with Pro Basketball Manager 2017. Start your career as head of the team of your choice, be they rookies or legends, and lead your players to victory!

name: VR Dunhuang
short_description: VR Dunhuang is developed with 8 grottoes，basically covering all dynasties in the Dunhuang Grottoes. By constantly upgrade VR Dunhuang and optimize the update, there will be gradually more than 700 caves of the Mogao Grottoes, more than 2000 statues, 45,000 square meters murals .
developers: Beijing Gravitational Waves VR technology co.,LTD

name: Real Dive World
short_description: In a world where the virtual space 'Real Dive System' has become the foundation of people's entertainment, the protagonist, Hikaru Arata, gets caught up in a sinister plot that misuses the Real Dive System.

name: Differently Fast
short_description: Differently Fast is a competitive wheelchair racing club in VR. Powered by nothing but your arms, it’s sweat, tears and glory.

name: Lightcube Pixel Art Editor
short_description: Lightcube is a pixel art editing tool for game developers and artists that make quality game assets, animations and stunning pixel art. Lightcube runs on Windows and supports layers, frames & a range of tools including a pen, eraser, magic wand selection, paint bucket, line draw and pattern brushes.

name: Foxhole
short_description: Foxhole is a massively multiplayer game where thousands of players shape the outcome of a persistent online war. Every individual soldier is a player that contributes to the war effort through logistics, base building, reconnaissance, combat, and more.

name: Zombie virus Ukraine 2022
short_description: Post-apocalyptic world filled with zombies, invaders, criminals and just crazy people, try to survive and save those who need it, create a community or join an already ready one, also don’t let the virus and diseases stop you.

name: Cook For Love
short_description: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.

name: The Warden
short_description: “The Warden” is a first-person psychological-horror game with puzzles.Ephram Elias Barkley is a landowner who , after losing his family , lives his life in a alcoholic loneliness.His life is interspersed with moments of lucidity and states of trance that seem to leave, as only trace, mysterious drawings of dark landscapes in which stands...

name: Star Trek™: Judgment Rites
short_description: Return to command of the USS Enterprise in this classic adventure game. True episodic format beams eight original point-and-click missions into your computer. Featuring the cast members and sound effects from Star Trek: The Original Series.

name: Spoxel
short_description: Explore, customize, and build across the world of Spoxel as you fight the otherworlders. Use runes to construct custom powerful or infuse weapons and armor with rare resources. Explore an infinite world while you build a base to establish a foothold of power to defend from your enemies!

name: CollabHub
short_description: CollabHub lets you draw and diagram on a virtual whiteboard with a team or all for yourself. Create advanced diagrams, upload images or share ideas in either the summer or winter environments. More than 30 tools and shapes to choose from.

name: COVEN
short_description: COVEN is a hyper-violent retro FPS where your path of vengeance will take you across time and space. Destroy your enemies and eat their flesh.

name: Wasteland 3
short_description: Following the critically acclaimed 2014 Game of the Year winner Wasteland 2, the RPG series that pioneered the post-apocalyptic genre in video games returns with Wasteland 3.

name: Bloomee
short_description: Delve into a virtual space free from the stresses of work, school and general day-to-day struggles. At times when it seems like we can't keep up with how fast the world is moving, take a load off and witness the worlds of Bloomee and satiate your desire to escape your current reality.

name: Ymir
short_description: Ymir is a 4X multiplayer strategy game combined with a city builder where each player develops a civilization of pigmen starting at the stone age.

name: Scrapland Remastered
short_description: The cult game that marked MercurySteam's origins returns; a sci-fi adventure with memorable characters, powerful ships and humor! Enjoy intense Multiplayer battles and races with ships you build.

name: Pandora: First Contact
short_description: Pandora: First Contact is a science fiction 4X turn-based strategy game on a planetary scale. Our Earth has been exhausted and colonial attempts on other planetary bodies have been in vain. Finally, after decades of exploration, an interstellar probe has brought promise of a new world.

name: Decks & Daggers
short_description: DECKS & DAGGERS is a Deck-Building RPG Card Game where you venture down into the dungeons to slay monsters and collect treasure.

name: Born Punk
short_description: A former combat hacker, a corporate CEO and a malfunctioning android get possessed by mysterious, otherworldly entities and must band together to save themselves and uncover the entities' origins. Talk, puzzle and explore your way through this (often humorous) cyberpunk thriller.

name: Oil-Manager
short_description: Who hasn't dreamed of building an oil empire? Make the dream come true.

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl
short_description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl tells a story about survival in the Zone – a very dangerous place, where you fear not only the radiation, anomalies and deadly creatures, but other S.T.A.L.K.E.R.s, who have their own goals and wishes.

name: SNOW BROS. SPECIAL: ANNIVERSARY EDITION
short_description: “It is a modern remake of Snow Bros., an arcade platform-based action game popular in 1990, characterized by its accessibility for people of all ages. It also provides diverse fun with new stages and new modes, and allows players to enjoy the original game as well.”

name: Rebellion GODSOUL: Awakening
short_description: 'GODSOUL' is a story-driven,Hyper-visually RPG. Team with 'rebel' girls who love gaming and drawing（and more）, resist villains and enjoy a mix of cyber reality, fantastical worlds, and card game action.

name: Pixelmash
short_description: Pixelmash is an innovative new pixel art and animation tool based on non-destructive pixelization, perfect for game makers, artists, hobbyists, kids, and lovers of the 8-bit and 16-bit eras.

name: G String
short_description: Slip into the Standard Issue Biosuit as Myo Hyori, a gifted Korean teenage girl who must face the perils of the future. Survive many hazards, explore a seemingly endless metropolis and beyond as the world around you implodes and history marches towards its inevitable conclusion.

name: Elf Manor
short_description: You will be playing as an Elf Master. Build your own manor and grow crops, farm, research, cook, and handcraft by yourself. Your mission is to fight against evil monsters and protect the world from corruption. The most important thing is staying alive.

name: Football Mogul 15
short_description: Football Mogul 15 is the 12th version of the addictive football simulation game from the makers of Baseball Mogul.This version includes rosters and player ratings for opening weekend of the 2015-2016 season. Enjoy controlling your football franchise in any year from 1970 to 2015.

name: Dragon Age™: The Veilguard
short_description: Unite the Veilguard and defy the gods in Dragon Age™: The Veilguard, an immersive single-player RPG.

name: Stygian: Outer Gods
short_description: Dive into a hostile world that challenges your very existence, in this survival horror game with RPG elements. Unravel a thousand-year-old mystery, risk your sanity and face the Outer Gods with your skills. Every bullet and every decision counts now, are you up to the task?

name: Space Company Simulator
short_description: Take the position of a CEO of a space transport company and become a new major player in the industry. Space Company Simulator is a realistic management sim game that will challenge your planning skills as you strive to launch the first manned mission to Mars.

name: Back in Service: a Metro Driver
short_description: Join the adventure and become the master of the metro in our game, which takes you into the underground world. Overcome challenges on the tracks from the cabin of a historic train. Can you complete the route, transport all passengers, and avoid delays?

name: Fires At Midnight
short_description: In a world where making love without being in love makes you spontaneously combust, the person you love most may be the one who burns you in Fires at Midnight – a cinematic and interactive visual novel about a couple who struggles to stay together.

name: Midjungard
short_description: Midjungard is a 3v3 deathmatch hack and slash with Battle Royale like elements set in a Norse universe! Choose from 4 characters & engage in intense PvP combat set in a beautifully lit game level that is huge. Has fantasy and magic elements. Tactical skill matters at least as much as magic!

name: Youtubers Life 3 - Stream Together!
short_description: Reach the top of the rankings! Create your dream home with a luxury setup, compete online in real-time with other users by streaming, creating VODs, and editing them in the most epic way… and don’t forget to share your photos in the unique and time-limited events on your calendar!

name: CyberCorp
short_description: Brutal fast-paced isometric Co-op Loot Shooter in Cyberpunk world. Equipment-based combos. Exotic Weapons and Armor. Easy to start, hard to master. Play solo or with friends.

name: Bodycam
short_description: Bodycam is the first tactical multiplayer FPS with a true body-camera view in Unreal Engine 5. Close-quarters combats feel raw and loud. Every angle, callout, and bullet matters. Play Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Body Bomb on photoreal maps where teamplay, tactics, and clutch skill are key.

name: Onslaught
short_description: This game features a highly dynamic background soundtrack, offering players an intense and thrilling challenge.

name: ADACA
short_description: A Sci-fi FPS set on the mysterious planet ADACA. - Use your GRAVITY-MANIPULATING arm to HURL objects at your foes or even RIP weapons directly from their hands! - EXPLORE and manipulate the environment in this EERIE and HOSTILE world!

name: Hades II
short_description: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

name: Ero Snooker
short_description: Play snooker and admire the girls.

name: Finding Mosey
short_description: Find your cat Mosey, choosing your degree of destruction and dedication. Fight, sneak, or talk your way into new areas and upgrade your character along the way as the search gets messy. Loot ridiculous items and discover hidden stories that help you explore this open world.

name: KALEIDO STELLA
short_description: 'Does your eye see the stars?' Visual Novel ADV 'Kaleidoscope Stella' fighting with the fate of the stars Circle CHARON presents a large-scale latest work set in the universe. Peaceful lives of boys and girls are shattered by the invasion of one alien. In order to protect this blue planet, you have to fight.

name: Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition
short_description: The critically acclaimed RPG that raised the bar, from the creators of Baldur's Gate 3. Gather your party. Master deep, tactical combat. Venture as a party of up to four - but know that only one of you will have the chance to become a God.

name: Eggoria
short_description: Unlimited world size&Migration. Digdog Studio's new Building/Survival Game, manage mysterious eggs, survive in an unlimited world, run away from darkness, build, research, craft, rest, prey, build your own tribe or even a town. Finally beat the darkness or live with it. Very Hardcore

name: Ultrawings
short_description: Ultrawings is an aerial-themed, open-world flight game where you use your virtual hands to fly multiple aircraft to complete a variety of missions across a beautiful, island-themed world!

name: Polar Penguin Post
short_description: Penguin Delivery Service!! Run a logistics company in Winter Mountain, the land of snow! Place the items in the bag so that the penguins can deliver them safely. Do people's favors and gain trust. You can help the Pola Penguin Post settle and penguins become recognized as residents.

name: Girl Mod | GIRLS VR (create + pose in VR)
short_description: Step into a highly immersive life-sized VR character creator and design a woman from head to toe. Then pose her any way you like in amazing scenes. It's a whole new level of character creation and posing. Wishlist now!

name: TramSim Vienna - The Tram Simulator
short_description: Experience with TramSim the most modern tram simulator, which impresses with photo-realistic graphics and as first location the Austrian capital Vienna in a virtual reality that has never been seen before.

name: AudioSpace
short_description: The best audio visualizer this side of the galaxy. Experience your favorite music like never before!

name: Zulu Response
short_description: Experience realistic combat gameplay from 1879 as you take command of your own squad of AI British soldiers or Zulu warriors in single, multiplayer or co-op. Configure AI to adjust their abilities and adjust game settings to create games that suit you.

name: Bratz™: Flaunt your fashion
short_description: The Bratz Pack has arrived– show the world your passion for fashion in a globe-trotting adventure to become the best style reporter!

name: Galaxis Wars
short_description: In the year 2120, humans face the threat of extinction from a looming war with the Galaxis. Progress through your simulation chamber’s elaborate and intense waves of simulated Galaxis fighters to gain powerful upgrades and new ships.

name: Journey to the West
short_description: A challenging rogue-like deck building game about a legendary adventure in the Realm of Divinity. Lead your team, build your unique deck, gather powerful relics and consumables to confront legendary creatures and eventually discover the truth behind the omen of darkness.

name: METALLIC CHILD
short_description: “Grab, hurl, and eliminate” Rogue-lite Core-Action!! A large-scale rebellion erupts within the spacecraft “Life Stream.” With the help of you, Rona, an android known as “Metallic Child,” stands up against a fleet of massive robots to stop the plot devised by her own creator, Doctor Irene.

name: Zombie Bar Simulator
short_description: 🍹 Zombie Bar Simulator is an incredibly engaging (and creepy!) bartending experience where you take on the role of the horrific bartender and serve your scarily nice customers multiple crazy dishes and drinks. 🍹

name: Marvel’s Spider-Man: Miles Morales
short_description: After the events of Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered, teenage Miles Morales is adjusting to his new home while following in the footsteps of his mentor, Peter Parker, as a new Spider-Man. When a fierce power struggle threatens to destroy his home, Miles must take up the mantle of Spider-Man and own it

name: Ultimate Epic Battle Simulator
short_description: Here is a sandbox like no other. Create massive battles with absolutely no limits. Want to see 10,000 chickens fight an army of Romans?? Sure, why not. Want to see a company of WW2 U.S soldiers fight 11,000 Medieval soldiers?? There are simply no limits to the carnage you can achieve in UEBS.

name: Destinesia
short_description: Destinesia is a sci-fi metroidvania which you are looking for a new home for humanity. Parkour your way through most dangerous jungles and explore the ancient dungeons. Upgrade your suit with the remains of your ancestors. Reveal the oldest secrets of Homo Sapiens.

name: 7 Days to Die
short_description: 7 Days to Die is an open-world game that is a unique combination of first-person shooter, survival horror, tower defense, and role-playing games. Play the definitive zombie survival sandbox RPG that came first. Navezgane awaits!

name: Verto Studio VR
short_description: VertoStudio VR is a fully-capable 3D modeling studio designed to run entirely in VR! You can use it to import FBX, OBJ, DAE (and more) directly in front of you, then configure every aspect of the visual display of these scenes directly down to the individual polygons.

name: Blood Bowl 3
short_description: Brutal, crazy, tactical… this is BLOOD BOWL! The iconic death sport returns with the new video game of fantasy football faithfully using the latest board game rules and new content. Create your team, then crush, mulch and cheat your way to the top... leaving your opponents in the graveyard.

name: Pocket Bravery
short_description: Inspired by classic fighting games from the 90's such as Street Fighter, Fatal Fury and The King of Fighters, 'Pocket Bravery' channels the 'Neo Geo Pocket' aesthetic for a modern fighting game with a retro twist!

name: Ys IX -Monstrum NOX-
short_description: Ys IX, the high-speed action RPG known for its exhilarating battles and adventure powered by special abilities, is now available on Steam®!

name: Sky Haven Tycoon - Airport Simulator
short_description: Build your own airport in Skyhaven! Live out your airplane tycoon and simulation game fantasies and make the best surroundings and strategy for both airline manager and passenger alike. Schedule flight plans, build terminals, landing strips and more and create an airport tycoon empire in Skyhaven.

name: Far Beyond: A space odyssey VR
short_description: Far Beyond: A space odyssey VR is the first hardcore Rogue-like in Virtual Reality with a Sci-fi atmosphere and AAA graphics. It features a hard but rich gameplay focused on resources management, craft and strategy.

name: Power & Revolution 2021 Edition
short_description: A new expansion of the ultra-realistic simulator of today's world where you play as the head of state or as the opposition! New Features for 2021: administration of the EU, Covid vaccinations, Biden's Challenge, political coalitions, diplomatic negotiations, worldwide tax and free-trade agreements.

name: Evil Labs
short_description: Evil Labs is a game about building and managing your own Evil Laboratory. Research and develop diseases, infect people, sell the cure and get rich!

name: Trainscape
short_description: All the fun and none of the mess in this VR sandbox for model railroaders!

name: Merek's Market
short_description: Merek's Market is a chaotic crafting game about running a medieval shop. Take charge of your shop as you haggle, barter and craft your way through a comical single player campaign or team up with friends in couch co-op to supply the whole town.

name: SenS
short_description: In the Beginning was the Nothingness... Enter the Unknown, explore the Infinite, find your own SenS.

name: Hexworld
short_description: Hexworld is a tactical autobattle RTS where you control the travelling kingdom-island, manage your tiles, collect and upgrade buildings, crash into other islands and watch your rare precious giant golem inevitably fall off the cliff on his way to the front lines.

name: Burden of Command™
short_description: Can you lead? Burden of Command is an emotionally authentic tactical leadership RPG. You’re a company Captain in the historical Cottonbalers. Fighting psychology as much as bullets, you must build respect, trust, and battlefield experience to bring your brothers safely home.

name: Lilja and Natsuka Painting Lies
short_description: A yuri kinetic novel about overcoming the tribulations of the human heart, and a sapphic tale on the heartaches and reprieves of fathoming love. Asou Ei’s first title with Frontwing is presented with poignant visuals in Full HD, an evocative soundtrack, and voice acting by a star-studded cast.

name: Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister
short_description: Vestaria Saga II continues the adventures of Zade, bringing the tales of him and his companions to a thrilling, satisfying end. They will encounter allies both new and old while uncovering more mysteries behind the vile Margulites and their plan to plunge Vestaria into a new age of darkness.

name: White Paper
short_description: What is your subconscious mind trying to tell you when you are mindlessly drawing on a piece of paper? Maybe someone trapped there, in a dark, damp basement and yes, screaming for help and trying to break out?

name: VEGAS Pro 22 Steam Edition
short_description: VEGAS Pro 22 – Steam Edition. The video software that takes your streaming highlights and gameplays to the next level.

name: Alien Marauder
short_description: “Alien Marauder” is a real-time strategy game with survival and confrontation theme. In this game, you will be the leader to a treacherous alien planet, build and defend base to survive against the vexan waves. Make the right decision!

name: Pro Basketball Manager 2016
short_description: In this comprehensive and realistic basketball management game, take control of all aspects of a coach's life such as recruitment, finances and training, as well as direct charge of games, in order to lead your team to the top of more than 70 championships that have been faithfully reproduced!

name: PAW Patrol: Grand Prix
short_description: No track is too big, no racer too small!   The PAW Patrol are on their fastest mission yet – To win the Pup Cup! Race around iconic locations including Adventure Bay, Jake’s Snowboarding Resort and The Jungle in this 4-player-championship to find out who will be crowned the winner.

name: Cookie Cutter: Overkill Edition
short_description: Fueled by love but driven by rage, Cherry embarks on a blood-soaked quest for revenge, explores the massive Megastructure, and eviscerates the armies of Infornet in a best-in-class action-adventure that breaks tropes and bones.

name: Langrisser I & II
short_description: The battle between light and chaos comes to a head in this remake of legendary Strategy RPGs Langrisser I and Langrisser II.

name: Fall of Freya (Alpha 1)
short_description: Sci-Fi Survival Shooter created by a small indie team. Powered by the Unreal Engine 4.

name: Descending The Woods
short_description: By day, tend to your farm, care for your pets, and explore the mysteries of the haunted woods. By nightfall, They will come from the woods, Beware of ghosts and demons of the haunted woods. Hide, Survive, Build, Fight and Explore in this eerie Survival Horror alone or with friends.

name: Vivid Knight
short_description: 'Vivid Knight' is a 'party-building roguelike' game in which you collect friends who have been turned into jewels and fight by combining their abilities! Explore the ever-changing dungeon and harness the gems you have gathered to challenge the labyrinth!

name: Pukan Bye Bye
short_description: Created to enrage.

name: Triversal
short_description: Unwind with Triversal: An award-winning casual spatial puzzle game that mixes chill with challenge.

name: Aggressor
short_description: Aggressor is a stylized air combat shooter with a physics-based damage model. Fly the greatest planes of the cold war and bring down the enemy with an arsenal of unique weaponry in a spectacular lightshow of force.

name: Wandering in Space VR
short_description: Join Wandering In Space, a unique FPS ROGUELITE SCI-FI experience built for VR. With a variety of space weapons, upgradable armory, power ups and unknown superpower, you, a soldier without any memory have to fight the mutants, cyborgs and the rebels to survive in the space of unknown...

name: Ostriv
short_description: Ostriv is a city-building game that puts you in a role of a governor of an 18th century Ukrainian town to challenge your creative skills and management abilities.

name: DREAMGATE
short_description: Dreamgate is a unique hardcore mix of deck building card battler, roguelite adventure and RPG. Build your deck, explore the Dreamgate world and defeat fearsome foes!

name: Broombot Battlegrounds
short_description: Battle to the death as adorable household cleaning robots in this frantic physics-based arena combat game! Compete in 1-4 player cage matches with your friends (or enemies) to be the meanest clean-machine of them all!

name: Rail Route
short_description: In Rail Route, you will design, construct, upgrade, and automate your railway network in one of the many maps based on real-life cities worldwide. Dispatch the trains to make the traffic flow and the network grow!

name: Buried Alive: The Annihilation VR
short_description: Buried Alive: The Annihilation is an immersive and intensive VR shooter. Survive and uncover the truth in the Annihilation!

name: Heavy Impact
short_description: Heavy Impact thrusts you into the ring as a first-person robot brawler made for Virtual Reality. Deliver devastating blows, and dodge big hits! Slow down time to deliver crucial combos, or avoid trouble in the last second. Become the king of the bob-and-weave, test your metal and scrap the competition!

name: Secret Ponchos
short_description: Secret Ponchos is a highly competitive PvP fighting game set in a stylish Spaghetti Western universe. The unique, fast-paced gameplay in 3v3 battles creates an environment where PvP skills will be put to the test every match.

name: Nomads of the Fallen Star
short_description: A trade sim & turn-based squad-RPG set in a dynamic & living sci-fi post-apocalyptic world. Take the reigns of a rag-tag scavenger gang as they unravel the mystery of the Fallen Star.

name: VEGAS Pro Edit 21 Steam Edition
short_description: VEGAS Pro Edit 21 Steam Edition. The creative standard for video and audio. Intuitive software that will turn your stream highlights and gameplays into engaging and entertaining videos.

name: Winter Resort Simulator 2
short_description: Winter Resort Simulator 2 is the extensive simulation of a ski area with all its exciting technical facilities and vehicles.

name: THE BRiLLiANT COUP
short_description: A fun and exciting 2D pixel art point and click adventure game with classic commands. Steal a world-famous brilliant from the best guarded bank in the country.

name: RXC - Rally Cross Challenge
short_description: Battle the world in reckless races as you bash, slide, and jump your way to the checkered flag. This isn't just another top-down arcade racing game. Made by two brothers, RXC is a physics heavy racing game with a traction and handling model that challenges sim racers and is still fun for newcomers.

name: The Political Process
short_description: Explore a dynamic world of politics in this turn-based, political simulator. Create a character, run for political office, write legislation, balance budgets, and more as you move up the political hierarchy.

name: STRIDE: Fates
short_description: Step into the shoes of a parkour spec-ops officer. Traverse your way through the rooftops and basements of dystopian Airon City - from slums to affluent skyscrapers. Deal with power shifts in gangs, dirty family feuds, corporate secrets, forbidden tech, and other obstacles to understand your past.

name: Sunburnt
short_description: Sunburnt is a multiplayer zombie survival game where guns WON’T help you! Zombie outbreaks have struck the country, and only a few humans have survived. Conventional weapons have little effect on the dead but they have a weakness… Light which gives them intensely painful sunburns!

name: Snowless Night
short_description: Snowless Night is a VR adventure where darkness has swallowed the light and Christmas is on the brink of extinction. Fight powerful enemies, uncover secrets, and restore hope to the world using an arsenal of modern magical technology. Early Access Fall 2024.

name: SHUFFLE! Episode 2 ~Kami ni mo Akuma ni mo Nerawareteiru Otoko~
short_description: 《SHUFFLE! episode2》是日本美少女游戏知名大厂Navel制作的作品。前作《SHUFFLE! 》是经典人气名作。本作由业界知名画师西又葵与铃平广携手担当原画与人物设计，并由创作了《近月少女的礼仪》、《D.C.》等经典系列作品的剧本家阵容联袂创作。本作曾荣获萌系游戏大赏角色设计金奖。

name: Starfighter: Infinity
short_description: A space based MMORPG with a focus on ‘dogfighting’ style action and exploration. Features a huge array of ships, imaginative weapons and ship upgrades with more being added all the time. Explore the galaxy, fight other players, form your own organisations, mine asteroids to craft new items, loot rare weapons from alien races, and more...

name: MegaSphere
short_description: Play as a special ops combat unit sent to investigate why the stars around Solar System are going dark in MegaSphere — a story-based post-cyberpunk action platformer adventure game of supermassive scale set in early 22nd century: smart guns, robots, self-reconstructing environments, and vast AIs.

name: Super Woden GP 2
short_description: Super Woden GP 2 is a love letter to the world of motor sports, offering a unique experience. Arcade-style isometric racing meets unrivaled campaign depth and a huge variety of vehicles to buy, sell and unlock.

name: Saint Emiliana
short_description: After Emiliana's sister is captured in a Witch Hunt, she offers up her soul to a demon in order to gain the power of a Witch. Now she must wrestle with her faith as she searches for her sister.

name: Last Light
short_description: En route to a scare game, Lumi realizes that she is suddenly alone. Then, appears the old abandoned hospital... Explore throughout the tragedy-stricken hospital. Search for the student IDs of Lumi's classmates. And find out what really happened. Maybe all you need is the courage to 'flee?'

name: Deep Space Outpost
short_description: Deep Space Outpost is a space station building & survival game, involving resource and base management. Build your space station tile by tile, mine asteroids, refine materials and keep your station operational.

name: Critter Cove
short_description: A deep, open world life sim and town building game set in a cozy post-apocalyptic paradise. Restore your town, sail across a mysterious archipelago, rescue animal pals. Hunt for relics and farm, fish & craft everything you need. Can you help turn Critter Cove into a thriving tourist town once again?

name: FINAL FANTASY XVI
short_description: An epic dark fantasy where fates are decided by mighty Eikons and the Dominants who wield them. This is the tale of Clive Rosfield, a tragic warrior who swears revenge on the Dark Eikon Ifrit, a mysterious entity that leaves naught but calamity in its wake.

name: Overthrown
short_description: Lift and throw anything as you build and manage your kingdom in this chaotic city builder for 1-6 players. Harness the power of your soul-stealing crown to defend your citizens from bandits and mutants, farm the land, and gather resources. Keep citizens happy or see them desert you!

name: Contraband Police
short_description: Take over the duties of a border guard inspector in a communist country of the 80's. Smuggling, corruption and forgery are the order of the day here. Be vigilant and earn the respect of your superiors.

name: Noelle Does Her Best!
short_description: After an unfulfilling childhood in the countryside, Noelle jumps at the first opportunity to move out and live on her own. Little does she know, her new home comes with the world's worst housewarming gift: a debt to the tune of a million gold, which she only has 10 days to repay! It's time for Noelle to do her best!

name: Descension
short_description: Descension is an OpenWorld Survival Horror Game That features constant new expansions and events. Survive For Six hours in uncharted universes, and get your exploration rewarded with a stronger arsenal!

name: RESONARK X
short_description: RESONARK X is an unprecedented rhythm game that offers a different way to play on the desktop and in VR. In desktop mode, players use 7 lanes + alpha and corresponding keyboard keys. In VR mode, you use a two-handed hand controller to clap your hands and manipulate six strings as you play.

name: SVRVIVE: The Deus Helix
short_description: A challenging mystery adventure game, ranked as one of the best HTC Vive games of 2017 (PC Advisor). With every mission comes entirely new worlds and puzzles. The story takes you through one of the longest VR games to date.

name: Sticky Dildo Man
short_description: Pickup items, punch polygonoids and don't bleed out! Get to the highest wave!

name: Forklift Simulator
short_description: Start your career in logistics today in Forklift Simulator! Take on a variety of different missions, a selection of vehicles and an extensive career mode in which you can put your skills to the test. Are you ready for the challenges ahead?

name: Cricket 24
short_description: Cricket 24 is the culmination of a decade of Cricket video game development and includes teams from every corner of the globe.

name: Coral Island
short_description: Coral Island is a vibrant, laid-back farm sim reimagined with multiplayer! Experience enchanting island life at your own pace: farm with friends, nurture animals, build relationships, hang out with a diverse cast of characters, and dive into the magical Merfolk Kingdom.

name: COLLAPSED
short_description: Collapsed is a post-apocalyptic roguelike action-platformer. Hunt your prey through vast procedurally-generated levels filled with tough enemies, useful loot and experience points. Fight alone or with a friend – either way, it won’t be easy!

name: Perfect Golf
short_description: Perfect Golf is a next generation, indie developed, single player and multiplayer golf game. Perfect Golf provides a truly immersive experience centered on stunning visuals and hyper-realistic game play. Don't just play golf - play PerfectGolf!

name: VR Karts SteamVR
short_description: ** This version of VR Karts is designed specifically and only compatible for HTC Vive ** The checkered flag is about to drop on a new Virtual Reality racing experience! Get in the drivers’ seat of your own customized kart and race against other players from around the world.

name: soul Interface
short_description: You explore an alien machine, learn to operate it, create virtual organisms, and grow an artificial ecosystem inside it. You design species down to individual atoms and watch them fight for survival. You then send successful species to other players to leech energy from them and power your machine.

name: Frozen Cortex
short_description: A hard-hitting simultaneous-turn-based tactical game from the creators of Frozen Synapse. Defeat your opponent’s plans on a randomly-generated playfield in this brutal futuresport.

name: College Bowl
short_description: College Bowl is a beautifully pixelated on-field simulation of American Football! Challenge college rivals on your way to winning a National title! Take on various game modes, including a deep Dynasty mode with in-depth recruiting, scouting, stat tracking, ranking, bowl games, yearly goals and more!

name: No Straight Roads: Encore Edition
short_description: Start a rock band & end the EDM empire in NO STRAIGHT ROADS, a rockin' action-adventure that mashes together rhythm-infused third-person combat with a kick-ass soundtrack!

name: Kingpin: Reloaded
short_description: Kingpin: Reloaded is an enhanced re-release of the classic tale of revenge. Take control of a street gang and order your recruits to attack, defend or even do a little safe-cracking to pick up some needed cash.

name: Virtual-O
short_description: Virtual-O is a new game that brings you the adventures of Orienteering without the need of going to faraway places. Nature will be your only enemy as you will try to navigate the Unknown using map and compass.

name: Friendship Club
short_description: Imaginary friends do battle in the mind of young Timmy Bibble! Who will be victorious in this arena of improbable dimensions, where no two rooms are the same and bullets bounce forever?! Get your buddies together for the ultimate showdown in this bullet hell party game!

name: Two Point Museum
short_description: Curate and manage incredible museums! Explore to discover amazing artifacts. Design and refine the layout, keep staff happy, guests entertained, donations plentiful… and children off the exhibits

name: Villagers
short_description: Villagers is a beautifully illustrated and richly detailed town-building game where you build a thriving community using the people and resources around you. Success or failure depends on your ability to create a town that can grow and prosper, and overcome the harsh realities of medieval life!

name: X Fugitive
short_description: X Fugitive is a police chase game where player have to run from the police cars . This is an endless game in which you just have to survive as long as possible.

name: Malmyr
short_description: Malmyr - Plan and optimize complex production chains. In each of the royal missions, the rules change and you are always challenged anew. What is it about the magical dwarven runes? Can you combine the runes correctly to master even the greatest challenges?

name: Last Gang Standing
short_description: Gather up a gang of your friends, build a base, add a factory, add some turrets, add teleporters, doors, foxholes and decorations. Arm yourselves to the teeth and go forth to raze, loot and t-bag all who stand against you. Be the Last Gang Standing

name: PIXELS: Digital Creatures
short_description: PIXELS is a turn-based combat roguelike where you battle with and against powerful creatures called Pixels. Fight your way through an ever-changing World where you never know what's next! Recruit Pixels and equip them with items to build the ultimate team! What Team will you lead to Victory?

name: ConnecTank
short_description: ConnecTank is an action game for one to four players where you step inside a big honking tank. Link conveyor belts together, craft ammo, and put out fires as you battle rival tanks to help Finneas Fat Cat deliver packages. Build new tanks and take jobs in an ever-changing world.

name: Nightlight Secrets
short_description: An interactive anime styled 3D visual novel with a mysterious and deep story that contains choices leading you to different endings.

name: KALPA: Cosmic Symphony
short_description: A next-generation rhythm game where story and music intertwine. Enjoy a tracklist filled with famous licensed songs and exclusive original songs made by renowned composers Discover an immersive story, and face endless challenges. Your performance will dictate the fate of the world.

name: RUINSMAGUS
short_description: Dive in and experience the magical world of Grand Amnis! Armed with the gauntlet, explore the mysterious Ruins beneath the city with your companion Iris, a novice researcher, as you uncover the dark secrets and prevent a terrifying future in this narrative action adventure.

name: Airport Madness 3D: Volume 2
short_description: Play at ten airports: Las Vegas, Princess Juliana, New York John F. Kennedy, Toronto Pearson, Miami, London City, San Francisco, Lukla Nepal, Hong Kong, and Chicago O'Hare. Airport Madness 3D: Volume 2 also offers new aircraft, more gates, and sharper detail.

name: STAY ALIVE MY SON (PC Version): A True Story About A Father's Search For His Son
short_description: Winner of the Producer's Guild Innovation Award, Stay Alive My Son is a virtual reality feature based on a true story of a Cambodian genocide survivor and father haunted by his past, to first-handedly experience an inspirational journey about family separation and the power of redemption.

name: TRESPASS - Episode 2
short_description: Trespass – Episode 2 is a game that will test your wits through puzzle solving elements and action packed scenarios. Assist Samuel Rodriguez through different environments by searching for clues and interacting with surrounding objects in order to escape.

name: Lost Flight: Survival
short_description: Find yourself stranded on a mysterious, uncharted island after a devastating plane crash. With no signs of rescue, your only goal is to survive

name: SACRALITH : The Archer`s Tale
short_description: SACRALITH: The Archer's Tale is a VR bow-and-arrow shooter. Help your AI companions as you pass various locations together toward the game's main goal: the magic stone called Sacralith that grants you power over dragons.

name: Gamitate - Meditate, Relax, Feel Better
short_description: Gamitate is a like a gym for your mind and soul. 'Work Out' your mind with carefully selected meditation techniques! Gamitate is designed to make you feel calmer, happier, and more peaceful. Enjoy the benefits of a wide variety of easy meditation techniques.

name: Dungeon Reels Tactics
short_description: Dungeon Reels Tactics is a challenging party based RPG roguelike with Slot Machine based Combat. Your party members' unique slot machine will supply your abilities each turn. Make the best decisions to succeed in Battle. Lose party members, recruit new ones, and try to reach The 'Great Evil'.

short_description: Colette has been living a happy life as an apprentice alchemist, but when a mysterious stranger pays her master Priscilla a visit, Priscilla sets out on a journey. With her master gone, it's up to Colette to inherit the workshop and help those in need while also embarking on adventures of her own!

name: Kartong - Death by Cardboard!
short_description: Kartong - Death by Cardboard! puts you up against wicked experiments inside the miniature city of Kartong. You have been shrunken down to the size of a guinea pig, trapping you in a home-built cardboard maze of evil toys & traps. Your goal is now to escape! But beware, 'Sven' is watching you.

name: Flatworld

Explore, gather resources, craft with your hands in 3D, and build anything you can imagine. Featuring great VR controls, near-infinite view distance, Steam Workshop mod support, and much more!

short_description: The stage is set. Imagine an old baroque manor, perhaps a hotel or a museum, somewhere in central Europe. A woman wanders in search of answers.

name: Forged of Blood
short_description: A fantasy turn-based tactical RPG built on depth and mechanical complexity, featuring classless character building, strategic management, and small unit tactics on a world scale.

name: GEHENA
short_description: Gehena is a single-player first-person horror game. The only way out of the cursed town is to make the right choice and not get caught in the fog. Is what you see real or is your mind playing tricks on you?

name: Gnomes Garden 3: The thief of castles
short_description: Gnomes Garden 3 — a new chapter in this exciting fantasy/strategy game. Head off into unknown lands and defeat the warlock!

name: Explorer of Yggdrasil
short_description: After rescuing an armless mage during a chance encounter, the explorer Mei embarks on a journey to reach the top of Yggdrasil, and to uncover the mystery of her forgotten past.

name: Paper Train Traffic
short_description: Paper Train Traffic is here to test your mind and reflexes with increasingly complex challenges. From single railroads to multi railway nodes, your task is to supervise the ongoing train traffic of many different locations around the World.

name: Dune: Imperium
short_description: The award-winning board game of strategy and intrigue in the iconic universe of Dune. The Spice must flow.

name: Richie's Plank Experience
short_description: You're on a plank, 80 stories high. Knees shaky, palms sweaty. You have a choice. Do you walk or do you freeze? Richie's Plank is the only VR experience that lets you clone any real-world plank into the virtual world for 2X the immersion.

name: UNCULT
short_description: 'UNCULT' is a Adventure where the protagonist, the daughter of a cult leader, suffers from amnesia after an accident in a fanatical pseudo-religious group. Now, she must piece together her obscured past, facing numerous challenges and uncovering the truth. Your decisions will shape her destiny.

name: Landless
short_description: Explore and conquer the high seas in this post-apocalyptic sandbox water world survival game where you must fight, build, and craft to survive.

name: Combat Mission Cold War
short_description: CM Cold War is set in the tipping-point years of a conflict that gripped the world for 45 years. Between 1979-1982, both the NATO and Soviet Warsaw Pact militaries began the shift away from industrialized warfare of the early 20th century and towards the modern digital battlefield of today.

name: RAIDBORN
short_description: RAIDBORN is an addicting fantasy action RPG with base building and procedural dungeons. Loot legendary treasures, upgrade your gear, level up your skills, and hurl yourself into intense combat.

name: Nanairo Reincarnation
short_description: Join spirit detective Kagami Makoto and his demon familiars as they hunt down the wandering ghosts disrupting the peace of his small town.

name: Guardians of Greenheart
short_description: After ten thousand years of waiting, the Demon Lord Alrolloth and his bloodthirsty Orc warriors have returned to Greenheart. With a force of mighty Orc warriors and help from the Demons of Hell, the fall of the Great Forest Greenheart is only a matter of time.

name: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2
short_description: This is a 'Mysterious Dungeon' style roguelike game where the terrain changes with each challenge. Make the monsters your 'Friends' and go on a new adventure!

name: MAGLAM LORD
short_description: The demon king is an endangered species!? Oh, slash such fate! A brand new Action-RPG presented by gorgeous creators!

name: Adventuring With Matilda!
short_description: Step into the shoes of an aspiring adventurer and delve into a perilous dungeon alongside Matilda, a beautiful elf with a secret, exploring and deepening your bond through shared trials and bonding moments.

name: Professional Farmer: Cattle and Crops
short_description: Professional Farmer: Cattle and Crops takes you out into the countryside and impresses with its depth and attention to detail! Experience how exciting the profession of a farmer can be. Work your fields with original machines or coordinate these tasks with your workers.

name: Life is Strange Remastered
short_description: Experience the BAFTA award-winning story of Life is Strange now beautifully remastered with enhanced visuals and vastly improved animation using mocap technology.

name: Sonority
short_description: Sonority is an innovative music puzzle adventure set in a lovingly designed, fascinating world. Play as Esther and discover the rockery, a place full of music and unique puzzle mechanics.

name: Drill Core
short_description: Corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining in Drill Core! Drill to the heart of planets while managing workers, researching cutting-edge tech, and fortifying against alien attacks. Will you prioritize efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or focus on defense for survival?

name: Let's Cook Together 2
short_description: Let’s Cook Together 2 is a frantic, cooking game for 1-4 players. Learn over 65 dish recipes, master 250+ levels, upgrade your kitchen appliances and travel around the world to make cooking meaningful again. Communication is the key!

name: Stifled - Echolocation Horror Mystery
short_description: Stifled is a multi-award winning, Sound-based Stealth Thriller Mystery, where SOUND is the only way you SEE and the enemies HEAR your fear through your microphone input. Microphone input and VR Features are optional.

name: Heterodox
short_description: Carefully cut and shoot your way through undead or other unique creatures in a dark-fantasy world fps. Do this to remove the evil, twisted schemers from taking control of the lands below the Sky-Gate. After that, return gloriously in your home capital as it is safe once more.

name: Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom
short_description: Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom is a history-driven turn-based strategy set in WW2. Take command of the Allied forces and protect your homeland and the whole of Europe from totalitarian madness. Form armies. Win battles. Change history.

name: Akolyta
short_description: Uncover the darkest secrets of the Cold War as you will slowly lose everything - even your sanity in the first-person horror adventure Akolyta. You will battle the worst Cold War products of the MK Ultra program and your own deteriorating mental health.

name: BLASTRONAUT
short_description: BLASTRONAUT is a mining game in a procedural alien world. Explore, extract and profit.

name: SUM
short_description: Through SUM VR, try to survive on another uninhabited island. Here you can build buildings, eat food, and do whatever you want to do. Buy now and get all future updates for free.

name: Flat Worlds
short_description: Flat Worlds is a VR space transport game set in our very own Solar System. Setup transport networks of people and natural resources, guiding the path of human colonization around the Solar System's planets and moons. What will we find when there is no more room to grow?

name: Once Upon A Puppet
short_description: Control the strings of fate and embark on a grand adventure with Drev and Nieve. A magical, story-driven 2.5D puzzle-platformer where puppeteering mechanics and a whimsical, theater-inspired world intertwine.

name: The Sacred Acorn
short_description: A cozy souls-lite adventure about a small squirrel embarking on an epic quest to save her tribe from the corruption threatening to destroy their world. Upgrade your magical abilities, battle legendary guardians, and explore a dangerous, enchanted land in this 2D action-adventure.

name: BossHunter VR
short_description: BossHunter VR is the first version of the game where players will have to fight many interesting opponents, use multiple weapons, and a unique mechanic of its kind where the player directly commands a weapon to execute something with the help of speech. The hunt is on!

name: Mannequin Character Generator
short_description: 2D character portrait generator for visual novels, JRPGs, and VTubers!

name: Medieval Delivery
short_description: Because deliveries also existed in medieval times, Medieval Delivery is a third-person simulation and adventure game where you'll have the task of making deliveries throughout the village according to the requests of its inhabitants, such as meat, flour, bread, and perhaps other things.

name: Let's Create! Pottery VR
short_description: Let's Create! Pottery VR is the best way to relieve your everyday stress and find your inner peace. It's an impressive, therapeutic, and uplifting experience you can enjoy in the comfort of your home.

name: AppGameKit Studio
short_description: With AppGameKit Studio we've re-imagined the game development user interface with an all-in-one work space. You can now quickly drag & drop assets to visualise your scenes, code with AppGameKit script, easily browse app media, run live debugging sessions, access online help and lots more!

name: Toxic place
short_description: Toxic Place, an exciting story in the form of a soul like game, combined with a sandbox for you to experience adventure. In a world full of pollution and monsters that have been affected have mutated into terrifying creatures. Will you be able to survive this cruel world?

name: Manny Boxing VR
short_description: Manny Pacquiao is the only eight-division world champion in the history of boxing and has won twelve major world titles. Enjoy boxing with world-renowned boxing star, Manny Pacquiao! Realistic physics, immersive sound, and fluid animation make you feel like you’re really in the Boxing ring.

name: Warrior Maiden Lecia and the Lost Fortress
short_description: A fresh graduate of the military academy, Lecia has just joined the ranks and received her first posting. She is to head to Kreist Fortress, a remote outpost far from the capital Central. However, what awaits her is the Lost Fortress fallen into disrepute at the hands of her new commander.

name: The Dark Occult
short_description: The Dark Occult is a psychological driven horror game that puts players in a constant state of anxiety that crescendos into raw panic and terror. You will encounter grotesque creatures, who will take your life at any moment.Your only goal -- survive.

name: Hyper Light Drifter
short_description: Explore a beautiful, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers and lost technologies.

name: Rinlo
short_description: Rinlo​ is an immersive third person puzzle adventure game designed for VR. Follow Agatha in her epic quest. Guide her through dioramas of this steam-powered city, and unlock the truth hiding behind its familiar, winding streets.

name: Everdell
short_description: Harvest resources to build a village of woodland critters in this adaptation of the award-winning tabletop board game!

name: Underworld Re: Card
short_description: Japanese Anime Style X Roguelike Deck-building CCGReborn into Underworld As A Hero!'Underworld Re: Card' is a game that combines deck-building and Rogue-like elements. Players are reborn into various races to fight and explore in the fantasy world.

name: Scopaesthesia
short_description: Join your friends or go it alone in this cooperative horror game. Collect pieces of evidence to uncover a mysterious disappearance, all while an unknown entity lurks in the shadows. Venture through a variety of environments, gathering what you can to progress and complete your objective...

name: Third Eye
short_description: Third Eye is a hack 'n' slash adventure game with its roots set in Indian culture. A game that is made by a group of 8 people putting in all their efforts to bring you the experience of a hack and slash adventure game made in India

name: Draco Knight
short_description: Don your armor and take up the spear and shield. Draco Knight is a brutally difficult action platformer with a hint of metroidvania that utilizes twin stick controls to provide an intricate and hard to master gameplay. Prepare yourself for a fast paced, action packed and exciting combat experience.

name: Knights of the Chalice 2
short_description: Knights of the Chalice 2 is a 2D RPG with turn-based combat. Create six Adventurers and set forth on an epic adventure against Evil. Overcome the odds with superior tactics. Enjoy a whole new dimension of complexity and variety based on the 3.5 ruleset! Includes a Module Editor.

name: Talisman: Digital 5th Edition
short_description: The definitive, most customisable version of Talisman, ever. Discover a world where every journey is a fresh experience in the ultimate digital sandbox for this iconic fantasy adventure board game. This is your Talisman, your rules.

name: Rise of Industry 2
short_description: Navigate the competitive industrial landscape of vibrant 1980's USA! Make strategic manufacturing decisions, optimize production chains, acquire technologies, and expand your global business network with key contacts. Opportunities await those savvy enough to capitalize on them!

name: Neon Valley: Revenge
short_description: The government has won the cyberwar. Their grasp chokes the citizens of every country as oppression rules the world. Then a group of hackers carved out an untraceable piece of the cyberspace and created the underground network known as Neon Valley.

name: SHIPS AT WAR
short_description: Sink player-made battleships, aircraft carriers and submarines in this physics-based game. Use pre-built ships and sink the enemy by deploying aircraft, torpedoes, depth charges or shells. Or built your own ships in the extensive ship-editor.

name: Sledders
short_description: Hit the backcountry in Sledders, the snowmobile simulator! Conquer deep powder with realistic physics and compete with friends in multiplayer. Are you skilled enough to reach the peak first? Jump in and prove your sledding skills!

name: Winter Survival
short_description: Winter Survival is a story-driven survival game where trauma turns reality into a reflection of your breaking mind. Battle cold, hunger, hallucinations, and adapt to the wilderness as it adapts to you.

name: PGA TOUR 2K25
short_description: Take your best shot at glory in PGA TOUR 2K25! In a 2K-first, compete in three prestigious major tournaments. Personalize your game with expanded MyCAREER, MyPLAYER and Course Designer options. Challenge friends across ranked, casual, and cross-platform multiplayer.

name: TRIBES 3: Rivals
short_description: TRIBES 3: Rivals is a team-based first person shooter that elevates the genre with jetpacks, skiing, and class-based warfare. Teamwork, tactics, high speed, and intense combat are supreme in this rebirth of the world’s fastest shooter.

name: New Heights: Realistic Climbing and Bouldering
short_description: The ultimate climbing and bouldering simulation game. Explore and climb 250 real world routes, create your own routes and compete against your friends from the safety of your computer.

name: LUNAR Remastered Collection
short_description: Dive into the enchanting worlds of LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete and LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete! Tag along on Alex and Hiro's quests and challenge enemies like the Magic Emperor and God of Destruction to save the world from dire peril in two adventures set 1000 years apart from each other!

name: Smokyflex
short_description: Game Features: - Pixel graphics - Hero weapon upgrade system - Final Boss - Soundtrack

name: Feed the Cups
short_description: Feed the Cups is a Roguelite multiplayer online cooperative game. Run a Drink Shop, stocking up, preparing ingredients, taking orders, crafting drinks, cleaning up, and checking equipment. Join your friends together!

name: Titanic VR
short_description: Witness the sinking of RMS Titanic. Explore the shipwreck. Titanic VR is a diving simulator and immersive interactive story. With over 6 hours of game-play Titanic VR you will leave with a greater understanding of the historic tragedy that unfolded in 1912.

name: TRAUMA Broken Paradise
short_description: A childhood stolen by brutality, a mind shattered by loss... In the ruins of a forgotten past, Sophia Markwell searches for the truth—will the ghosts of her parents’ murder lead her to redemption, or deeper into madness? And who’s Catherine?

name: Truck Life
short_description: Brand new truck simulation game, experience fun from a variety of truck driving. Drive around the original Chinese map, complete hundreds of specialty tasks through different cities. Meet in the mountains, rivers, lakes and seas. Let’s share your truck life.

name: Live by the Sword: Tactics
short_description: Live By The Sword: Tactics is a streamlined tactical RPG that blends classic and contemporary gameplay elements. The game is set in a world recovering from the ravages of war, you must navigate the treacherous landscape to prevent further turmoil. Single Player and Multiplayer modes available.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 9
short_description: Save your next party! 5 new games in 1 Party Pack: the trivia bluff-off Fibbage 4, the team test Quixort, the joke auction Junktopia, the silly guessfest Nonsensory and the reality TV game Roomerang.

name: Tower Princess
short_description: A charming 3D roguelite platformer about a normal day in the life of a knight! Sharpen the spear and make the Dragon run in fear! Oh, and also try to manage a date with princesses & princes you rescue.

name: Genesia Legacy: Ultimate Domain
short_description: Successor of 'old school' games, Genesia Legacy is a challenging and punitive turn-based strategy game, easy to learn but hard to master.

name: Prism
short_description: Prism is a video file converter for Windows. It can convert many different types of video files, like mp4, avi, wmv, vob, mkv, mpeg and many more. Prism Video Converter is lightning-fast and easy-to-use. Edit, adjust videos within Prism, and choose from a wide variety of output settings.

name: Revoke
