short_description: Revoke is a VR arcade shooter with breathtaking boss fights. You play as Major Miya, serving in the Rebel army, who has found herself being hunted by her former comrades. Use multiple special modules on your bionic hands to survive---Deformation Canon, Time Freezing! More crazy moves coming soon.

name: Haque
short_description: Haque is a glitch fantasy roguelike adventure about cute monsters, low-bit hauntings, and a suspiciously talkative narrator. Choose your character and battle through forests, deserts and dungeons to defeat a mysterious evil. Die often. Try again!

name: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars
short_description: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars is an RPG set in a world of swords and sorcery, told entirely through the medium of cards.

name: Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II
short_description: The sequel to the award winning Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice, Senua returns in a brutal journey of survival through the myth and torment of Viking Iceland. Intent on saving those who have fallen victim to the horrors of tyranny, Senua faces a battle of overcoming the darkness within and without.

name: Hidden Ghost Town
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Australian Football Coach
short_description: Coach your team to the premiership flag! Australian Football Coach is the premier Aussie Rules Football management game. Coach in one of eight different leagues, create your own footy world or even pit the different states against each other in State of Origin mode.

name: Persona® 5 Strikers
short_description: Join the Phantom Thieves and strike back against the corruption overtaking cities across Japan. A summer vacation with close friends takes a sudden turn as a distorted reality emerges; reveal the truth and redeem the hearts of those imprisoned at the center of the crisis!

name: Destiny Star Girlfriend 3
short_description: In the final(?) route of this award-winning VN series, Seiji survives an attempt on his life by Kanoko, aka secret magical girl no. 3. The leads all point to a childhood tragedy and a certain deep-space Majin, so why him? And will Kanoko leave the dark side to save Seiji—and mankind—from herself?

name: Lambda Spellcrafting Academy - Learn to Program!
short_description: Develop magical programming abilities while building spells. Lambda Spellcrafting Academy is a card-based puzzle game where you build spells (programs) to solve puzzles. If you've ever wanted to dabble in spellcraft (programming) here is a fun way to get started.

name: Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou 2
short_description: 《近月少女的礼仪2》是由日本美少女游戏资深大厂 Navel 制作的超人气女装系列作品的第三部。国际中文版除收录游戏本篇中的内容外，也将包括Limited Edition追加的『樱小路露娜接后日谈的后日谈《对好答案后是美妙的问候》以及『堂兄妹理论及其中心』两个特别篇内容以及全角色语音内容。

name: Wild Radio Flux
short_description: A fast-paced, charming action-adventure side-scroller Platformer game, packed with nostalgic energy. Explore, discover, collect, fight, unlock new stages, and grow your hero to save free thought from a tech-controlled dystopian future!

name: [International] AbsentedAge: Squarebound
short_description: Absented Age is a fresh mix of genres: an action RPG outside of combat that becomes a roguelike-style strategy RPG during combat.

name: Ultrawings FLAT
short_description: Ultrawings is an aerial-themed, open-world flight game where you fly multiple aircraft to complete a variety of missions across a beautiful, island-themed world!

name: Loco Dojo
short_description: Enter the whimsical wooden world of Loco Dojo and step up to Grand Sensei’s ‘Table of Trials’ to pit your silliest skills against (up to) three friends or strangers in this hilariously competitive cross-platform multiplayer social VR party game.

name: GNOSIA
short_description: The Gnosia lie. Pretending to be human, they’ll get in close, trick and deceive, and then eliminate one victim at a time...

name: Hitstream
short_description: Want to make exercise fun? Punch, stretch, squat and step your way to fitness in this 360° game that takes you to stunning locations across the globe. Hit the objects, catch the orbs, dodge the walls and, if you’re feeling really energetic, turn squats on.

name: Straight Up Poker SE
short_description: A highly customizable, offline, single player poker game, with over 130 different built in poker game types, and a rules editor to create your own poker types.

name: Evil Bank Manager
short_description: What could be better than having a million dollars, a billion? This will not make you all powerful in the world, your goal will not only be to make lots of money, but to print money and become a Federal reserve system

name: Elixir
short_description: Welcome to Elixir, a 2D strategic puzzle experience. Become an ancient alchemist with a mysterious past to unlock. Explore & find lost souls who need your help. Uncover Elixirs and experiment on them, and yourself. Embark on a dark journey to solve puzzles, unlock recipes and unearth hidden secrets.

name: SGS Afrika Korps
short_description: The game recreates the campaigns and battles of Erwin ‘Desert Fox’ Rommel’s legendary Afrika Korps, in Libya between 1941 and 1942. Play the Axis forces to conquer the most valuable prize of all: the Suez Canal. Or command the 8th Army soldiers, the famous Desert Rats, to repel the invaders.

name: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage
short_description: Embark on a new narrative journey by the creators of Life is Strange. Film your summer of 1995 and create memories of a lifetime with your new friends. 27 years later, confront the dark secrets that made you all promise to never speak again after that fateful summer.

name: SIGNALIS
short_description: A classic survival horror experience set in a dystopian future where humanity has uncovered a dark secret. Unravel a cosmic mystery, escape terrifying creatures, and scavenge an off-world government facility as Elster, a technician Replika searching for her lost dreams.

name: Mittelborg: City of Mages
short_description: Mittelborg: City of Mages is a strategic adventure with elements of rogue-like and resource management. You are crowned to be Chancellor of the city, but this power is a heavy burden. Face tough decisions, fight mystical tempests, look for the cause of upcoming chaos. Will Mittelborg have a future?

name: Castle Cardians
short_description: Castle Cardians fused card games,roguelike and real time colony defense together. Build your powerful deck, defend the castle and beat invaders.

name: Blue Hunter
short_description: Welcome to hell! Blue Hunter is an RPG roguelike deckbuilder where you forge your own path as a hunter and turn into a god! Create your own army of undead monsters, unlock powerful skills and beat all the gods that stand in your way. How far can you go?

name: Flowers -Le volume sur automne-
short_description: As the summer heat fades, Suoh Shirahane is just one step away from unraveling the mystery of why her beloved Amitie partner left in the spring.

name: Buoyancy
short_description: Buoyancy is a city-building strategy game where you build, manage, and move a floating city on an oceanic world. Explore and scavenge resources scattered around the endless waters. Keep your villagers nourished and happy while combating fires, sickness, and pirate attacks.

name: WyrmBound
short_description: In WyrmBound, you can have thrilling fights to improve your skills, ride amazing dragons, control their abilities, and change the course of battles. Face off against legendary Asian deities and mythical creatures to bring back peace to the land.

name: Rune The First Wanderer
short_description: Can a girl who can’t remember her name or birth recover her memories through new relationships she made and experiences she underwent after wandering about aimlessly?

name: Sunkenland
short_description: Get ready for a Waterworld-themed survival game with modular base building, sunken city scavenging, crafting, base defense, and invasions of NPC clans for resources and territory. Ready for the water apocalypse?

name: Plague: London 1665
short_description: Plague: London 1665 is an RPG with pixel art graphics set in 1665's during the Bubonic Plague outbreak in overcrowded and polluted London. As a body collector, graveyard keeper, and family provider, avoid the disease while clearing the streets. Will you survive the outbreak or become another victim?

name: Fantasy Dungeon VR
short_description: Fantasy Dungeon VR is a roguelike dungeon crawler with gesture-based abilities. Use more than just your sword for fighting.

name: Vilset
short_description: Vilset is a strategic simulator based on the principle of survival of people, who turned out to be beyond the limits of their civilization.

name: MorphVOX Pro 4 - Voice Changer (Old)
short_description: MorphVOX Pro will change your voice online and in-game. Take your voice-changing to a new level with superior voice-learning technology, background cancellation, and sound quality.

name: Whitewater VR: Extreme Kayaking Adventure
short_description: Get ready to paddle through some of the world's wildest, and most challenging rapids in breathtaking VR. With stunning graphics, realistic physics, and heart-pumping action, you'll race against the clock as you navigate through wild waters filled with obstacles and surprises.

name: Duriano
short_description: Duriano is a top-down arena shooting Slasher roguelite game where the player will be a hero durian of the norse wielding a weapon to fight upon a god of norse mythology. From different weapons, Durian hero, God’s trail, items will lead the player to create a build and defeat all gods of asgard.

name: 3D PUZZLE - Alchemist House
short_description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

name: Starship Horizons: Bridge Simulator
short_description: Starship Horizons is a multi-player experience allowing 2-6 players commanding a Starship as the bridge officers in the roles of Captain, Flight, Tactical, Science, Operations, and Engineering.

name: The Revival
short_description: The Revival is a story-based, tactical stealth First-Person Shooter game which is set in the near future. Get ready for covert operations. Play as a well-trained special soldier who fights on his own against his deadly competitors.

name: Tropico 6
short_description: El Presidente is back! Prove yourself once again as a feared dictator or peace-loving statesman on the island state of Tropico and shape the fate of your very own banana republic through four distinctive eras.

name: Sixtar Gate: STARTRAIL
short_description: Sixtar Gate: STARTRAIL is a rhythm game for keyboard set against a space exploration backdrop. Captain your science vessel alongside your navigator Shii as you explore the vast Sixtar system!

name: Truck & Logistics Simulator
short_description: Load, drive, and deliver through a huge open world with up to 24 players in cross-platform multiplayer. Join your friends in exciting heavy transport convoys. Jump into the driver's seat of more than 30 unique vehicles and carry out complex loading tasks to deliver a variety of cargo.

name: Spaceteam VR
short_description: A chaotic, cooperative party game! Shout technobabble at your friends until your spaceship inevitably explodes. Attempt to follow randomly generated, incorrectly assigned instructions. Work together… as a Spaceteam!

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II
short_description: Return to the Calvard Republic and unravel the mystery of the crimson beast! One day, a shocking series of murders set the wheels of fate into motion once again. Chaos looming on the horizon, the spriggan Van Arkride receives an unexpected visitor. Who is behind the murders, and what is their goal?

name: DOUGH: A Crime Strategy RPG
short_description: A crime based 4X strategy game with heavy RPG elements. Money, power, women... in the Prohibition, the world of crime is prospering, but in it, the road to the top is filled with blood. The ruthless competition, the greedy politicians and the pesky policemen, everyone wants to come out on top!

name: Mystery of Myths: Mystery of the Fjords Collector's Edition
short_description: Unravel divine conspiracies and find hidden objects scattered across breathtaking Scandinavian landscapes, from misty fjords to the halls of Valhalla!

name: Immortal Legacy: The Jade Cipher[VR]
short_description: Delve deep into the origins of a sinister Chinese legend, and unearth the secrets of an island’s forgotten past in this pulse-pounding adventure.

name: Treater
short_description: Hardline of sci-fi survival on Space Station! Craft, Research, Explore and Fight against evolving mutants. Interesting open world and big sectors to explore! Manage the entire colony single-handed! Can you survive long enough to escape the horror?

name: Star Rangers™ XE
short_description: Explore space and build on other worlds in Star Rangers! Star Rangers is a space exploration and construction game that allows players to build habitats and spacecraft, acquire gear and explore the solar system.

name: Pixel Dungeon VR
short_description: With core gameplay of multiplayer cooperative dungeon combat, upgrade Battle Talent's combat thrills, this co-op game brings you into VR Minecraft world to explore the unknown！Designed around player exploration and social experiences.

name: Boat Crew
short_description: Command your crew in Boat Crew, a gripping action-strategy experience amidst the Pacific War. Take charge of a PT boat against Imperial Japan, skillfully managing resources and personnel by any means necessary to ensure victory in this high-stakes conflict.

name: Omi Domini
short_description: Reyna, Hiei, and Jamal set out into the bowels of the Sistine Divide, the molten core of their homeland! The celestial lords await them observing their fighting style to fight you, the player, on your own level!

name: Motorbike
short_description: A casual bike skills game full of action and real physics dynamics.

name: The Tribe Must Survive
short_description: The Tribe Must Survive is a survival base builder strategy game set in a harsh Lovecraftian Stone Age. Build your camp, overcome disasters and uncover new areas. Manage fears and diminish internal conflicts, as your Tribe grows. Every decision matters. Will your Tribe survive?

name: The Oregon Trail
short_description: The Oregon Trail is back in a beautiful blend of charming pixel art characters, 3D environments, and cutting-edge lighting and visual effects!

name: Way of the Hunter
short_description: Become the new owner of a hunting lodge nestled among gorgeous habitats and rich animal populations. Explore vast open world environments and hunt with a premium selection of firearms. Enjoy the perfect hunt on your own or with friends in co-op.

name: School Simulator RPG
short_description: Sara and Kenichi join as college students on Sakura city school academy. Here, they will have their adventure of friendship, love, and mysteries. Play as either a boy or girl in this virtual school simulator to interact with many friends and date a senpai.

name: Brothers - A Tale of Two Sons
short_description: Guide two brothers on an epic fairy tale journey from visionary Swedish film director, Josef Fares and top-tier developer Starbreeze Studios. Control both brothers at once as you experience co-op play in single player mode, like never before.

name: ALaLa: Wake Mi Up!
short_description: 'Wake Mi UP!' is a VR party game which could be played by four people in maximum. There's a sleepy cat called ALaLa who has a magical power bringing everyone into her dream when she falls asleep. This time, it's a HIDE AND SEEK dream in the playing room! Now, let's protect ALaLa's dream!

name: Enemy Remains
short_description: Atmospheric horror shooter, offering a blend of intense action and survival horror.

name: ACL Pro Cornhole
short_description: Immerse yourself in the most realistic Cornhole simulation ever created with accurately motion captured player movement, detailed 3D modeled environment, official ACL bags, and commentary from legendary Cornhole personalities Trey Ryder and Bernie Nabors.

name: ICEY
short_description: ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action game and a META game in disguise. As you follow the narrator's omnipresent voice, you will see through ICEY's eyes and learn the truth about her world. The narrator will constantly urge you in one direction, but you must ask, 'Why? Why am I following his directions?“ Obey? Rebel?

name: ROOM FOOTBALL - Hangar
short_description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

name: Inferno: Deathfield
short_description: After a long time in exile, Lucifer, the King of the Underworld rages again to conquer the Hell. The demons emerge through the door of death and a chosen warrior is destined to seal it once for all and save the mankind from a total abolishment. Be the chosen warrior and save the world!

name: Rumpus
short_description: Rumpus is a live-coding playground for room-scale VR.

name: CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION
short_description: CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- REUNION is a remaster of CRISIS CORE featuring updated graphics, combat systems and soundtrack. Follow the tale of SOLDIER operative Zack Fair, as he discovers the secrets of Shinra's dark experiments.

name: Playcraft
short_description: Playcraft is a multiplayer game-creation sandbox accessible to anyone!

name: ViSP - Virtual Space Port
short_description: ViSP – Virtual Space Port is a creative building game for VR. Construct your own space port out of blocks and defend it against relentless enemies to fortify your space colony!

name: Shelter Manager
short_description: We live in a troubled world. Viruses, military conflicts - you never know what danger the world will face tomorrow. It's time to get ready now! Lead a bunker network and start developing society after a global disaster.

name: SamabakeScramble
short_description: Watch a whole town come alive as characters designed in quite possibly the greatest character creator of all time interact and form—ahem—deep and meaningful relationships! Each exciting development that arises amongst the cast of lifelike characters promises to be more thrilling than the last!

name: ADOM (Ancient Domains Of Mystery)
short_description: ADOM (Ancient Domains Of Mystery) is one of the most successful roguelike games ever created, boasting a brilliant mix of story, RPG, exploration, and intensely strategic & flexible combat. The Steam version adds various features like achievements, difficulty level customization & play modes.

name: NOT ME
short_description: The eight adventurers will explore the mysterious island, but the ship has been damaged by the storm and cannot return. Little did they know that the werewolves on the island had already killed the two adventurers and blended in with the team, playing hide-and-seek with the other humans.

name: Down Fast VR
short_description: Race and freeride across four different locations in Down Fast VR, the ultimate mountain biking game for virtual reality. Compete against players from all around the world and explore the mountain with three different bikes and stunts like whips, 360s, frontflips, and backflips.

name: Disciples: Liberation
short_description: Disciples: Liberation is a mature, dark fantasy strategy RPG with turn-based combat. Liberate the land of Nevendaar and uncover the endless stories hidden within this richly detailed world where every decision has a consequence, and every wrong move could be deadly.

name: Frontier Pilot Simulator
short_description: FPS is a Sci-Fi cargo pilot sim, with an engaging emergent mission-driven storyline, with a real-time economy with free flight and trading, on an alien world to explore. All in customizable upgradeable, well-simulated VTOL craft with real weather, and flight dynamics.

name: ATRIUM
short_description: Create the biggest empire by owning roads and castles without forgetting to attack other players. This builder placement game allow you to evolve your builders to a powerfull army and can be played up to 4 players on the same computer.

name: The Colonists
short_description: Build a new home for your team of robots as they begin a new life for themselves on a distant planet where they can fulfil their ultimate dream: to be human.

name: The Chronicles of Dragon Wing - Reborn
short_description: This is a world in which sword and magic rule, an era of heroes that time will not forget, and a place where glorious victory in battle immortalizes you throughout time, and you are the author. Dragon Wing is for you to write, and write you will! Go, hero! Make it a magnificent and epic chapter!

name: Happy Live,Show Up!
short_description: 荣获颇多奖项的Favorite社新作，《Happylive show up》强势登陆Steam平台！ 身处异乡他国，在伙伴的友情与爱情的帮助下，奏响属于大家的“Happy Live”！

name: ExoCorps
short_description: ExoCorps is Jetpack Powered Exosuit Deathmatch! Prepare for intense aerial dogfights with Lasers and Missile Swarms. Hunt your foes across vast landscapes. Avoid detection by managing heat, then let loose with viscous barrages of cannon-fire, railguns, missile rain and more.

name: ThanksKilling Day
short_description: In this homage to 90's Survival Horror Games and Cinema, you play as a young boy visiting his grandparent's turkey farm for Thanksgiving. When all is not what it seems, as one by one, each family member is murdered by a giant unknown Killer. Run, Hide, Solve Survive!

name: Ancient Amuletor VR
short_description: Ancient Amuletor VR is an action tower defense game that throws you into the ancient world to battle magical creatures, monsters and other legendary foes in single-player and cooperative multiplayer for up to three players.

name: Printer Forge 3D
short_description: 3D Printer Forge allows anyone to quickly and easily build Miniatures for 3D Printing. Fantasy Miniatures, Mechs, Starships and more!

name: COCOON
short_description: From Jeppe Carlsen, the lead gameplay designer of LIMBO and INSIDE — COCOON takes you on an adventure across worlds within worlds. Master world-leaping mechanics and solve intricate puzzles to unravel a cosmic mystery.

name: Trash Goblin
short_description: A wholesome, cosy shopkeeping game with no pressures, no stress, and endless good vibes! Uncover and clean trinkets then upcycle them to sell to endless colourful and quirky customers. Spend your savings to upgrade your shop, buy better tools, plus expand and customise your space.

name: God secret
short_description: It is a deep-sea themed survival game.

name: All-In-One Summer Sports VR
short_description: 10 Summer Sports are waiting for you! Head to a hot tropical island full of sunshine, fun and unforgettable experiences. Create your own character and join the dizzying games with many players around the world! Hone your skills, play and win!

name: GM Forge - Virtual Tabletop
short_description: GM Forge is a Standalone Virtual Tabletop with competitive features, making it a good affordable alternative. When you buy a copy of GM Forge, your friends join you through their web browser without purchasing a copy.

name: Puzzle of Santa Girl VR
short_description: Solve Santa Girl's puzzles and Get the Gifts! There are 3 mini puzzle games(Catch the Santa Girl / Count the Santa Girls / Spot the Differences)!

name: Party Golf
short_description: Party Golf is a crazy and competitive couchplay game for one to eight players. Party Golf combines simple 2D physics, a procedurally generated world and over a trillion different gameplay combinations.

name: GearStorm - Armored Survival
short_description: GearStorm - Armored Survival is a story-driven, open-world sci-fi survival adventure. Discover what led to the Phage, a deadly virus apocalypse and our escape to a alien world. Explore a vast alien planet, build your base, create your colony, acquire vehicles, weapons, and supplies to defend it.

name: Pro Strategy Football 2021
short_description: [NOT THE LATEST VERSION!! See Pro Strategy Football 2022]

name: Genotype
short_description: Your weapons are alive! Print creatures and use them as weapons and tools as you explore this Metroidvania FPS adventure. Morph yourself tiny, upgrade, and locate collectibles to advance to the next boss. Explore large non-linear maps and explore an environment woven together with a complex story.

name: Dreamspring
short_description: Dreamspring is a dark fantasy styled, open world souls-like game. Explore a dying kingdom and it's different realms in first person action combat, styled in a mix of retro and vaporwave aesthetics.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
short_description: Made in a close partnership with Games Workshop, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is a story-rich classical RPG from Owlcat Games, developers of the critically acclaimed game, Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous.

name: The Dwarves of Glistenveld
short_description: The Dwarves of Glistenveld is a Colony Strategy game about clans of dwarves trying to live and expand underground. Help them explore, mine, forage, fight, and build a home in a forgotten underworld! Features a unique blend of traditional RTS and Colony-Sim.

name: STAR OCEAN THE SECOND STORY R
short_description: In this science fantasy RPG, choose between Claude or Rena, play through their perspectives, and unlock various endings. Recruit allies and defeat foes in fast paced real-time battles.

name: Disney Infinity 3.0: Gold Edition
short_description: Enjoy Disney Infinity with a Full Toy Box! Disney Infinity 3.0: Gold Edition includes Star Wars with the existing collection of Marvel and Disney characters and worlds, and NOW with all Characters and Playsets Unlocked. Embark on adventures as big as your imagination in the 3.0 Toy Box!

name: Rasen no Sora
short_description: 'Spiral Universe' 'Space Fleet x Character Game' Battle of Delusion Fleet.

name: AFL 23
short_description: AFL 23 - IT'S TIME TO FLY!! Feel the Atmosphere, Chase your dreams and Make it your own - in the most realistic AFL game ever!

name: Urban Strife
short_description: Old school TBS, post-apoc survival and RPG. Recruit deranged locals in your militia, ally local factions and fight those you hate. Haul loot back and rebuild your shelter, doctor your wounds, and fix your guns. People need feeding, booze needs brewing and there is an end of the world to enjoy.

name: Etrian Odyssey III HD
short_description: Set sail to an undersea labyrinth in search of the Deep City of Armoroad! Lead a party of adventurers to explore the vast dungeon in search of untold technology, treasure, and lost secrets.

name: TEVI
short_description: Embark on an epic action-adventure as you slash, dash, and combo your way through a vast, vibrant world. Explore and uncover hidden secrets. Customize your build to triumph in spectacular boss battles. Experience a tale of mystery, magic, and mayhem in TEVI, a bullet hell metroidvania!

name: Pro Wrestling Sim
short_description: Pro Wrestling Sim is a text-based pro-wrestling booking simulator. Control a wrestling promotion, decide your roster, and create storylines, feuds and matches where the winners and losers are in your hands.

name: Farmagia
short_description: Command an army of monsters in this all-new action game featuring character designs by famed manga artist Hiro Mashima. Take a stand to free the people of Felicidad as a Farmagia named Ten when monster farming, adventure, and hectic battles come together in an epic tale of rebellion and friendship.

name: Apex Point
short_description: Apex Point is an open world game that aims to immerge you into the Japanese car culture by providing a huge variety of customizations and race types so you can choose your own path

name: Carrier Battles 4 Guadalcanal - Pacific War Naval Warfare
short_description: CARRIER BATTLES is a classic hex-and-counter digital wargame covering the naval-air battles of the Pacific War, from 1942 to 1943. Find your opponent and strike at him before he sinks your precious carriers, while preventing them from invading or supporting your own amphibious operations.

name: Thrive: Heavy Lies The Crown
short_description: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown is a complex city builder, where the fate of your kingdom hinges on your every decision. Explore this medieval land alone or with friends, make tough moral choices and conquer your foes in RTS combat. Will you struggle to survive, or find the strength to Thrive?

name: Elven Rivers 2: New Horizons Collector's Edition
short_description: Celene and her brave teammates have already earn a reputation for themselves: this is why they were chosen to be the first group to explore the neighbouring continent of beastmen.

name: Resident Evil 4
short_description: Survival is just the beginning. Six years have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy, one of the survivors, tracks the president's kidnapped daughter to a secluded European village, where there is something terribly wrong with the locals.

name: Project Kuragava
short_description: Project Kuragava is a visual kinetic novel with a thoughtful plot The protagonist Yuki enters Kuragawa Academy, he is the first guy in this academy. Will Yuki be able to change his past and future? Or will he lose this fateful battle?

name: Warsworn: DRAGON OF JAPAN - EMPIRE EDITION
short_description: Warsworn: Dragon of Japan is a real-time grand strategy game, created by a one-man development studio. Players will draft their own clans, compete in high spirit battles, and come up with epic strategies in order to unify Japan.

name: Wanderstop
short_description: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

name: Dialogue: A Writer's Story
short_description: Try out different conversation mechanics – Active, Exploratory or Written – in Dialogue: A Writer's Story. Play as the writer Lucille Hawthorne, exploring characters and events through a year in her life via mostly ordinary, and occasionally fantastical, conversations.

name: The Protagonist: EX-1
short_description: You’re a highly trained soldier on a mission to infiltrate an alien space station that goes horribly wrong—find your team and discover the hidden truth. Upgrade, Craft, and Discover technologies, Enhance your character’s skills in this gripping turn-based tactical RPG.

name: Into the Restless Ruins
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you create the dungeon you fight through. Each night use your cards to expand the ruins then battle through them, harvesting Glimour from the lost souls and improving your deck. Can you reach The Warden and defeat it, so The Maiden will grant your heart’s desire?

name: Stories: The Path of Destinies
short_description: Stories: The Path of Destinies is an Action RPG, an enchanted storybook filled with madcap fantasy tales, each told by a zippy narrator attuned to the player’s choices and actions.

name: AntharioN
short_description: Antharion is an epic old-school fantasy RPG that combines tactical turn-based combat with the freedom of a huge living-breathing open world.

name: Iron Sea Defenders
short_description: Man the guns! The enemy fleet is on the horizon! Defend your fort from attacks – show your tactical skill.

name: Bloodbound: Vampire Hunters
short_description: Bloodbound is a Vampire, Vampire Slayer multiplayer first-person action shooter. Locations are varied and detailed, and each character comes with its own unique weapons and special abilities. Pick a side, squad up, and master a rising roster of fearless characters in this fast-paced bloody FPS.

name: Union of Gnomes
short_description: Onwards to revolution in this challenging deck-building roguelite. Free your gnome comrades, assemble your squad, mind wieners (supplies), slay the slavers, and take down the fiercest of them all – Snow White! FREEDOM TO GNOMES!

name: Exogate Initiative
short_description: Build and manage mankind’s first mission across the universe! Create a sprawling facility underground, recruit a diverse group of specialists from around the globe and explore mysterious new worlds through the Exogate.

name: Infinite Scuba®
short_description: Explore the ocean like a real scuba diver.

name: Ancient Warfare: The Han Dynasty
short_description: Ancient Warfare: The Han Dynasty is a wargame demonstrating ancient warfare in China and combining elements of Big Strategy, RTS and RPG. You can learn little-known stories of heroes in ancient China by experiencing battles accommodating thousands of soldiers.
developers: 不秋草游戏工作室(Bamboo Games)

name: Deity Empires
short_description: Deity Empires is a 4X, turn-based strategy game with a powerful “just one more turn” feel! Enter an intricate fantasy world as one of many deities posed to become ruler of the world.

name: MotorCubs RC
short_description: Survive Monument Valley in RC Cars with Crash Test Teddy Bears. Co-Op and Single Player offline races in 8 tough as nails race tracks, with more on the way!

name: TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-
short_description: The latest title in the 'TGM' series, 'TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-' offers the ultimate Tetris game that no one has ever experienced before. Challenge yourself in new modes such as ASUKA and SHIRANUI.

name: Shogo: Mobile Armor Division
short_description: Shogo is an anime-inspired first-person shooter. Fight on foot or pilot a giant mech in both open and urban levels. You will know the true power of giant robots!

name: Grimoire Groves
short_description: Join the witches in their quest to restore the Grimoire Groves! Master magic, grow cute plant creatures and discover the mystery of the Rainbow Socks in this cozy, rogue-lite dungeon crawler.

name: EDGE OF DAWN
short_description: In EDGE OF DAWN, players will craft, build, and survive in a mountainous winter landscape. Along with threats of hunger, thirst, and exposure to extreme temperatures, players will also need to adapt to the various enemies that inhabit EDGE OF DAWN in order to stay alive.

name: A Plague Tale: Requiem
short_description: Embark on a heartrending journey into a brutal, breathtaking world, and discover the cost of saving those you love in a desperate struggle for survival. Strike from the shadows or unleash hell with a variety of weapons, tools and unearthly powers.

name: Rota's Nautical Chronicles of Trade
short_description: 'City building' and 'Trade' simulation game by Rota, the princess of the forest country! Rota strives to realize her plan for sea trade with the entire world. Let's greatly develop the port town of Portamare through the production, import and export of goods, and business negotiation battles!

name: Real Pharmacy Simulator
short_description: Become the owner of a pharmacy in Real Pharmacy Simulator! Manage the business, serve customers, and balance profit with ethics. Order medicines, organize the space, and decide how to run your business - honestly or riskily. Your decisions will determine the fate of the pharmacy!

name: Dr. Cares - Pet Rescue 911
short_description: Take care of adorable pets and animals, and become a real vet! 🐶 🐱 🐰 🐎

name: Tactics 2: War
short_description: Tactics 2: War.This is a real-time strategy, combined with a shooter of an airplane, a tank, a rocket launcher, a ship and a submarine. Modern warfare.

name: Enigma Sphere :Enhanced Edition
short_description: Introducing the powered-up Enhanced Edition of Enigma Sphere. This Edition is loaded with new game modes and exciting gameplay experiences that will provide gamer satisfaction. Online multiplayer is available along with a world ranking function to allow you to aim to be the world's best.

name: Hatsune Miku - The Planet Of Wonder And Fragments Of Wishes
short_description: Miku and friends crash land on a mysterious planet during their space journey... There they meet many unique characters! Play all kinds of games to grant everybody's wishes!

name: Dragon Is Dead
short_description: Dragon is Dead is a 2D dark fantasy roguelite with hack-and-slash combat and unlockable classes. Build class skill trees, slot runes, and chase Legendary and Mythic loot through corrupted stages.

name: Eternal Strands
short_description: A next-generation action experience where the elements obey you, the terrain bends to your will, and every victory is entirely your own.

name: FILE 9
short_description: FILE 9 built by Alfred Cypress, is one of the Sub Terminal Areas housing several areas within Terminal for Cypress training. Each designed with their own unique features, using everything from stealth, weapons, searching, and sometimes strategy to achieve objectives.

name: HighFleet
short_description: Battle for survival in the skies of a mysterious future Earth in this unique action-strategy game mixing arcade combat, exploration, management and diplomacy. As giant flying ships wage spectacular aerial warfare, a prophecy tells of one who will save the world – could it be you?

name: Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure
short_description: Travel back in time to help defend Hua Mulan against evil time bandits all while learning Chinese in this story-driven, role-playing, open 3D world episodic adventure.

name: Eclipse Edge of Light
short_description: Explore an unknown world. Discover its past. Uncover its mystery. Eclipse is a first-person sci-fi adventure game. After crash-landing on a sentient planet, you awake to find a dreamscape world filled with discovery, wonder and the littered remains of a betrayed civilization.

name: VA Framework - Build Your AI
short_description: VA Framework is a unique personal AI Assistant Development platform for non-programmers. Start building your AI Assistant on top of pre-built plugins and create commands and rich responses visually with flow-based programming.

name: Gold  Challenge
short_description: A gold hunter simulator. Here you can walk around the forest and enjoy the nature, meet different animals and, of course, gather gold.

name: Cyanotype Daydream -The Girl Who Dreamed the World-
short_description: Kaito wakes to find himself in a strange room, with no memories, and a taciturn girl named Yonagi by his side. Upon learning of his role, he immerses himself into three wondrous dream worlds with her. When all three stories meet a bitter end, Kaito recovers his memories, and the true story unfolds.

name: Grisaia Phantom Trigger Vol.8
short_description: At last, an all-out war is at hand. The battle against the religious organization, The Fatal Answer (TFA), has entered its final phase, with CIRS and SORD preparing to send all of their troops into TFA's stronghold.

name: Sore wa Maichiru Sakura no You ni -Re:BIRTH-
short_description: 《繁花落舞恋如樱 -Re:BIRTH-》由日本美少女游戏资深大厂Navel制作，是早在22年前就已成为广受赞誉的经典名作的重制版。本作由西又葵担当原画与角色设计；由创作了《我们没有翅膀》、《近月少女的礼仪》等话题名作的剧本家王雀孙主笔。桃山伊音、夏和小、九条信乃等知名声优为本作女主角献声。

name: Binky show
short_description: Study Binky’s behavior. Fight his minions. Defeat the Clown and save River-Road!

name: PAW Patrol World
short_description: Explore the world of PAW Patrol like never before and stop Mayor Humdinger’s super blimp mayhem, in a free-roaming 3D adventure full of pup-tastic fun!

name: Viola: The Heroine's Melody
short_description: Viola: The Heroine's Melody is the musical Platformer/RPG! After failing at violin practice for the hundredth time, Viola becomes trapped inside her instrument's fantastical world. Join her adventure to find her way back home, aided by the diverse ensemble of friends she meets along the way.

name: Plank not included
short_description: One of the BEST experience for your VR parties and for newcomers that have never tried virtual reality before. Plank not included is a virtual reality (walk the plank) experience. You will experience acrophobia (fear of height) Now you can choose between the plank and the tightrope experience.

name: Monomyth
short_description: MONOMYTH is an immersive, first-person dungeon-crawling RPG inspired by the genre's late classics. Embark on a journey through a vast and highly interactive game world as you unravel the mysteries hidden beneath the ancient fortress of Lysandria.

name: Taurus War
short_description: Taurus War is a Sci-Fi turn-based strategy game.Solemn promise: We will update this game for 10 years!

name: MEGATON MUSASHI W: WIRED
short_description: Launch a counteroffensive to take back the Earth from alien invaders in this mecha action RPG.

name: Tower Factory
short_description: Tower Factory is a tower defense and automation game with roguelite elements. Optimize resource production using conveyor systems while defending against monster waves. Can you find and destroy the enemy tower before it's too late?

name: Laysara: Summit Kingdom
short_description: Build and expand your very own settlements in high mountains! Carefully plan production chains and satisfy various needs of your three-caste society while dealing with mountain hazards such as weather breakdowns and avalanches. Are you skilled enough to make your town thrive?

name: Seed of Heroes
short_description: Journey through the realms with your heroes party. Defeat hordes of enemies in a bullet heaven and reach Valhalla where you belong.

name: Curse of Blood
short_description: This is a game about survival and betrayal. Ten explorers ventured to the corrupted land to prevent the arrival of the Blood Moon. The bad news is that there are werewolves and vampires mixed in.

name: DanielX.net Paint Composer
short_description: Create beautiful music simply and easily! Save your compositions and share them with friends and the world. Interesting characters are fun for both kids and adults. The musical staff is welcoming, you can leverage your existing knowledge of music or expand it through experimentation. Enjoy!

name: Criminal Bundle
short_description: Criminal Bundle is a first person shooter online multiplayer with low poly esthetic. Shoot other players while trying to open the safe or prevent criminals from run away with the money.

name: ZOMBIE RAID: No One Survives
short_description: Join the fight for survival in a top-down shooter with realistic-looking combat. Raid the infected city and fight for survival in team battles.

name: ! Wild Russia !
short_description: «Wild Russia» is an open-world horror adventure game. Its action takes place in a striking provincial Russia, and any of your actions or inaction can lead to serious consequences.

name: No Clue VR
short_description: Spot the difference in VR, you are part of the picture this time.

name: Holomento
short_description: Holomento is an Indie Permadeath Action-RPG focusing on the dangerous quest of passing through the mysterious Eventide Hollow – and rebuilding it step by step.

name: Princesses Never Lose!
short_description: Play as Erica, princess of the Tolinia Kingdom, as she fights to unify the Stivale Peninsula against a powerful, modernized country, that threatens to undermine the peninsula's sovereignty.

name: Little Busters! English Edition
short_description: Capturing the hearts of countless fans since 2007, Little Busters! is an emotional visual novel from Key, the minds behind Angel Beats! and CLANNAD. This special English release supports touch controls and dynamic switching between English and Japanese text, and is in HD for the first time on PC.

name: ReDertsy
short_description: The protagonist is stranded in an enigmatic realm, and it's your task to aid them in navigating through the intricacies of time. Rescue our hero by gathering the maximum number of eggs!

name: Carmen Sandiego
short_description: The scarlet super thief Carmen Sandiego is back! Adorn Carmen’s signature red hat and play as the vigilante herself to navigate a world of espionage, utilizing high-tech gadgets, and ultimately capturing VILE.

name: Monkey Barrels
short_description: Monkey Barrels is an action-packed twin-stick shooter in which you blast waves of weaponized electronic devices with tons of crazy unlockable weapons. You can experiment endlessly with different combinations and find the loadout that best suits your playing style.

name: Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade
short_description: Defeat malevolent forces in this stunning Japanese-inspired roguelite world! Become a master of the Demon Blades and combat swarms of demons in a fantasy realm set in the Edo period. Through every journey, you will unveil the hidden truths concealed within troubled times.

name: VEGAS Pro 18 Edit Steam Edition
short_description: VEGAS Pro 18 Edit – Steam Edition is a powerhouse of tools for creating Let's Plays and includes a screen capturing tool, truly mind-blowing special effects, intuitive operation and ultra-efficient workflows.

name: Heroes Never Die
short_description: Heroes Never Die is a Next-Gen VR shooting game designed by Frostbite Games. Not as other shooting games, players should save ammo and time. Try to find time bonus and possible strategy to achieve high score. Many heroes can be used and every stage is worth to explore.

name: Mahou Arms
short_description: Mahou Arms is an anime-inspired character-action hack and slash that tells the story of a magical girl paramilitary group fighting back against an alien invasion.

name: FWsim - Fireworks Display Simulator
short_description: Light the sky and express your creativity with the sandbox simulator FWsim – Fireworks Display Simulator! Enjoy an easy-to-master professional software used by fireworks experts all over the world, and use your favorite music and 3D iconic landmarks to create unique, unforgettable moments.

name: Jardinains!
short_description: The world's favorite brick-breaking, 'nain-bouncing game is back!

name: At Dead Of Night
short_description: At Dead Of Night is part horror film, part horror game and part ghost hunt. It blends live-action and graphics to create a unique immersive horror experience like no other.

name: Project AETHER: First Contact
short_description: As a threat from beyond looms over the solar system, take control of the AETHER prototype in this rhythmic and tactical space shooter - fusing classic arcade-style action with stunning 3D environments and an engaging sci-fi story.

name: Unsung Story
short_description: Unsung Story is a spiritual successor to Final Fantasy Tactics that takes place in a world where spells are cast as songs and a 77-year war has damaged the foundations of magic. Build a team to work backwards in time from the final battle to find a way to save Lasfaria.

name: Exo TD
short_description: Exo TD is a true 3D space Tower Defense. Invaders have scouted your planet as their next target, you must protect it by building destructive turrets, orbital defenses, shields, drones and more to defend against the incoming invasion force.
171 is an open world action adventure game with a Brazilian inspired ambience.

name: Seals of the Bygone
short_description: Class based survival roguelike! Void monsters sealed away for eons are awakening across the land! Pick a Sealer and put an end to the chaos!

name: Apocalypse Run!
short_description: Apocalypse Run... Apocalypse Fun! A Roguelike-Strategy-RPG with guitars and cats, and lots of car battles— and very little Florida.

name: WitchSpring R
short_description: WitchSpring R is a story-driven RPG combining elements of collecting, simulation, and battling. Experience the joy of training a young witch and accompany her on a grand adventure!

name: Tryst
short_description: Tryst is a competitive Real Time Strategy Game that provides a unique, fast paced spin to the established strategy model.

name: Cringegolf
short_description: If you think playing golf is easy, then try playing Cringegolf! Your nerves will be tested, and your composure will be questioned.

name: Riviera: The Promised Land
short_description: The long-awaited 'Riviera: The Promised Land' is back with many added features for easier play! The story unfolds like flipping through a picture book with various variations of music color the adventure. Let's set out on the journey to protect Riviera from the devastation of the 'The Retribution.'

name: Creatures of Ava
short_description: Let your empathy guide you as you play an exciting action-adventure, creature-saver game. Understand and tame the creatures of Ava and let them lead you through a variety of ecosystems – all in the hopes of saving the planet from a life-consuming infection.

name: Touch Type Tale - Strategic Typing
short_description: Touch Type Tale is the strategy game you control by typing! Join a brave new era of strategy — tactical typing. Use a satisfying mesh of mechanics across a range of surprising challenges, with storybook campaigning and online play. You are Paul. (Hi there.) And the keyboard to the kingdom is yours.

name: Helle's Undersea City Project - Bringing Air to The Garden
short_description: Helle's Undersea City Project - Bringing Air to The Garden - Grow and expand the land with air, aiming to rebuild the undersea city with a lone girl, Hele! A new type of undersea city-building simulation game!

name: NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS
short_description: Legendary ninjas reunite in the next exciting entry of the STORM series! NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS is an action/fighting game with fast-paced ninja battles and two different story modes.

name: METAL GEAR SURVIVE
short_description: METAL GEAR SURVIVE builds upon MGSV’s stealth action gameplay with elements of exploration and survival creating a bold new experience. *An internet connection is required to play the game.

name: Bionite: Origins
short_description: Bionite: Origins is a Tactical Shooter game based on vehicles. The game uses a combination of Aircraft and Tank physics to produce a unique gaming experience based on hover propulsion. Players can command pilots and build bases in 1 vs 1 team games or with up to 8 other players.

name: Shadow Falls
short_description: Shadow Falls is a first-person horror game, where you explore a mysterious farmhouse deep in the forest, solving eerie puzzles and uncovering secrets that reveal the thin veil between the world of the living and the dead. Delve deeper and uncover the sinister forces that led you here.

name: Wulin Chess
short_description: Wulin Chess is a turn-based strategy game set in a captivating dark fantasy world. Employ diverse characters across various boards/battlefields, and devise strategic thinking for victory. Strengthen your heroes by collecting equipment and enhancing attributes to face the challenges that lie ahead.

name: Cube Universe
short_description: Cube Universe is a first-person voxel RPG. Visit many different, procedurally generated planets. Team up with your friends to fight against fierce enemies in dungeons. Do quests to save the world from the forces of evil - or throw it into chaos.

name: Cold Blooded
short_description: Cold Blooded is a gripping third-person action survival horror game that lets players take the role of Amy, a determined and highly resourceful skilled fighter, who must battle for her life against an alien invasion taking over the planet.

name: Aerofly FS 4 Flight Simulator
short_description: We promise you will feel like a pilot flying airliners, helicopters, fighters, gliders, historical and aerobatic aircraft in a photorealistic world! Over 10,000 real world flights, highly detailed cockpits and scenery are awaiting you.

name: The Morrigan
short_description: Step into this world of beautiful stylised graphics and explore striking, handcrafted environments - torch in one hand, big axe in the other. Built exclusively for VR.

name: Skyborn
short_description: Life under the iron rule of the winged Skyborn race isn’t so bad for Claret Spencer, the star mechanic of a successful airship repair shop, present her with broken machinery and she’s sure to fix it. She’s one of the fortunate ones, not all who live under the watchful eye of the Skyborn are so lucky…Little does she know that her stable,...

name: Chess
short_description: The classic strategy game with gorgeous graphics, online gaming and intuitive interface.

name: Barbarous - Tavern Of Emyr
short_description: As a fantasy world innkeeper, face the problems of a prematurely retired hero!

name: SHMUP Creator
short_description: SHMUP Creator allows you to make the Shoot 'em up of your dreams! As fun as a game, it is very simple but powerful enough to make professional Shmups. Place your enemies with the mouse, create your bullet patterns, press a button to play, then share your games with your friends!

name: Out Of Hands
short_description: Out of Hands is a bizarre card-based adventure game that blends video-collage graphics with gripping psychological horror. Will you seek the truth lurking in this wicked, warped world—and can you bear its weight? Misty memories threaten to tear you apart, contorting you into a being... Out of Hands.

name: Atomfall
short_description: A nuclear disaster has left an area of Britain in tatters. Atomfall, a new survival-action game, will see you explore, scavenge, craft, barter and fight your way through beautifully recreated scenery in search of answers.

name: Park Studio
short_description: Create the parks of your dreams in Park Studio! Construct amazing structures, build thrilling rides and decorate your park with an unprecedented level of detail and unmatched realism! What are you waiting for? Get creative!

name: Verdant Skies
short_description: Verdant Skies is a life simulation game born from a love for games like Harvest Moon and a desire to create something unique with modern gameplay and deep storytelling. Ensure the success of the colony as you make friends and pursue romance with a diverse cast of characters.

name: Pylon: Rogue
short_description: Take all of the combat of an Action-RPG and cram it into a non-stop action game with RPG character progression, add a bit of satire, and just one life to make it to the end, and that’s Pylon: Rogue.

name: Lightspeed Frontier
short_description: Leave everything behind and try your hand at captaining a ship on the fringes of the universe. Customize your ship, explore vast star systems, invest in corporations, and embark on expeditions discovering fame and fortune within Lightspeed Frontier!

name: Hologram
short_description: Hologram is a third-person shooter that takes place in the middle of the war of realities. In a world beyond the past and the future, transformed by illusion, evolve and overcome rapidly changing battlefields with time manipulation abilities.

name: The Riftbreaker
short_description: The Riftbreaker is a solo or Co-op base-building, survival game with Action-RPG elements for up to 4 players. Hack & slash countless hordes of enemies. Build up your base, craft powerful weapons and research new inventions to survive.

name: Mediterranean Assault: 1943
short_description: Delivering Hectic firefights, Mediterranean Assault: 1943 takes players across some of Italy and Africa's forgotten fronts.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria™
short_description: A survival crafting adventure set in the Fourth Age of Middle-earth. Lead the Dwarves to reclaim Moria - mine, build, and battle through procedurally generated depths alone or with up to 8 players in co-op. It is time to return to Moria!

name: Ravenlok: Legendary Edition
short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey in Ravenlok, an action-packed fairytale adventure about a young heroine destined to fulfill a perilous prophecy.

name: Anceder
short_description: Dive in the VR arcade shoot-them-up (shmup, shoot'em up, bullet hell). A lot of action is awaiting you. 'Insert coin' and jump in the shmup !

name: Subaeria
short_description: Subaeria is an intense action puzzler where players use their wits to manipulate their enemies into destroying each other.

name: Star Wars Outlaws
short_description: Experience the first-ever open world Star Wars™ game and explore distinct locations across the galaxy, both iconic and new. Risk it all as scoundrel Kay Vess, seeking freedom and the means to start a new life.

name: Dadish Collection
short_description: He's a dad AND a radish! Join Dadish on his quest to rescue his missing kids in three classic platforming adventures. Dadish Collection combines Dadish, Dadish 2 and Dadish 3 in one rad package.

name: Aquarelle
short_description: Aquarelle is a surreal adventure with parkour elements, where you have to find a way out of the virtual space into which its creator D-504 fell.

name: Tabletop Warriors
short_description: Tabletop Warriors is an immersive, multiplayer VR experience in the tradition of a tabletop dungeon crawling adventure. Players transform into figurines on the table and must navigate dynamically generated dungeons under the ever watchful eye of the game master.

name: Son of Nor
short_description: The World is Your Weapon in Son of Nor, a third-person action-adventure! Alter the environment with your terraforming abilities, use telekinetic powers to bend the dynamic surroundings to your will and cast powerful elemental spells that can be combined to wreak havoc on your enemies!

name: Roots of Pacha
short_description: The charming and relaxing stone-age farming sim where you live in a thriving community exploring the wonderful world of Pacha. Discover 'ideas,' domesticate crops, befriend animals, and help your village grow. Play co-op with friends or explore the early days of civilization in single-player.

name: Power & Revolution 2023 Edition
short_description: The latest edition of the ultrarealistic world simulator where you play as the Head of State or as the opposition! New Additions: dive deeper into the war in the Ukraine with artillery, trenches, mines, troop morale, etc; detailed immigration management; the justice system; and children.

name: Dr. Cares - Amy's Pet Clinic
short_description: Get ready to test your vet skills in Dr. Cares - Amy's Pet Clinic!

name: VRM Dance Dream MV
short_description: VRM Dance Dream MV lets you easily create pro-quality dance MVs. Just mix avatars, dances, music, stages, and effects! Supports models posted on VRoid Hub, plus VRM, BVH, FBX, and VMD formats. Auto camera work and effects make creation fast and stunning!

name: ROGAN: The Thief in the Castle
short_description: ROGAN: The Thief in the Castle is a VR adventure game.Players experience the thrilling life of a thief who has sneaked into a medieval castle full of guards. You will require cunning to survive and make your way through the castle as you use everything a thief has at their disposal: pickpocketing, stealing, hiding, creating distractions,...

name: NeverBound
short_description: NeverBound is the gravity-shifting shooter that brings you mind-bending combat and puzzles in multi-gravity environments. You are as dangerous from below as you are from above. The rules have changed. High ground is relative.

name: Parker & Lane: Criminal Justice
short_description: Are you ready to solve the case and bring a criminal to justice?

name: Kabounce
short_description: Kabounce™ is the multiplayer pinball sport game where you are the ball. Experience fast-paced online arena combat, rack up combos and points and score to win. Take the action offline with single player time-attack parkour modes!

name: Edepth Angel: Pinocchio's Murder
short_description: Which memory is true, which is false? Listen to the cyborg family's stories to help resolve a cold case without getting killed.

name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist
short_description: Decades after the events of ENDER LILIES, Homunculi — sorrowful, artificial life forms — roam the land. In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?

name: The Monstrous Horror Show
short_description: Four girls find their way into an abandoned hospital, each for her own reasons. Will they manage to unravel the dark secrets hiding within, escape safely, and return to their normal, peaceful lives?

name: Charging Out Dead Zone
short_description: This is a zombie car parkour game. The pace of the game is very tight. The goal of the game is to score as many points as possible. .

name: Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of DANA
short_description: Ys returns with a brand new adventure for the first time in 8 years! Adol awakens shipwrecked and stranded on a cursed island. There, he and the other shipwrecked passengers he rescues form a village to challenge fearsome beasts and mysterious ruins on the isolated island.

name: Game Designer & Maker
short_description: Game Designer & Maker is a cross-platform 2D game development software aimed at independent game makers. It doesn't require coding skills. You can export(permanent function) the finished games as executable files for PC, Mac and Android, and you own 100% of the copyright.

name: UNDERDOGS
short_description: UNDERGROUND MECH FIGHTS! Wrap yourself in 5 tons of metal & go smashing through a dark scene of full-on metal-on-metal violence!

name: Push For Emor
short_description: Push For Emor is an open world(s) SciFi FPS RPG with light RTS building elements thrown in for good measure. Fight your way across 11 planets, engage in space combat, disable enemy craft and board enemy wrecks, explore abandoned space stations and defeat evil planet governors.

name: Blacktop Hoops
short_description: Blacktop Hoops is the ultimate VR basketball game and sports experience. Embark on a hoops journey in career mode, ball against bots, hang out with friends in online courts, or climb the rankings in competitive pickup games. Do you have what it takes to become the GOAT?

name: Experiment Gone Rogue
short_description: In a dystopian future, an alien race, known as the Cirinians, rules over Earth and is building an army of genetically altered humans. Step into the shoes of an escaped experiment and wreak havoc across the facility in which you were created against your will.

name: Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage
short_description: Popular vertically scrolling shoot'em up game Shikhondo is back and powered up! One day, the soul-starved Youkai escape from the depths of hell. Now, the story of the Grim Reaper and the girl who has fallen into this land begins!

name: F1® Manager 2023
short_description: The intense world of Formula 1® comes alive for a new season in F1® Manager 2023. 23 races, six F1® Sprint events, new cars, new circuits including the Las Vegas Strip Circuit, new drivers, new challenges… Your legacy begins here.

name: METAL GEAR SOLID V: THE PHANTOM PAIN
short_description: Ushering in a new era for the METAL GEAR franchise with cutting-edge technology powered by the Fox Engine, METAL GEAR SOLID V: The Phantom Pain, will provide players a first-rate gaming experience as they are offered tactical freedom to carry out open-world missions.

name: Pocket Universe : Create Your Community
short_description: Prepare for a brand new adventure in Pocket Universe, a game which combines adored mechanics from strategy and RPG genres. Our vision is an experience which does not solely revolve around the player, but also the world itself which is inhabited by artificially intelligent agents.

name: No Rest for the Wicked
short_description: From Moon Studios, the award-winning developers of Ori and the Blind Forest and Ori and the Will of the Wisps comes No Rest for the Wicked, a visceral, precision Action RPG set to reinvent the genre.

name: Crocotile 3D
short_description: Crocotile 3D is a tile-based 3d modeling application. A great tool for creating lowpoly models and scenes with pixel-art textures. Select tiles directly from tilesets and place them into a scene to give them a third dimension. Use various tools to edit your tiles and shape your models.

name: Sin and Love
short_description: 'Sin and Love' is a dark narrative roguelike game with a background set in a fantastical version of the Tang Dynasty. You will play as a princess from the ‘Stone’ Kingdom, who has been poisoned and rises from the ashes.

name: True Love
short_description: If you are looking for the True Love... Here you go xd

name: SNWBRD: Freestyle Snowboarding
short_description: SNWBRD - Is a Snowboard Game like AMPED and inspired by the AMPED Original Xbox Game, an action-packed, open-world snowboarding game that lets players experience the thrill and freedom of shredding the slopes.

name: The Solus Project
short_description: The Solus Project is a single player exploration adventure with survival elements. The adventure is set on a mysterious planet and is the spiritual successor to The Ball - 2010 PC Gamer Action/Adventure Game Of The Year...

name: Gerty
short_description: In fully destructible terrains, carve your own path in a new rogue-lite that focuses on challenging combat. Dive into the deep tunnels of a mining colony on your own, or in local co-op with up to 4 players. Purchase gear, level up your character, and gain powerful perks to eliminate the alien horde.

name: Monaco 2
short_description: Get your crew back together for the ultimate heist experience! Return to Monaco, plan your operation, and skedaddle when things inevitably go awry in this co-op heist game. The city is yours for the taking!

name: N3Rally
short_description: 'N3Rally' combines a charming aesthetic with intense racing action. Drive a range of vehicles, from production cars to rally cars, and master various terrains such as tarmac, gravel, and snow!

name: Summa Expeditionis
short_description: Summa Expeditionis is a survival and strategy game set in ancient Roman Empire. Follow the career of a Roman soldier from Legionnaire to Centurion. Build and manage your camp, recruit more soldiers and face the barbarians for the glory of Rome.

name: SGS Halls of Montezuma
short_description: Halls of Montezuma recreates the Mexican-American war of 1846-1848. Play the USA and conquer Mexico City before Whig opposition in Congress forces a negotiated peace. As Mexico, hold desperately against the enemy’s onslaught, to gain enough time for America's internal politics to end the war.

name: Nine-Tailed Okitsune Tale
short_description: Fluffy x Kawaii! A Japanese-style action RPG where the character changes into various forms to solve anomalies that occur in the capital!

name: Bohemian Killing
short_description: Paris, 1894. Class differences and pervasive racism finally lead to a tragedy. A year later you find yourself on trial, accused of a brutal murder. How far will you go to exonerate yourself? Will you lie? Manipulate the evidence? Frame others? Act insane? Confess? Your imagination is the limit.

name: Requiem
short_description: Slash enemies, morph into beast form, and raise the dead to fight for you in this grim-dark souls-like.

name: Pro Show Jumping
short_description: Experience the world of professional show jumping with this simulation-based game! Ride through realistic jumping courses with a variety of horses, refine your eye for strides, design your very own courses and share them with friends.

name: Blade Ballet
short_description: Blade Ballet is a whirling dance of multiplayer robot destruction. Each character possesses a unique personality and special abilities - use them to claim victory as you spin from one challenging arena to the next, battling for dominance in this action-packed fighting game.

name: Crystarise
short_description: Explore a vast world, create your own sky island, the island gives the girl the power. An open world-action RPG that you create more and more and become stronger and stronger.

name: Aokana - Four Rhythms Across the Blue
short_description: In a world where flying through the sky is as simple as riding a bicycle, the sport 'Flying Circus' is all the rage. Following the discovery of anti-gravitons, special shoes that allow an individual to fly, Anti-Graviton Shoes, took the world by storm.

name: The Rogue Prince of Persia
short_description: In this challenging, fast-paced roguelite, every death is a unique chance to rewrite fate, save Persia or die trying. Master fluid, acrobatic combat and parkour as you explore your kingdom to right your wrongs!

name: Heliopolis Six
short_description: Embark on a cosmic odyssey as the director of your own space station in a galaxy full of wonders. Skillful management is vital as you construct and connect station components, oversee resource handling, and guide your space haven to reach new heights amidst the stars.

name: DYNABLASTER
short_description: Having been a blockbuster, DYNABLASTER® is a game for the strategic thinker whose smart tactics will instill fear in his competitors – playing online or local against others or against the computer. In this captivating action game, destroy your enemies with cleverly placed bombs.

name: Dead Hook
short_description: Dead Hook is an explosive mix of rogue-like and shooter genre with brutal combat and captivating storytelling. Explore the elder planet Resaract and take on the role of Adam Stone, a mercenary, smuggler, thief, and devoted husband.

name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure
short_description: When Max Caulfield finds her friend Safi dead in the snow, she tears open the way to a parallel timeline. Here, Safi is still alive - and still in danger! With her new power to Shift between two timelines – can Max solve and prevent the same murder?

name: Boxing Apocalypse
short_description: You are the world’s best assassin, locked up on a space prison taken over by aliens beginning human testing, and waging war on mankind. For sport, aliens watch inmates battle to the death. Players must use their boxing skills to fight for freedom, the winner stays alive to see another day.

name: Mashinky
short_description: Mashinky is a transport strategy game about trains. The goal is to create your own transport empire on a procedurally generated map. It’s a unique blend of realistic graphics combined with an isometric construction mode and board game-like rules.

name: Emergency Crew 2 Global Warming
short_description: Hurricanes are raging in Sunland! Once again, Stephen Shepard leads an Emergency Crew to help people in their hour of need and get to the bottom of what's going on.

name: Neptunia Riders VS Dogoos
short_description: Goddesses go full throttle to exhaust the Gigodtic Dogoo!

name: Genesis of a Small God
short_description: You have awoken as a small god. As you accumulate the faith and souls of your followers, you will learn incredible new abilities. Protect, guide your people and smite any threats that may arise. The fate of your world is in your hands.

name: Pit Blocks 3D
short_description: Pit Blocks 3D is a cube-matching arcade style puzzle game where you manipulate falling bricks of different shapes and sizes. The goal is to stay alive as the speed increases over time – and to rack up as many points as possible before the pit fills up with bricks!

name: Don't Bleed
short_description: Don’t Bleed is a high tension Third-Person Shooter game. Face off against up to 15 players to escape while avoiding deadly Leechers.

name: Archaeology - Egypt
short_description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

name: Builderment
short_description: Builderment is a casual factory builder, where you are sent to far away planets to keep Earth going with fresh resources. Establish your base, then mine, build, transport, and ultimately design an automated operation that will save your home one shipment at a time!

name: Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries
short_description: In 1921, young French artist Jennifer Chevalier becomes embroiled in death, espionage and revolution, assisted by the ghost of Oscar Wilde. A hand-drawn Point & Click adventure with a unique comic book inventory design.

name: MarisaLand Legacy
short_description: Twilight Frontier's latest release is here! A Touhou Project inspired work: 'MarisaLand Legacy' Eat mushrooms to increase your height in this easy to control 2D side scrolling action game! But it's not only her height which has changed, the number of players too! Marisa's adventure starts once more...!!

name: On The Road - The Truck Simulator
short_description: From 18 tonners to the Gigaliner, ON THE ROAD – The Truck Simulator offers everything a trucker’s heart desires.

name: STAND OUT VR : VR Battle Royale
short_description: Kill, build, drive, do parkour, fly, make friends, eat... Compete to be the last man alive on huge islands filled with deadly weapons and vehicles. Play the way you want, this is Battle Royale.

name: Last Remains
short_description: 'Last Remains' is a highly challenging multiplayer zombie survival game. Players must survive in a city overrun by the undead, scavenging for food, arming themselves, avoiding zombies, searching for loot, plundering other survivors, and finding any possible way to escape.

name: Timore Redo
short_description: Timore Redo is a psychological horror game about sadness.

name: Lords of Solgrund
short_description: Lords of Solgrund combines elements of real time strategy, city building and other unique additions. The game features detailed animations, complex gameplay systems inspired by the early middle ages and elements of fantasy.

name: Arcane Arts Academy
short_description: Join Erika during her first year at the Arcane Arts Academy!

name: Red Fury
short_description: Fast paced arcade action where you become stronger as you are covered in the blood of your enemies and your own wounds.

name: Harukuru. - Spring has come true? -
short_description: A Certain Situation. Of course, even if I put it that way there’s no way I can explain the situation I’m in… Thus is the start of a story unlike any other about a guy and 4 girls and the daily life they find themselves in.

name: Machines At War 3
short_description: Real time strategy game featuring over 130 different types of units and technologies, 21 campaign missions with characters and an intriguing story, unlimited random map skirmishes with many customizable settings, network multiplayer to challenge your friends, and so much more in this RTS!

name: Solium Infernum
short_description: Take the Infernal Throne in this hellish turn-based grand strategy game. The Prince of Darkness has vanished, leaving Archfiends to conspire: muster your legions while intoning dark sorceries, devilish schemes, and machiavellian plots. Who will be the new ruler of Hell and ascend the Throne?

name: Casino Tycoon Simulator
short_description: Upgrade your casino and become millionaire! Manage your Slots, BlackJacks, Roullettes, and many more. Protect your casino against thieves and cheaters.Want more? jump into mining market or build your dream nightclub!

name: Oure
short_description: Take flight in a dream-like cloudscape as you seek to reawaken the relics of a lost civilisation. As a unique child born with the powers of the ancient dragons, your parents cast you from the stricken surface into the land above the skies.

name: Production Inc.
short_description: Production Inc. is a 2D puzzle game where you can make a production line to manufacture objects in any shape you want. You will be running a factory whilst trying not to go bankrupt. At the end of the week you will have to pay the debt.

name: High Spirits
short_description: Drink potions while you banish ancient spirits and recover your memories of the night before. In this RPG you'll recruit dysfunctional companions, collect strange ingredients, and concoct wicked brews.

name: TaleSpire
short_description: TaleSpire is a beautiful way to play pen and paper RPGs online. Bring your stories to life and embark upon campaigns together with your friends, regardless of where you are in the world.

name: Spykebots
short_description: Volleyball meets full contact football, grab your friends and choose your bot for a highly addictive and competitive smash fest. A futuristic Sports-Action game, Spykebots immerses the players into a high octane match-up where they must smash, pass, and spike if they’re to come out on top.

name: inVokeR
short_description: Experience arcane one-on-one wizard battles designed for VR in inVokeR. Cast earth-shattering spells to turn the tide of battle. Command the elements to defeat monstrous enemies, and compete against your friends in intense, strategic showdowns fueled by magic.

name: Anno 1800
short_description: Anno 1800™ – Lead the Industrial Revolution! Welcome to the dawn of the Industrial Age. The path you choose will define your world. Are you an innovator or an exploiter? A conqueror or a liberator? How the world remembers your name is up to you.

name: Ys: Memories of Celceta
short_description: World-famous red-haired adventurer Adol Christin awakens in the unfamiliar land of Celceta, remembering nothing more than his name. Join Adol and his new friends as he embarks on an adventure to map the wilderness and reclaim his memories in this beloved action RPG from Nihon Falcom.

name: Office Life
short_description: Dive into a massive 2-million-word immersive life sim. Use card-based strategies to survive office politics, rise from a rookie intern to a business tycoon, and find true love. Career, Romance, Wealth—why choose when you can have it all?

name: Dragon Banner
short_description: Dragon Banner is a new mix of strategy and base-building. It is built from the love of building blocks and real-time strategy games. Discover the fate of dragons and start the resistance against the Skull Queen and her army of skeleton warriors!

name: Power Sink
short_description: Descend into the ruins of a submerged power plant, where flickering lights and corroded machinery guard long-buried secrets. Restore power, uncover the past, and navigate the depths—but beware what lurks below.

name: Floating Islands of Nucifera
short_description: Floating Islands of Nucifera is an open world shop keep game set in an abandoned world in the sky. Adventure across the fantasy world of Nucifera in your airship, summon powerful creatures to your side to aid in dangerous turn-based combat, and loot treasures to help pay off your family's debt!

name: Astral Ascent
short_description: Choose one of four heroes and explore the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful mystical bosses: the Zodiacs. Challenge them with dozens of unique spells and faithful friends by your side to unfold the story of this platform roguelite with lightning fast combat.

name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2
short_description: The sequel to the captivating tale of Fuga: Melodies of Steel has arrived! This turn-based RPG is back with a ramped up battle system for more strategy, as well as a brand new event system that gives you more thrilling choices to affect your experience!

name: Constructor
short_description: You can’t rise to the top without taking a few others down. If that means engaging in a workplace accidents, dodgy deals, and a shifty trick or two then so be it! You're going to need every trick in the book if you want to go from small-time slumlord to property tycoon!

name: Immortal Heritage
short_description: A 3D RPG !

name: Pluto's Island
short_description: Artsy and super weird action adventure RPG with roguelike sauce(elements) on top. Inspired by 90's RPG's, comics, and cartoons. Made by one human.

name: Mercenaries Wings: The False Phoenix
short_description: “Mercenaries Wings” is a tactical simulation RPG where you level up, equip and command a group of mercenaries to fight through the stages. Character design is by the illustrator Raita Kazama, who has spared no effort in detail to make each character expressive and alive.

name: Shadows of Doubt
