short_description: Genetic Disaster is a coop action game based around absurd guns, crazy characters and instant fun with procedurally generated levels for endless hours of accidental friendly fire in multiplayer!

name: Target React Force
short_description: Target React Force is a realistic tactical VR experience where you can Train, Plan and Execute your ideas, with gameplay focused on randomisation and replayability. Use your tactical skills to navigate through the Live Scenarios and Training layouts to neutralise the targets and save the hostages.

name: Takelings House Party
short_description: A frantic and whimsical local multiplayer party game for VR. Takelings have invaded this quiet suburban home and it's up to Hal to exterminate these pests using whatever means necessary! Up to 8 players hide, sneak, attack and cause chaos against 1 VR player in a variety of asymmetric minigames

name: GreedFall II: The Dying World
short_description: Dive back into the unique world of GreedFall again in an even deeper RPG experience. Uprooted from the island of your birth, find your freedom, explore the old continent and forge your destiny through alliances, scheming and battles!

name: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? ~Fullland of Water and Light~
short_description: One fateful day, without any warning, the labyrinthine city of Orario was transformed. In the sunken Orario, Bell and his group follow the trail of the characters as dictated in the heroic tale.

name: Starshifter
short_description: Starshifter is a game about shapeshifting, desert animals, and finding your place.

name: Shadow Gangs
short_description: Shadow Gangs is an arcade style ninja action game. Live The Legend Of Dan The Crimson Ninja.

name: Adventure Game
short_description: A VR adventure game: explore dungeons, fight monsters, and solve puzzles to uncover the mysteries of a strange island

name: Divilixa
short_description: Divilixa is a game about strife, sacrifice and insanity. Take the war down into the core of the underworld. Fight the darkness. Be the saviour.

name: Forever World Cup Simulator
short_description: Simulate over 40 events, including the World Cup and continental cups. Enjoy high replayability with 220+ national teams evolving dynamically over the years. Use powerful in-game editors to create new teams and edit tournament formats, while tracking detailed statistics for every team and event!

name: NEOGEO POCKET COLOR SELECTION Vol. 1 Steam Edition
short_description: Retro game fans rejoice! NEOGEO POCKET COLOR SELECTION VOL.1 Steam Edition is SNK's legendary handheld console dream collection, containing 10 handheld defining classics, is coming to Steam!

name: The Doors of Trithius
short_description: The Doors of Trithius is an open-world RPG roguelike. Engage in tactical turn-based combat in a living world of warring factions, wandering behemoths, and ancient magic. Level your skills, cook, craft, and explore dungeons. Will you follow the story, or let adventure be your guide?

name: Hazeron Starship
short_description: Explore and colonize a vast universe. Discover resources. Build cities. Make spacecraft. Walk aboard them. Operate their controls. Command a crew of NPCs. Lift off. Fly up through the atmosphere to outer space. Land on other worlds, anywhere, not at designated places. Build an empire.

name: Narazumono
short_description: Narazumono is a roguelike game.

name: Arrogation: Unlight of Day
short_description: Arrogation: Unlight of Day is a psychological horror game set in World War II. You will play as a lone reporter searching for his lost family in an abandoned village from 80s China. Beyond darkness, you will find nightmarish creatures and secrets from the long lost Imperial Japanese Army.

name: Echoes of the Sun
short_description: This is a moving puzzle adventure story about a teenage girl, Mia, who witnessed the tragic fall of her homeland and the explosion of the Sun. A heavy burden fell on her fragile shoulders - she must restore light to the land and peace in her heart. Will she succeed?

name: The Rise of the Golden Idol
short_description: The Award-winning detective saga returns in this standalone sequel to The Case of the Golden Idol. Uncover the truth behind 20 strange cases of crime, death and depravity in the 1970s. The world has changed dramatically - the sins of humanity have not.

name: Project MIKHAIL: A Muv-Luv War Story
short_description: Set on an Earth where mankind is being steadily annihilated by the alien invaders known as the BETA, Project MIKHAIL lets you pilot a Tactical Surface Fighter in the war to save humanity!

name: Darklands:Awakening
short_description: You will control the protagonist to come to a mysterious prison and reveal the horrible secrets unknown here!

name: Slime Heroes
short_description: Play as the last slime tasked with saving their home in this cute 3D action-adventure slimes-like! Customize your slime, play alone or with a friend, collect weapons and gear, battle challenging enemies and bosses, gain skills, and combine them to create your own abilities to suit your playstyle!

name: Rooms of Realities
short_description: Rooms of Realities is an anthology of virtual Escape Rooms that you can enjoy in co-op or solo mode. Discover the secret that connects all the rooms.

name: Capes
short_description: Superheroes clash in this turn based strategy game. Recruit, train, and deploy your team in order to take back the city from the villains that hold it hostage.

name: Happenlance
short_description: Climb huge mountains, impale hundreds of enemies, and solve tricky physics puzzles... all using only a spear. Pole-vault yourself to victory in this epic joust-'em-up adventure — or face your friends in online co-op and PvP multiplayer!

name: From Madness with Love
short_description: This is a dating sim with guys you will never be on the same page with! For some reason, you just can't communicate with the guy you like... An unusual yet extraordinary experience with a cute pixel art style, fully voiced in Japanese.

name: Dragon Fin Soup
short_description: Dragon Fin Soup seamlessly blends genres to create a fresh experience: half story-driven tactical RPG and half high-stakes roguelike, with a pinch of crass humor and a heaping helping of murder & madness set in a procedurally generated fantasy world.

name: Colonize
short_description: Colonize is a combination of survival game and building strategy that takes place during the colonization period - the 17th century. It tells the story of a settlement in the New World and all the difficulties encountered by the early settlers.

name: SpriteMancer
short_description: SpriteMancer is an all-in-one tool to create and animate effects. Includes a Particle Editor, Animation, Fluid Simulation, 3D Support and a powerful Node Graph plus much more!

name: Badlands Crew - Drive, Command, Conquer
short_description: Create, customize and command your battle wagon to conquer crazed enemy factions and save innocent survivors scattered throughout the lawless Badlands in the aftermath of a devastating apocalypse. Do you have what it takes to Build, Evolve and Fight to survive?

name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition
short_description: Humanity is fighting a losing battle against the virus. Experience a post-apocalyptic open world overrun by hordes of zombies, where your parkour and combat skills are key to survival. Traverse the City freely during the day, but watch the monsters take over during the night.

name: The Amulet of AmunRun
short_description: Dive into AmunRun's pyramid in this cooperative escape room game to recover the pharaoh's amulet. Collaborate & communicate to work out the ancient enigmas that will lead you to the funeral chamber, and avoid falling into the pyramid's many deadly traps along the way.

name: Making History: The Great War
short_description: The Great War is a turn-based grand strategy game based on the epic struggles of the WWI era. Experience the battles of attrition and punishing artillery barrages. Play as any nation of the period as the modern world of industrialized warfare replaces an age of kings with a struggle of ideologies.

name: Forklift Simulator 2019
short_description: Finally, a truly realistic driving game that also teaches you how to safely operate various types of forklifts.

name: Hide & Hold Out - H2o
short_description: Hide & Hold Out is a multiplayer survival game taking place in a devastated water world. Gather, build, team up with your friends and establish the foundations of your future floating empire utilizing the heavy guns of your battle ships!

name: Kinetic Anatomy 3D
short_description: Kinetic Anatomy 3D is a sports anatomy learning software offers a wealth of 3D animation demonstrations of human muscle and skeletal movements.

name: NanoApostle
short_description: NanoApostle is a dark sci-fi boss rush action game featuring intense reaction-based combat and the unique 'Destruction Point' system. Play as Anita, a child augmented with lethal nanomachines, as she battles against twisted cybernetic experiments to escape a top-secret facility.

name: Tempopo
short_description: A psychedelic soundscape in the sky. Puzzle through the seasons by conducting chaotic Tempopo to rescue musical flowers. Design and populate your melodic garden, then let the music play!

name: Cook Serve Forever
short_description: Bathe in the sights, sounds, and smells of Cook Serve Forever, a narrative-focused cooking adventure where you serve food to the hungry masses on your quest for greatness.

name: BattleBit Remastered
short_description: BattleBit Remastered is a low-poly, massive multiplayer FPS, supporting 254 players per server. Battle on a near-fully destructible map with various vehicles!

name: Movavi Video Suite 2023 Steam Edition - An all-in-one video maker: an editor, converter, screen recorder, and more!
short_description: Simplify your game video-editing routine with Movavi’s all-in-one video maker. Edit footage, convert multimedia files to 180+ formats, record video instructions and tutorials, and grab streaming videos. Have fun and maximize the number of views on YouTube, TikTok, and Vimeo.

name: Actraiser Renaissance
short_description: Heaven, earth and mankind - Create and destroy everything according to your will! Experience the revival of the '90s classic hit 'Actraiser'

name: Voxile
short_description: Quest, craft, loot, build, destroy, and shoot your way through gorgeous voxel islands! Encounter mutated wildlife, discover secrets, and find out what went wrong in both pre-designed adventure and procedural survival worlds. Play in Early Access today--alone or with friends!

name: The Corpsmen
short_description: The Corpsmen is a deck-building roguelite where you build and lead a team of creatures to fight, hunt and harvest other monsters. Your creatures will grow and learn new skills according to how you construct them. Craft unique creatures and decks, and venture forth into the unknown.

name: Consortium: THE TOWER
short_description: A hardcore sci-fi first-person role-playing experience. Explore, talk, fight and/or sneak through The Churchill Tower in 2042! Play an active role in the ongoing narrative. Every choice counts.

name: Survival Camp
short_description: The story takes place on Halloween night, when people are wearing masks to revel, the mysterious virus spreads quietly, and the virus engulfed the world instantly. The world is no longer safe. You need to build a camp and survive. Good luck. . .

name: Empyrean Frontier
short_description: Empyrean Frontier is an epic real time strategy game that mixes classic RTS gameplay with a multi-stage campaign in which the player commands a fleet of ships through a galactic map. Boss battles, base building, planet destroying superweapons, and tactical skirmishes create a unique blend of genres.

name: Terra revive
short_description: A simulation of rebuilding a planet after it has been almost completely destroyed. Your task is to make the earth fit for human life again. Survive, build and explore!

name: Machine World 2
short_description: Take control of a range of different machines and operate them in a unique environment. Each new game generates a new world, and it is yours to develop: Dig and build anything, anywhere! All machines have been carefully modelled down to small details.

name: Unexplored 2: The Wayfarer's Legacy
short_description: Dynamic, procedurally generated adventure game that puts exploration first. Build your legacy as each wayfarer will change the fate of the world. Endless replayability with a huge set of difficulty modifiers. Boasting an award-winning soundtrack, a beautiful art style, and regular updates.

name: World Diplomat
short_description: Embark on a diplomatic journey to impact the world with skills and strategy.

name: Outworld Station
short_description: Take the helm as a new Station Commander and exploit an alien star system in this stunning space-station factory automation game. Amass resources and construct starships using increasingly advanced manufacturing and expand your station in a hostile universe.

name: City Tales - Medieval Era
short_description: City Tales is a medieval city builder, allowing you to unleash your creativity and shape vast cities that break outside a traditional grid. Plan each district for your citizens needs and aid your companions in their tales, creating a city to be proud of!

name: Storm Chasers
short_description: Be one of those intrepid storm chasers in this online multiplayer video game. Your goal is to shoot the best twisters pictures without dying because of powerful winds and flying debris. Feel the challenge of correctly forecasting and intercepting storms with the optimal vantage points before other players.

name: Spark the Electric Jester 3
short_description: High speed 3D action platformer! Join Spark on his latest adventure.

name: Cogmind
short_description: Cogmind is a sci-fi roguelike epic in which you play a robot building yourself from components found or salvaged from other robots. Explore a living, breathing world through turn-based tactical combat, or sneak, hack, and fly your way to victory.

name: Cleo - a pirate's tale
short_description: Cleo is a solo-developed, top-down, pixel-art, retro, pirate adventure with a lot of nostalgic flair, humor and a linear story, inspired by the old Zelda games and the classic LucasArts adventure games.

name: Void Grimm
short_description: Void Grimm is a real-time roguelike deckbuilder - In Space! Fight your way through waves of enemy spaceships. Your survival in the fast-paced battles requires quick thinking even at increased adrenaline levels. Optimize your deck, gather your crew, and utilize card synergies to master your runs.

name: ADK
short_description: A.D.K is a third-person survival horror inspired by the iconic classics of the '90s. Face ruthless enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets — every step brings you closer to the horror… and the truth.

name: Torn Tales
short_description: Lead your party of 3 heroes on their quest to repair the torn pages of folklore. Evil has destroyed the tales you love. Hack monsters and slash enemies throughout the Torn Tales in this real time squad based RPG.

name: X-Mutation
short_description: Survive thousands of monsters in X-Mutation, a hardcore 3D top-down rogue-lite action game. Mutate your body into diverse weapons, choose from hundreds of mutations, and uniquely upgrade to craft your personal combat style!

name: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals
short_description: Welcome to the world of dungeon crawling! The classic dungeon crawler released back in 2006, returns to Steam with improved UI and more.

name: Forgotten Seas
short_description: You are lost in the Bermuda Void, where the ocean is endless and dry land precious. Craft your Ship-in-a-Bottle, then experience survival on the high seas. Sail for new land, build camps, hunt for treasures, trade for goods - then defend your ship from dreaded pirates stalking this strange realm!

name: Movavi Video Editor 2024
short_description: Your simple yet powerful editor for creating wow videos. Whether you’re creating immersive walkthroughs, exciting game highlights, or engaging Let's Plays, Movavi Video Editor has you covered with must-have editing tools and dynamic special effects to give your content some extra zing.

name: Tempest Rising
short_description: Command distinct factions in a desperate struggle for power and resources in Tempest Rising - a classic RTS set on Earth after a nuclear war.

name: EPHEMERAL -FANTASY ON DARK-
short_description: Fleeting, yet beautiful. The world of darkness―― The main protagonist, Cloe (name changeable) lived in a secluded town. Surrounded by wire fences, it felt like she was trapped inside a cage. Zombies were the only residents in that town, and she wasn't the exception.

name: art of rally
short_description: Race in the golden era of rally. Drive iconic cars from the 60s to Group B on challenging stages through stylized environments inspired by real worldwide locations. Will you master the art of rally?

name: Kingsvein
short_description: Explore and reclaim the infested castle-city of Kingsvein! Ride into its depths on your trusty wyvern, and lead your customizable party of Knights and Mystics in deep tactical combat.

name: Stoneshard
short_description: Stoneshard is a hardcore turn-based RPG about the harsh life of a medieval mercenary: travel with your own caravan, descend into procedurally generated dungeons, learn new skills, survive hunger and injuries - and remember, every mistake can mean death and loss of progress.

name: CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic
short_description: Empire Club. The most luxurious bar that ladies and gentlemen come and gather. The beautiful maids who worked there danced and talked with the customers to amuse them.

name: You VS Drugs
short_description: Addiction can enslave anyone, anywhere. By taking on the role of real-life Agents who exist in our brain and embarking on an adventure that will defy your imagination, you will be empowered to better protect yourself and the people you love —if you have what it takes! All kids should play this game!

name: Len's Island
short_description: An open-world survival crafting game for 1–8 players, blending intense dungeon crawling and ARPG combat with peaceful farming and creative building. Take on quests and explore a vast, procedurally-generated world full of danger and discovery.

name: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2025
short_description: Lead your college basketball team in Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2025. Recruit stars, coach for success, and make key decisions that will lead your team to the tournament. Navigate recruiting, the transfer portal and NIL options to build a winner. The ultimate coaching simulation game!

name: Bardic: Quest for Love
short_description: Having just arrived in the great port city of Deepharbor, humble bards Edmond and Edna are suddenly tasked with running a Tavern. Recruit fellow adventuring heroes, manage your tavern, and possibly find romance? This is your Quest for Love!

name: The World of Kungfu: Dragon and Eagle
short_description: Make a name for yourself in this old-school Wuxia RPG. Explore the chaotic lands of ancient China and engage in challenging turn-based battles to change the world of kungfu forever.

name: Verdant Village
short_description: You've washed ashore in a foreign land. With nothing to your name other than a few tools you’ll have to learn how to live off the land. Explore, grow crops, and meet the locals. How you live is up to you. Can you create a new life for yourself in the small town of Amberglen?

name: Under One Wing
short_description: Fairy Fight - A large-scale dogfight, utilizing the finest warplanes the world has ever known. Sasaki Junichi is the grandson of a legendary FF Pilot. He arrives at the student dormitory of a legendary FF academy known as Shouou Academy, only to find... every other tenant is a woman!!

name: Age of Survival
short_description: Age of Survival is survival simulation crafting game from Silky Sullivan. Your player has been stranded on an island not far off of the coast of Africa where you will encounter many creatures, and players alike.

name: Liars Village
short_description: The new strategic and realistic multiplayer role-playing game up to 12 players ! Act discreetly and make the right choices to lead your team to victory!

name: Double Shot
short_description: The perfect blend of bartending, shooting and the 80's come together in virtual reality. Doused in neon and riddled with bullets, will you survive your shift?

name: Northern Regime
short_description: Northern Regime: 1862 is a hardcore survival game set against the backdrop of the American Civil War in the frozen and frigid lands of Northern Dakota. It’s you vs. the environment and all its inherent dangers as you tackle Confederate soldiers, hostile wildlife, and the cold to stay alive.

name: EscapeVr
short_description: Try to escape a murder room. Interact with objects in the world to find clues. Pick up items that seem to be usefull. Even smashing stuff with a baseball bat could help finding a way out. You allowed to be creativ!

name: Chef RPG
short_description: Craft your culinary adventure in a beautiful pixel art world. Manage your restaurants, forage and hunt for ingredients, befriend locals, and grow your culinary empire. What kind of chef will you be?

name: VR Squash 2017
short_description: Real competitive squash experience in VR - feel hitting the ball with your virtual racket! Beat four increasingly difficult AI enemies in squash with your skills! The unique enemies will use different tactics to try to defeat you, difficulty is ranging from Sam the Slow to Chad the Champion! Are you up to the challenge?

name: Kizuna AI - Touch the Beat!
short_description: Say hello (morning!) to a new kind of rhythm game, and hang out in a virtual space with Kizuna AI!

name: Afterlove EP
short_description: From the creator of Coffee Talk and What Comes After, comes a slice-of-life adventure set in modern Jakarta about love, loss and finding your own way forward. Step into the shoes of Rama, a young musician struggling to move on with life after the death of his girlfriend, Cinta.

name: Source of the Nile Digital Edition
short_description: The single-player version of the legendary board game 'Source of the Nile', finally brought to the digital realm. A challenging game of discovery played on a hexagon-grid map showing known Africa ca. 1820, in which the player competes with nature in order to survive.

name: Dungeoneers
short_description: You stand before a dungeon crawler 10 years in the making. Fast-paced, tabletop-insipred gameplay. Light story and banter. 80's nostalgia. Quick sessions. Multi-platform. Classic art & narration. Easy to learn. Hard to master. Enter if you dare.

name: DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia
short_description: Play as Shido and unravel the secrets of the mysterious spirit Ren in the visual novel follow-up to DATE A LIVE: Rio Reincarnation, based on the acclaimed light novel and anime series.

name: The Symbiant
short_description: The Symbiant is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about two men, both from vastly different worlds, embracing their sexuality and their newfound romance. It is also a tale of interstellar friendship and being gay in space!

name: Meifumado
short_description: Meifumado is an action RPG set in a post-apocalyptic, immersive world inspired by Japan.

name: Cozy Caravan
short_description: Grab your backpack and climb on in, it’s time to hit the road! Head out on a gentle journey in your reliable old caravan, crafting hearty meals, running market stalls and sharing goodies with local townsfolk. Spread kindness, share, and help prepare for the annual Whizz Bang Fair!

name: In the Dark
short_description: 'In the Dark' is a roguelike deck-building horror card game. Cooperate with and fight against other survivors, collect cards, skills, items, and souls, and use them to survive in the world shrouded in darkness due to the impact of the meteorite, where monsters and zombies have appeared.

name: The Demon Rush: Legends Corrupt
short_description: The Demon Rush: Legends Corrupt is an action RPG with an ensemble cast and multiple modes (Story Mode, Endless Dungeon, Onslaught, Conquest, Heist, Boulderball, Naval Conquest, Side Stories, RopeRange, Prison Break, Summoner's Onslaught and Counterintelligence).

name: TERRORHYTHM (TRRT) - Rhythm driven action beat 'em up!
short_description: TERRORHYTHM - the music powered beat 'em up game. Follow the rhythm of music to defeat the security systems that keep any sound from the society. Upload your own MP3 collection and battle through your favourite tracks!

name: openCanvas 6
short_description: openCanvas is a painting software dedicated to Windows Operating System, that is suitable to beginners to advanced users. Equipped with analog-like brush strokes and functional yet user-friendly interface, openCanvas has the higher basic performance and the unique 'Event' function that enables to record and replay the drawing...

name: Katy and Bob: Safari Cafe
short_description: Katy and Bob: a new chapter in the adventures of Katy and Bob. Head into the safari park and grow your business!

name: Knights of Light: The Prologue
short_description: Action adventure role playing game during medieval age in Middle East. Story is based on a historical battle at the 7th century in Iraq. Inspired by The Witcher and Mount & Blade with a rich story with two playable characters. Relive the battle events and lead your troops to victory.

name: Super Technos World: River City & Technos Arcade Classics
short_description: This exciting collection brings you 12 games in one, from developer Technos Japan known for creating the legendary River City and Double Dragon series. From arcade classics to region-exclusive titles, you’ll have plenty to explore in this collection! Get your hands on these rare games of legend!

name: Legend of Heroes: Three Kingdoms
short_description: 'Legend of Heroes: Three Kingdoms' is a single-player RPG where you shape the Three Kingdoms era. Choose to be a ruler, a loyal advisor, or a cunning mercenary. Marry, build homes, or train in martial arts. Restore peace through diplomacy or conquer with mighty armies.

name: Trolley Problem
short_description: ' A Kind Girl, or A Ruthless Savior? ' A multi-ending action-puzzle game where your guidance becomes a story.

name: Pickup One
short_description: This is an parkour pickup game. The pace of the game is very tight. The goal of the game is to score as many points as possible.

name: Code 3: Police Response
short_description: Code 3 is a tactical police based first person shooter developed for the PC made by police and police support personnel.

name: Westard
short_description: Get ready to heist banks and rob trains solo or co-op with friends in Westard VR. Take it to the western streets to decide who controls the town in pvp multiplayer modes.

name: Near-Mage
short_description: You have been invited to stay in Transylvania for the summer... Only to find out that you come from a long line of witches. Meet your new vampyre and strigoi classmates, embrace your destiny, and enroll in the Transylvanian Institute for Magick! A supernatural adventure made in Transylvania.

name: ZUSI 3 - Aerosoft Edition
short_description: Zusi 3 Aerosoft Edition is a train simulation for PCs, the professional version of which is also being used in railway companies for engine driver training purposes.

name: Nefasto's Misadventure: Meeting Noeroze
short_description: You like original adventures? The point-and-click genre? Twisted riddles and obscure discoveries? Dive into the 'glitched' universe of Nefasto, where the 4th wall is continuously broken! But will you manage stabilizing your computer, on the verge of crashing?!

name: Frontier Quest
short_description: Rebuild a frontier town and become acquainted with its community in puzzle-RPG Frontier Quest! Explore the frontier, collect materials and defeat monsters with the right equipment in order to restore the town and uncover the secrets of the frontier.

name: City VR
short_description: City VR allows you to discover new perspectives to look upon cities like never have before. Touch and feel the skyscrapers, teleport around, walk like a giant, take snapshots of favorite views and moments, or simply enjoy the sunset from the top of the world.

name: Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery
short_description: Experience the newest tactical RPG from the creators of Girls’ Frontline. Some 30 years in the future, AU agent Mendo and the mysterious girl Jefuty find themselves in gruesome battles against armed URNC forces…
developers: Shanghai Sunborn Network Technology Co., Ltd.

name: The Prison Game
short_description: The Prison Game is an online multiplayer survival game. Your mission is to try to survive in harsh prison conditions, against vicious death row inmates, by using your own capabilities, skills and abilities.

name: The Beekeeper's Picnic - A Sherlockian Adventure
short_description: Beekeeper (and former world’s greatest detective) Sherlock Holmes is arranging a surprise picnic for his friend Watson. Unfortunately pesky mysteries keep getting in the way! Explore, find clues and interrogate your neighbours in this cosy point and click adventure!

name: RECOG The First Wave
short_description: RECOG The Game is truly challenging and strategically entertaining. Build and defend your industry from an enemy who knows you more than you know yourself. Plan each step wisely, for all decisions you make directly impact what’s to come. Be prepared, for you are now entering THE RECOG!

name: Space Impossible
short_description: Take control of a fully destructible spaceship and explore, blast or trade your way through the cosmos, alone or with friends. Every tile matters, as you dogfight, maneuver or speed your way past friendly traders, hostile aliens, and impressive space navies. What will you do, Captain?

name: AIR
short_description: Summer stretches on endlessly. Beneath the vast blue sky. Beneath the air in which she awaits— AIR, the second game released by visual novel studio Key, is now available on Steam! Now featuring the side story novel, 'First Sky Chapter' and full voice support!

name: Star Ruler 2
short_description: Massive scale 4X-RTS set in space. Control hundreds of planets, manipulate galactic politics, research numerous advanced technologies, and command thousands of units and hundreds of planets in your quest for galactic dominance.

name: Zompiercer
short_description: Take control of the train which will become your haven on the rails. Collect resources, craft equipment, construct a cozy house on railway cars, and travel through the carefully handcrafted locations to explore the story of a zombie apocalypse world.

name: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible
short_description: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible brings the beloved book series to life. Help Dog Man and his friends chase down the supa bad guys in their most impawsible mission yet!

name: Contractors Showdown : ExfilZone
short_description: Contractors Showdown delivers adrenaline-fueled VR combat with two distinct modes: fast-paced Battle Royale and the immersive, tactical Exfil Zone. Customize your loadout, complete missions, and fight to survive in dynamic, high-stakes battles. Gear up, squad up, and dominate the VR battlefield!

name: Tour de France 2020
short_description: Compete against the peloton in all 21 stages of the Tour de France in the official game! To wear the yellow jersey, you will need to take risks, attack, sprint and perfect your race tactics. Challenge your friends in Downhill or Sprint Challenge mode!

name: OMSI 2: Steam Edition
short_description: Off to the next round! Experience a new omnibus simulator with OMSI 2 and start discovering Spandau while driving the omnibus. OMSI 2 is the successor of the well-known and awarded omnibus simulator 'OMSI - The Bus Simulator'.

name: Island Treasure Chase
short_description: We explore the pirate island searching for treasures and trying to escape from skeletons.

name: Baldr Sky
short_description: Kou Kadokura, a cyber officer, seeks to uncover the truth behind the tragedy that ended his once peaceful life. A war looms, and the answers he’s looking for are locked away in him... So why can't he remember anything? Unravel the mysteries hidden in his lost memories through this fast-paced mech action game!

name: SlasherRPG
short_description: Slasher RPG is Game Fantasy Faming , Action and Survival We combined many feature. such as hunting , farming , hack and slash , building , raise animals

name: New Cycle
short_description: New Cycle is a city building game with focus on survival. After an apocalyptic series of solar flares, human society has been thrown into disarray. Establish a settlement and develop it all the way from humble beginnings to industrial metropolis.

name: Yolo Space Hacker
short_description: Welcome to our ethical hacker's organisation: we will teach you how to use actual hacker tools (terminal, proxy, reverse shells...) to scan the network, crack passwords, bypass server security and solve the mystery of the Bikini-72 space station.

name: Crystal Breaker
short_description: Shoot the enemy at close range! Crystal Breaker is a vertically scrolling shmup that focuses on close range attack.

name: Prodeus
short_description: Prodeus is a first-person shooter of old, re-imagined using modern rendering techniques and technology. Experience the quality you’d expect from a modern AAA game, designed with retro aesthetics and gameplay that invoke the tech-imposed limits of older hardware.

name: Legions At War
short_description: Unique sandbox engine to create limitless turn based tactics/strategy games. You can create modern military scenarios or even chess variations, so be prepared for incredibly challenging turn based challenges in the campaign or online play against the best strategic minds in the world.

name: Identity
short_description: Identity is a new breed of massively multiplayer online role-playing game where hundreds of players interact in a world of absolute freedom. It's the actions of players which determine your fate and the fate of the world you live in.

name: Trollskog
short_description: Trollskog is an open-world citybuilder RTS, with economic engine-building, tactical battles and player choice. Explore a forested world inspired by Swedish folklore, filled with both friendly and hostile NPCs, solve quests and secure resources through force or diplomacy.

name: Faeland
short_description: Take on the role of skilled hunter, Sam, in Faeland, an adventure RPG set in a beautiful world inspired by 8-bit classics.

name: M.E.R.C.
short_description: Experience non-stop, real-time tactical combat with a 4-person squad. Upgrade and recruit units, enhance special abilities, while acquiring better weapons and gear. Take your toughest recruits into action in single player or co-op multiplayer and save humanity from the suppressive Manta force.

name: Summer Pockets
short_description: From the creators of Angel Beats! and CLANNAD, Key, comes their latest emotional, award-winning journey. Follow protagonist Takahara Hairi as he travels to the secluded island Torishirojima, where he rediscovers what it means to enjoy summer vacation.

name: SPGP Super Polygon Grand Prix
short_description: It's all about speed, it’s all about the competition. Choose a car that suites you and race highly competitive AI at brake neck speeds over a vast variety of locations. Unlock 48 tracks and 20 cars in Progress Mode. Local Multiplayer and Online Leaderboards.

name: Tactera
short_description: Tactera is a Real-Time Strategy game played on a “virtual tabletop”. Comes with VR (Rift/Vive) and non-VR versions! Inside a futuristic war room, a 3D hologram shows two armies on the verge of battle. Build swarms of gunships, tanks, bombers, and other units to strategically outmaneuver the enemy!

name: Sam & Max: This Time It's Virtual!
short_description: Sam is a dog in a suit. Max is his naked rabbity partner. Together, they’re the Freelance Police. Jump into the not-quite-right world of Sam & Max via the wonder science of virtual reality, and join the multimedia darlings in their never-ending quest to slap the stupid grin off the face of evil.

name: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure
short_description: Oddsparks is a blend of automation and real-time strategy for both the die-hard fans of the automation genre and the automation-curious. Explore a strange fantasy world, uncover the mysteries of the past, automate your workshops, and go on adventures with your odd & adorable Sparks!

name: You are Peter Shorts
short_description: You are PETER SHORTS! You have been captured and taken to a secret cloning facility. Can you escape with your newly-cloned brethren?

name: Star Trek™: Starfleet Academy
short_description: A must for any fan, Star Trek: Starfleet Academy is an action/flight simulator featuring filmed footage of the original Star Trek actors. Take your place among the best and brightest at Starfleet Academy!

name: Slime Rancher 2
short_description: Continue the adventures of Beatrix LeBeau as she journeys across the Slime Sea to Rainbow Island, a land brimming with ancient mysteries, and bursting with wiggly, new slimes to wrangle in this sequel to the smash-hit, Slime Rancher.

name: SOUND FORGE Audio Studio 14 Steam Edition
short_description: Quick and easy audio editing with cutting-edge technology: SOUND FORGE Audio Studio 14 Steam Edition delivers comprehensive digital audio editing tools and functions for recording, editing, restoration and mastering.

name: Square Heroes
short_description: Join the Galactic Tournament in this fast-paced comical action shooter. Level-up your Hero and unlock an arsenal of weapons. Lay waste to your friends and foes in local, LAN and online multiplayer matches, or hone your skills in single player and custom games.

name: Astrox Imperium
short_description: Astrox Imperium is a relaxing space game where you fly around a generated universe. Mining, Fighting, Building, Exploring, and Surviving. What makes this game unique? You have complete control of how it plays. A robust sandbox and lots of MOD tools. Make it your game, and play it your own way.

name: Neonverse Defenders
short_description: Neonverse defenders: The retro-futuristic 3D Tower Defense game.

name: Ascension
short_description: In this cultivation 4X strategy game, your sect has been in peril, and so they open a portal—sending you, a young disciple and their last hope, inside. Stand tall as the new sect leader and guide disciples to rebuild what was lost. Sharpen your focus, master alchemy, and ascend to immortality.

name: The Safe Place
short_description: This is a dramatic deep social point&click adventure about tough childhood and self-sacrifice.

name: Sunset
short_description: It's 1972 and a military coup has rocked Anchuria. You, Angela Burnes, are trapped in the metropolitan capital of San Bavón. Your paradise has turned into a warzone. You take up a job as a housekeeper. Every week, an hour before sunset, you clean the swanky bachelor pad of the wealthy Gabriel Ortega.

name: #BLUD
short_description: Save your friends, fight off the vampire apocalypse, and survive the horrors of freshman field hockey practice in #BLUD, a delightfully zany animated dungeon crawler that blurs the line between action RPGs and hyperkinetic 90s cartoons.

name: Grim Realms
short_description: A dark fantasy colony sim - will your colony end the Dread Storm and redeem mankind, or will they harness the dark powers for themselves? Guide your villagers as they struggle to stay alive in a world overrun by the undead.

name: Iron Age
short_description: Iron Age is a First-person dungeon crawler set in a Sci-Fi Fantasy world with Realtime melee combat.

name: MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons

name: VRocker

In this open-world simulation, you and up to 3 pals will steal, fight, and scheme to reclaim the city. Customise your rides, buy businesses, and take on the Mayor’s forces. Rockhaven is yours for the taking!

name: Geneforge 2 - Infestation
short_description: Wildly open-ended adventure in a unique fantasy world. Use battle or diplomacy and trickery to change the world, served by an army of custom-made mutant monsters. Almost 90 zones to explore and 50+ hours of gameplay. Enormous range of abilities, factions, quests, and paths to victory.

name: Wilmot Works It Out
short_description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

name: Erannorth Renaissance
short_description: Erannorth Renaissance is a story-driven RPG, where you create your own hero, build a party, and make choices that shape your journey. Set in an open-world, it mixes text-based storytelling with turn-based combat, deep customization, and the freedom to play your way.

name: BATTLE GEAR
short_description: A zombie virus that began with a meteorite, the surviving humans fled to the sea by boat. To get the world back, And for the victory of the human race, Solve the problems, As a troubleshooter for the UN ,That's your mission.

name: D96: Kansei

name: Golem
short_description: A heart-warming adventure about a young girl and a shape-shifting golem who must navigate the ruins of an ancient tower to solve its challenging puzzles and re-activate its long-dormant machines.

name: Myst
short_description: Welcome to Myst: a starkly beautiful island, eerily tinged with mystery and shrouded in intrigue. Built from the ground up to play in 2D & VR, explore Myst in a whole new dimension! Journey to the Ages, unravel puzzles, and be a part of the surrealistic adventure that will become your own.

Help him uncover the sinister secrets of Kent Industries in this 2D puzzle adventure filled to the brim with funky tunes and retro platformer goodness.

name: Snacko
short_description: Driven away by the cost of living, you and your childhood friend set off with the goal to turn things around and start a new life. Explore, gather, and build up the town from scratch into a place you'll be proud to call 'home'!

name: Mars Horizon
short_description: Lead a major space agency as you guide humanity to Mars in this strategy simulation game. Construct a base, design and build rockets, conduct missions throughout the Solar System, and write your own history of Space exploration. Created with support from the European Space Agency.

name: Bush Hockey League
short_description: Aggressive hockey is back! Experience hockey the way it was meant to be played in this old school arcade style hockey game where blood on the ice is just another day at the rink. Big moustaches, no helmets, dirty hits, bench-clearing brawls, goalie fights, and stick fights – that’s Bush Hockey League.

name: The Cursed Moon ~The Girl Trapped in the Haunted House~
short_description: After hearing a young girl's cry for help, Yukine as a kami went in to the unknowned dimension to help. While helping the ghosts on the way to fulfill their wishes, she also has to solve riddles and traps. Will Yukine be able to save the girl from this cursed dimension ...?

name: Jusant
short_description: Enjoy meditative vibes in Jusant, an action-puzzle climbing game. Scale an immeasurably tall tower and ascend to new heights alongside your watery companion. Master your climbing tools, find your way up through diverse biomes, and piece together the tower’s past.

name: Metrico+
short_description: Explore this unique world of infographics: All the bar charts, line diagrams and pie charts react to what you are doing. Metrico+ is a combination of exploration, skill, experimentation, but most of all: thinking outside of the box. Are you smart enough to solve all the mysteries?

name: Dragonkin: The Banished
short_description: The draconic threat is once again upon us. Legendary heroes rise up to face the legions from the depths. Tame your wyrmlings, create unique power builds with the Ancestral Grid, expand your city and destroy the Dragons!

name: Hadean Tactics
short_description: Hadean Tactics is a roguelike deckbuilding game fused with autobattler elements to create a unique strategy experience. Use your cards to influence the actions of your units and help your Hero defeat the Six Wings of Hell!

name: Atrio: The Dark Wild
short_description: Keep your disposable android-body alive by automating everything. Automate farming, foraging, crafting and capturing - and even assimilate creatures into your production lines during your impossible mission to relight the world.

name: Thrillgate
short_description: A comic strip, a classic point n' click, a surreal adventure set in the 80's.

name: EBOLA VILLAGE
short_description: EBOLA VILLAGE - this is a classic survival horror game from the 90s with a focus on atmosphere and player immersion. Solve puzzles, follow the story carefully and use various weapons in a brutal fight for survival. Danger lurks at every turn.

name: OHV
short_description: Build your own buggy. Obtain, maintain and tune your OHV car. A game set in Poland in the 90s.

name: Vibrant Venture
short_description: Vibrant Venture is a singleplayer 2D adventure platformer game featuring a quirky cast of characters! The game features four playable characters with multiple unique abilities that can be combined for extremely versatile, fluid and fun movement!

name: Rime Berta
short_description: Command an army of puppets in this Japanese SRPG as you hunt for a relic said to grant any wish. Livia's village is dying, and all that can help them is an ancient relic situated somewhere within a mystical tower.

name: Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty
short_description: Prove to have a true Strategic Mind! Spirit of Liberty will put your strategic planning skills to the test. It’s a hardcore, turn-based, historically accurate strategy game set in WWII. Lead Finnish forces against an overwhelming threat through the Winter War, Continuation War, and Lapland War.

name: Sankaku Renai: Love Triangle Trouble
short_description: Meet Sousuke. He's just your average student, living in a rural town. Ever since his father remarried when he was young, he's been living together with his little sister Nanaru. Together with his childhood friend Maho and their other friends, they have fun geeking out in the Otaku Club.

name: Library Of Ruina
short_description: 'May you find your book in this place.' Combat between the guests and the librarians breaks out as if it were on a stage. Defeated guests turn into books, and the Library grows onward. And eventually, get your hands on… The one singular, perfect book.

name: Acassia
short_description: Tank, action and shooting game, where does it start your new adventure in a world of science fiction and interplanetary wars...

name: 4D Toys
short_description: 4D Toys: A box of toys from the fourth dimension.

name: The Shepherd
short_description: After finding an old picture of your grandfather on a camel, you decide to leave the city and set off into the serenity of the desert. In order to become a great rider, just like he was. Train your herd, befriend desert-folk, fight predators, and navigate the mysteries of the desert.

name: Two Falls (Nishu Takuatshina)
short_description: Explore 17th century Canadian wilderness through the eyes of Jeanne, a French woman who crossed the Atlantic to start anew and Maikan, an Innu hunter trying to discover what’s disturbing the forest. Your choices will shape the traits of the protagonists in this narrative single-player experience.

name: Guilds Of Delenar
short_description: Guilds of Delenar is a strategy RPG with a tactical turn-based combat system where you fight to build your guild from nothing into a guild known across the realm. Manage your heroes, their gear, what quests you do, and command them in battle.

name: Grieve
short_description: This is a single player, action based thirdperson shooter. where the player travels to different mini openworld type locations to clear out enemy bases and gather intel

name: EVOTINCTION
short_description: In 'Evotinction', a third-person hacking and stealth game, you are Dr. Liu, the only one who can stop rogue AIs in a futuristic research facility. Use a variety of hacking skills to overcome robotic threats and uncover the secrets that hold the key to humanity's survival or its potential extinction.

name: Click and Relax
short_description: The game consists of mini-games in which you can move objects, twist the knobs and just relax.

name: Ghost
short_description: This is a farm themed platform jumping game with simple gameplay but quite cute and interesting.

name: Our Darker Purpose
short_description: Journey to the dark heart of the Edgewood Home for Lost Children in this fiendishly difficult action RPG!When her teacher stepped out of the classroom a month ago, Cordy never imagined he would be gone for good. Now her fellow students have turned on each other as the school descends into chaos.

name: The Callisto Protocol™
short_description: Survive to escape the horrors of Callisto and uncover the dark secrets of Jupiter’s dead moon.

name: MuGen - The Music Generator
short_description: MuGen uses guided randomization and music theory to create royalty free music based on your input parameters. Get inspired, unleash your creativity - generate music for your next game or video, create backing tracks for your guitar practice - the possibilities are limitless!

name: NEStalgia
short_description: NEStalgia is an original MORPG inspired by the glory days of traditional console RPGs. Essentially 'Dragon Warrior 3 meets World of Warcraft', NEStalgia is an amalgam of the best generations of RPG gaming. You can play solo, in private games with friends, or online with hundreds of other players!

name: Corrupted: Dawn of Havoc
short_description: A hardcore auto battle rogue-like deck-building (H.A.R.D) game, 'Corrupted' has the strategy of an auto-battler and the challenging difficulty of a rogue-like. Build your own team and skill card deck, and retake the stolen planet through strategic placement and real-time card use!

name: YUMENIKKI -DREAM DIARY-
short_description: As long as I have dreams in my heart, I can never escape. I can never awaken from my dreams. Maybe if I follow the dream just past this doorway, then someday I can wake up again...

name: 4th Generation Warfare
short_description: As the leader of a nation, dispatch and control your team of characters all around the world to destabilize your enemies and establish your supremacy. All methods are fair game: hacking, sabotage, political interference, military strikes, corruption, treachery, assassinations, data theft…

name: Fate Hunters
short_description: Fate Hunters is a hardcore mix of strategy card battles and a roguelike adventure. Build your deck, explore the dangerous dark fantasy world and face fearsome foes! Risk your life to get powerful treasures!

name: REYNATIS
short_description: Fantasy meets reality in Shibuya, Tokyo, where magic is something to be feared. In this action RPG, a young wizard seeks freedom through strength, and an officer seeks to control magic and restore order. When their paths cross, a darkness that will transform the world descends.

name: Kainga: Seeds of Civilization
short_description: Welcome to the mystical world of Kainga, an unusual roguelite village-builder! Take control of a Thinker and, with the help of your people, grow a unique town to complete short challenges while discovering the world and adapting to the pressures of the environment, beasts and other tribes.

name: Boulder Dash Deluxe
short_description: Boulder Dash® Gem collecting puzzle action in an update of the classic game!

name: Banana for Scale
short_description: A Virtual Reality game where you measure things with bananas.

name: Carrier Command 2
short_description: Carrier Command 2 is the real-time strategy game that puts you in command of a futuristic carrier capable of deploying a vast array of aircraft and amphibious units. Compete against AI or human players and hop into every single vehicle to take matters into your own hands!

name: DurDanto
short_description: DurDanto is a metroidvania game where you play as Zubok in a fallen city with beautiful pixel art environments while facing different enemies. Use elemental abilities to uncover secrets of the fallen city, overcome the enemies & roguelike dungeons by skills & spells!

name: SunnySide
short_description: Find harmony in the Japanese countryside as you help Sparky uncover lost memories in this modern take on the farming and life simulator. Build a thriving homestead, cultivate new relationships, and chase your own happiness in SunnySide.

name: xDrive VR
short_description: X Drive - multiplayer dynamic shooter from the third person view, developed for VR headset.

name: Gordon Streaman
short_description: Gordon Streaman is a newcomer to the world of streaming and gaming, in order to fullfill his mostly intense dreams and wishes of becoming known/popular and make a lot of money in the process, it isn’t going to be that easy! Achieve as many subscribers as possible and become a popular internet celebrity.

name: PLAYNE : The Meditation Game
short_description: Grow a beautiful island as you build a daily habit of mindfulness and meditation. Experience relaxation and learn ways to care for your mental wellbeing.

name: Heraldry Studio
short_description: Tool for making your own coat of arms is here! Heraldry Studio allows user to create and export a unique coat of arms, according to the rules of heraldry.

name: Open Sorcery: Sea++
short_description: You wake up at the bottom of the ocean, surrounded by your broken memories. Reclaim and compile your magic or drown in a sea of dreams.

name: Fritz - Your chess coach
short_description: Fritz. Your chess trainer! Chess is fun with me! With AI help you learn to play brilliant winning games even as a beginner. Or play at professional level without help. Always with a humorous commentary. I also find opponents for you on the chess server and give you tactics training.

name: Combat Mission Shock Force 2
short_description: The latest title in the famous Combat Mission franchise of wargames, now on Steam. Shock Force 2 brings you to a hypothetical conflict in Syria between the forces of NATO and the Syrian Army. Play either on WeGo or Real Time in an incredibly detailed and realistic 1:1 tactical simulation.

name: Love ritual
short_description: Visit a beautiful fantasy city as an occult scientist where a forbidden ritual was performed. Unravel the mystery with your detective skills as the plot thickens around you, and all while two handsome advocates vie for your attention and your heart.

name: Deadside
short_description: An Open World Survival Shooter blending hardcore PVP and PVE action. Secure precious loot in safe zones or build your own fortress in the wild. With intense gunfights, stunning visuals, and performance smooth enough for any system, the challenge awaits!

name: Ninja Legends
short_description: If he attains the virtue of the long sword, one man can beat ten men. You must attain this virtue in Ninja Legends and recover the stolen shadow scrolls. Enemies will utilize cooperative group attacks to swarm and surround you. Master all the weapons and tactics ... or perish.

name: Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds
short_description: On your maiden voyage with the Heroes Guild, your ship was capsized by an enigmatic maelstrom, stranding your party on Respite Island. Navigate your way through pirates, ferocious beasts, and shady alchemists as you unravel its mysteries.

name: The Original Island
short_description: The Original IslandIs an open world island survival RPG independently developed by Lanmeng technology. From the main perspective of the victim, Lin Yunfeng, it depicts a beautiful and dangerous, magnificent and mysterious island, and tries to solve its secrets.
developers: 泉州市兰梦网络科技中心（有限合伙）

name: Metric Racer
short_description: Race through future cities and across the surface of other planets to out run, out maneuver and out pace your competition. Metric Racer, a fast paced, cartoon shaded futuristic racer.

name: Artifact Run
short_description: A treasure hunter searches for artifacts in the jungle and is chased by wild animals.

name: XFlight: FPV Drone Simulator
short_description: A top-notch FPV simulator with excellent control feel and a wealth of engaging content.

name: Cowbots and Aliens
short_description: Cowbots and Aliens is a furious PvP Multiplayer VR brawl set in the Saloon-iverse! Free movement, laser precise gunplay, multiple competitive modes and a custom networked physics system that lets you use EVERYTHING as a weapon makes for an immensely satisfying VR ruckus!

name: Pinchcliffe Grand Prix
short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of Flåklypa in this game for the whole family. Play nine mini games, enjoy the classic story and take it to the tracks for high-octane racing, alone or with a friend in split-screen. But watch out, your competitors will use dirty tricks to win – and so can you!

name: Core Keeper
short_description: Explore a vast cavern of creatures, relics and resources in a mining sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Mine, build, fight, craft and farm to unravel the mystery of the ancient Core.

name: Swanky Paint
short_description: A modern Deluxe Paint tribute.This is not the greatest pixel paint package in the world, no. This is just a tribute.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki II KAI -The Erebonian Civil War-
short_description: The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki role-playing game series is highly acclaimed by gamers all over the world for its elaborate character portrayals and epic storyline. The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki and The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki II have sold over 1 million copies in total.

name: MoneyFalls - Coin Pusher Simulator
short_description: MoneyFalls is a coin pusher simulator with accurate physics and stunning graphics with many added items and gadgets that makes the game more challenging.Added in version 1.2 new machines and modes. Discover it yourself.

name: Kilta
short_description: Kilta is a single-player auto battler strategy RPG featuring item management, an interesting story supported by a growing cast of unique characters, charming pixel art in a 2.5D environment, and a stunning soundtrack.

name: Holo Impact : Prologue
short_description: Arcade style shooting game totally come back with VR technology!!come to fell the classic gameplay with simple control and experiencing the excitement of bullet shower. Player is playing a hero in a star ship, going to unknown planet to save his girlfriend taken by alien. Can you go through the stage to save your beloved girlfriend ?

name: glitter
short_description: It is a casual puzzle game with great features and advantages.

name: Kukoos: Lost Pets
short_description: Welcome to the world of the Kukoos! On a planet covered in water, the Kukoos live on an island that is home to the Kukoo tree. After an experiment where the Kukoos attempted to make their pets more obedient goes haywire, it is up to the Kukoos to find their newly aggressive pets and regain control.

name: Vernon's Legacy
short_description: Vernon's Legacy is an horror adventure with an enigmatic story that takes place nearly a century ago. You are playing as Robert, the new owner of Dunkenhof manor.

name: VentureVerse: Legend of Ulora
short_description: The Champion of Ulora is missing and an unsuspecting adventurer is about to embark on a quest they will never forget. Create your character, grab your weapons and delve deep into the puzzle-packed dungeons of Ulora and beyond in this light-hearted action-adventure.

name: Rise of a Legend
short_description: Rise of a Legend is a third-person action RPG that immerses you in the ruthless era of gladiatorial combat. Engage in rich single-player progression or take on challengers in online multiplayer matches. Manage your Ludus, level up your fighters, and boost your house's prestige with every victory.

name: Monster Prom 4: Monster Con
short_description: Can you find love at the nerdiest convention ever? 'Monster Con' goes back to the multiplayer dating sim formula: go through absurd and funny situations as you find love among six sexy monsters! Who will you romance? The mimic who cosplays? The idol clown? Or the eldritch cutie? (There's also Liam)

name: Universe Sandbox
short_description: Create & destroy on an unimaginable scale with a realistic physics-based space simulator. Explore the beauty of our universe and the fragility of our planet. Use science to bend the laws of gravity, collide planets, boil away oceans, fire epic space lasers, and customize your universe.

name: SCP: Secret Files
short_description: SCP: Secret Files is a collection of paranormal cases from the SCP Foundation, an organization tasked with containing dangerous anomalies. You join as an assistant researcher for Dr. Raymond Hamm and complete a strenuous induction program that will make you question everything you know.

name: INtLOVErt Game Club
short_description: A lot of unique Japanese nerds appear one after another! Let's enjoy the exciting daily life with him, a member of the nerds circle who is interested in you!

name: Ultimate Admiral: Age of Sail
short_description: Ultimate Admiral: Age of Sail is a tactical wargame from the creators of the Ultimate General series set amidst the epic naval campaigns in the period of the American Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars.

name: White Sands
short_description: As a commander of the Union, a semi state organization with military and research potential, your goal is to help humanity rebuild. Modern military technology will give you an edge over the bandits, but the task will be far from an easy one.

name: Morkull Ragast's Rage
short_description: A 2D video game that combines platforming and action with a touch of exploration in which we control Morkull, God of death and darkness and lord of the Ragast, whose main mechanics lies in the breaking of the fourth wall, which will allow Morkull to communicate with the player in various ways.

name: DragonRideVR
short_description: Become a DragonRider! DragonRideVR is an interactive fantasy experience with 7 fun game modes that immerse you into 10 stunning magical worlds.Fly your own dragon or choose from a variety of preset rides, shoot targets and balloons or, swing your swords to the beat of the music in RhythmRide!

name: Super Mega Baseball: Extra Innings
short_description: Tight controls and a smooth learning curve will have you knocking it out of the park in no time in this awesome arcade baseball simulator. Polygon’s 2014 Sports Game of the Year.

name: Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl
short_description: A silly multiplayer party game, Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl brings festive cheer with battles and mini-games matched with absurd weapons. Compete against friends and roast them with a flamethrower and slap them with a GIANT FISH. Jump into this hilarious holiday-themed brawling mayhem today!

name: Teddy's Haven - A Fantasy Inspired Shop Simulator
short_description: Teddy’s Haven is a cozy shop sim filled with magic and charm. Sell over 400 items, decorate with 250+ decorations, and create the shop of your dreams. Meet mythical creatures, level up your skills, harvest the land, and uncover the peaceful wonders of life on Ursa.

name: Memorial Park of Hypoxia
short_description: Build your own piece of cemetery. Make it a place to memorize your dear ones or honor yourself.

name: GROUND BRANCH
short_description: From one of the developers behind the original Rainbow Six® and Ghost Recon® games, comes a thinking-man's first-person shooter featuring in-depth character and weapon customization. Take your time. Think ahead. Get the job done.

name: Hunting fields of Jackals
short_description: Drive various of real-world military vehicles that armed with real-world heavy weapons, racing and fighting against other players in a unique PVP+PVE survival mode.

name: Meow Motors
short_description: Meet the kitties, the heroes of the new go-kart racing game! Overcome obstacles on the tracks, evade mines and bombs, blast your competitors with bubble gum and other awesome weapons to stop or slow them down. And don’t forget to collect power-ups on the way to be the fastest driver on the track.

name: DO NOT OPEN
short_description: DO NOT OPEN is a terrifying short and paced first-person escape-room experience, based on randomness in puzzle combinations, and classic survival-horror mechanics. Each game will contain different rooms and puzzle combination, being different to solve.

name: Ghostlore
short_description: Ghostlore is an 'Eastpunk' Action-RPG where you fight supernatural monsters from Southeast-Asian folklore. Inspired by classic ARPGs such as Diablo 2 and Titan Quest, Ghostlore features detailed item and character customization systems, procedurally generated maps, and awesome 90's retro graphics.

name: Threefold Recital
short_description: Threefold Recital is set in an oriental fantasy world where the metropolis of Bluescales faces turmoil after a long golden age. The mix of magic, modern, and ancient technologies challenges governance, while tensions between humans, beastlings, and dragons grow. In the shadows, a crisis looms...

name: Wrath of Anna
short_description: You've been stranded on Empress Anna's remote planet of Drumgore during the Cross-Planetary War of 2021. How long can you survive?

name: Champions of Odin
short_description: As war plagues The Nine Worlds, mighty Odin faces the biggest challenge of his life - tracking down the soul of his murdered wife.

name: Made Marion
short_description: A romantic action-adventure visual novel based on Robin Hood lore. Play as Lady Marion and choose what kind of leader and lover you want to become. Join Robin's rowdy rebels in Sherwood or tackle the political pitfalls of the Sheriff's Nottingham. Fight for freedom and fall in love!

name: Trigger Witch
short_description: Trigger Witch is a 2D, twin-stick, action/adventure game set in an odd open world where magic is mundane, but firearms are the new unknown! You are Colette, and as you graduate from the Stock, a curious man invades your world... Welcome to the world of Witchcraft and Triggery!

name: Reimei no Gakuen - Otome/Visual Novel
short_description: A visual novel of modern-day fantasy, bonds, and a mystery that brings misery to the children born with a strange power.

name: HATCHICK
short_description: The game begins in the middle of the room where a chick is in a deep sleep, when a butterfly flies into the room from no where. Flaps of the butterfly awakens the chick. The chick begins to fly with the help of the butterfly. But before long, enemies are appearing with an attempt to make the chick fall into a sleep again.

name: Back To Ashes
short_description: Explore alternative realities while trying to save Your own from approaching annihilation. Dark fantasy rpg action game which will take You on a journey deep into the realms of Errent.

name: IS -Infinite Stratos- Versus Colors
short_description: High-speed 3D action battler! Control the world's strongest powered exoskeleton in Infinite Stratos and aim for the top! Manipulate the varios IS! Master an array of equipment!

name: Rogue Slime
short_description: Rogue Slime: An engaging isometric 2D roguelike adventure where you maneuver a slime character through dynamic dungeons, utilizing slime ball attacks and a variety of power-ups to overcome diverse enemies and evolving challenges.

name: Majikoi! Love Me Seriously!
short_description: Follow Yamato and his friends as they navigate the friendships, rivalries, and martial arts of Kawakami Academy.

name: Algor PEW PEW
short_description: One day, invaders from the other world attacked and kidnapped all ARPs. Your mission is to travel through parallel worlds, enjoy the rhythms, rescue the ARPs and survive until end. Let us dive you into the first rogue-lite survival game from Algorhythm Project.

name: Hotel Architect
short_description: Step into the shoes of a hotel owner as you design, build, and manage grand hotels around the world. Juggle demanding guests, frantic logistics, and plenty of unexpected surprises in Hotel Architect; the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game!

name: ReignMaker
short_description: ReignMaker: Saving the World One Tower at a Time. ReignMaker is a match-3 game with tower defense, city building, and political strategy elements. Your policy decisions determine the fate of your city and the direction of the story. Your match-3 and tower defense skills determine the fate of the world.

name: Pagan: Absent Gods
short_description: Pagan: Absent Gods is a singleplayer fast-paced hack-and-slash action RPG that will challenge your skill in brutal and satisfying combat against countless enemies and larger than life bosses. Master all heroes, each with their own unique playstyle and earn unique rewards.

name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3
short_description: The dramatic RPG Fuga: Melodies of Steel series is now complete!

name: No King No Kingdom
short_description: No King No Kingdom – First-Person Strategy Game. Ride Dragons! Command peasants! Build towns! Raise Armies! Tame Epic Creatures! Take your own sword and fight side by side with your troops against powerful giant bosses.

name: Fabulous - New York to LA
short_description: Will Angela's expansion into LA turn into a Walk of Fame, or a Walk of Shame?

name: RP7: Spin Your Own Encounter
short_description: RP7 is a slot-managing roguelike. Spin the reel and beat the odds in this RPG adventure!

name: Xenonauts 2
short_description: Wage a global war of resistance against an alien invasion. Command turn-based tactical battles, build a network of covert bases, directly control your fighter wings, and achieve strategic victory in a simulation of asymmetric warfare against a technologically superior foe.

name: The Frost Rebirth
short_description: First person shooter in which you need to search for weapons, food, equipment and explore the territory of the mountains. There are only two main tasks, survive and find your way home. You need to look for clues that will lead you out of this area.

name: Road Maintenance Simulator 2 - Winter Services
short_description: In Road Maintenance Simulator 2, you take on a variety of authentic tasks that occur every day in a road maintenance depot - now including winter service! Choose from a wide selection of tools, attachments and vehicles to master the challenges ahead.

name: Phantom Halls
short_description: Phantom Halls is a squad-based side-scrolling comedy-horror game. Play as a group of teens as they attempt to survive the night in a haunted mansion. Single-player and local co-op supported!

name: Zombaliens
short_description: Kill aliens in creative ways in this wacky retro FPS featuring non linear, highly interactive maps. Zombaliens blends retro FPS with immersive sim, letting you use anything in your environment against your enemies, while retaining the speed and simplicity of a retro FPS.

name: The Last of Us™ Part I
short_description: Discover the award-winning game that inspired the critically acclaimed television show. Guide Joel and Ellie through a post-apocalyptic America, and encounter unforgettable allies and enemies in The Last of Us™.

name: One More Roll
short_description: One More Roll is a marble game heavily influenced by Super Monkey Ball & Marble Blast. So far the game has 100+ Levels across 7 different worlds with many more to come in the future. Enjoyable both for casual players and hardcore speedrunners.

name: Revive & Prosper
short_description: A complex but not difficult voxel automation game with belts, trains, teleports, and even catapults for transport. Achieve efficiency through smart water control. Play with or without enemies. Produce materials and fuel for a spaceship. Deal with the toxic side effects. Can you Revive & Prosper?

name: ECHOPLEX
short_description: ECHOPLEX is a time-bending puzzle platformer with a full-motion video story. Trapped in a mysterious looping simulation, you are followed by an “Echo” -- a duplicate of yourself who repeats everything you do.

name: Secret of Mana
short_description: The memorable adventure of Randi, Primm and Popoi is reborn as Secret of Mana! Originally released in 1993, Secret of Mana is by far the most popular title in the “Mana” series and has now undergone a much-awaited full 3D remake!

name: ARK: Survival Ascended
short_description: ARK is reimagined from the ground-up into the next-generation of video game technology with Unreal Engine 5! Form a tribe, tame & breed hundreds of unique dinosaurs and primeval creatures, explore, craft, build, and fight your way to the top of the food-chain. Your new world awaits!

name: Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion Remastered
short_description: Finish the hunt in this epic finale to the Turok Trilogy. Pick up immediately after the events of Turok 2: Seeds of Evil, with dual protagonists Joseph and Danielle Fireseed, of the Turok family tree, as they battle the titular antagonist Oblivion and its followers, the Flesh Eaters.

name: Naxia
short_description: Naxia is a brainchild of old school action-RPGs and modern rogue-lites, which means you get to explore a procedurally generated world and master your guardian’s fighting abilities to help them save Naxia from threats far beyond their wildest expectations.

name: Cutlass Call
short_description: A starving pirate crew on a lone ship pins their hopes on the least experienced sailor, sending them ashore to an undiscovered island. Tasked with discovering 31 diverse foods, the rookie navigates the challenges of the island's terrain.

name: Pandoria
short_description: Adventure, creation, and joy in this wonderful world of Pandora

name: Grace Online
short_description: Grace Online is a 3D fantasy MMORPG featuring an immersive experience that allows the players to forge their own paths through exploration and discovery.

name: Punch! ViaCAD 2D/3D v9 + 3D Printing PowerPack LT
short_description: ViaCAD 2D/3D provides a seamless marriage of 2D and 3D design plus 3D printing, verification and preparation tools to help take your ideas to 3D realism.

name: Super Robot Wars 30
short_description: 30 years on, the battle for our world's future continues. Super Robot Wars is a tactical RPG that brings characters and robots from a variety of mecha anime together to battle their mutual foes.

name: Banquet for Fools
short_description: The Pavura needs four volunteers to solve the mystery of an abandoned village. Answer the call to adventure in this party-based beat ‘em up RPG.

name: Heavyarms Assemble: WWII
short_description: This is a strategy game with the theme of WWII. As a battlefield commander, maintaining your army's motivation and satisfaction, promoting your generals, managing your own economy, dealing with your friends' armies, and real time grand battle. What kind of commander will you become in the process?

name: Mori Carta
short_description: Mori Carta is a handless deckbuilding roguelike. Choose left or right on every card to adventure through stories. Simple decisions lead to rich and rewarding gameplay. Four dramatically different characters with their own unique card sets, more than 1000 playable cards, over 185 unique enemies.

name: Kitchen Sync: Aloha!
short_description: Kitchen Sync: Aloha! is a cozy, story-driven cooking RPG. As head chef of your family's restaurant in Hawaii, build a trusty team of chefs and dish up tasty Hawaiian food. Manage kitchens, build friendships, find romance, explore tropical venues, and discover the power of cooking together.

name: Within the Range
short_description: This game is no longer updated, do not buy!! RTS with physical details. Formulate strategies based on terrain and unit characteristics

name: Empire Architect
short_description: Empire Architect is an ancient city-building real time strategy game, with elements from grand strategies sprinkled in for good measure. The levels are procedurally generated, and you have limited control over your subjects

name: Flow Weaver
short_description: You are trapped. Bound by magic by unknown captors. But you are a Flow Weaver and can move between dimensions. Travel amongst them, learn new spells, and uncover the secrets of this strange world to orchestrate your escape.

name: The Mysterious Cities of Gold
short_description: Play Esteban, Zia and Tao through numerous tricky levels full of puzzles, traps and infiltration phases in a wide variety of diverse gorgeous settings. Explore every nook and cranny of China, and escape Zarès’ hostile men, searching for the local City of Gold.

name: Village Monsters
short_description: Village Monsters is a cozy town life game set in a forgotten world. You play as the sole human living in a community of (mostly) friendly monsters.

name: Space Reign
short_description: An indie space-sim and strategy game featuring ship and fleet combat mixed with RTS elements. Complete contracts and Claim sectors for your faction in the near-future, where resource exploiting corporations are in a state of constant conflict over territory control.

name: Racket Club
short_description: Racket Club takes all the fun of tennis or pickleball and puts it in a box to create a brand new racket sport, built from the ground up for VR. Step onto the court and get swingin’!

name: Holiday Jigsaw Halloween 4
short_description: Prepare for Halloween with Holiday Jigsaw Halloween 4. 500 photos means 500 excellent puzzles and ideas for a happy holiday!

name: River Tails: Stronger Together
short_description: River Tails: Stronger Together is a 3D co-op adventure platformer designed around an asymmetrical co-op system. Teammates must work together to defeat end-of-level bosses and solve puzzles across a range of natural-world environments. All you need is communication, coordination and complete trust!

name: First Person Tennis - The Real Tennis Simulator
short_description: First Person Tennis uses the most innovative physics engine to reproduce the real tennis shots in VR. Thanks to the support of a big community and professional tennis players, the game is in an endless development to reach an incredible level of realism.

name: Hunter Moonstrike : Ai NPCs version
short_description: Hunter Moonstrike is the first survival game integrated with artificial intelligence. In this game, all npc have their own unique story and you can see the story of the game from their point of view. Talk to any person, ask any question you like, they will answer and think they are alive

name: Memoranda
short_description: Memoranda is a 2D point and click adventure game inspired by author Haruki Murakami’s surreal short stories.The game tells the story of a young lady who gradually realizes that she is forgetting her own name. But is she really losing her memory?

name: Heart's Medicine - Time to Heal
short_description: An intense, but also funny, medical drama that deals with a lot of life-changing decisions. Become an aspiring surgeon at Little Creek Hospital!

name: Castle of Lord Velimir
