short_description: Take the main role in the epic battle against encroaching darkness. Dark Souls, Super Mario Bros and Warcraft 3 had a baby and it's this game. How did the baby happen, you ask? Well, it was that wild of a party.

name: Space Dance Harmony
short_description: Space Dance Harmony is a VR dance rhythm game where you replicate real dance choreographies with your entire body to play. Immersed in breathtaking environments shaped by the sound and aesthetics of popular dance music, Space Dance Harmony is your space to get free and to dance.

name: Drift Type C
short_description: A multi-discipline real-physics driving game where the ghosts are actual ghosts. Drive 50+ real spec cars right from the factory on 100+ miles of track to free the God of Time. Master Drift, Time Attack, Off-road, Rally, and even a few head to head races against bad AI. Robust Creative Mode.

name: Fractal Alchemist
short_description: Fractal Alchemist is a tool for creating and exploring 3D Fractal Worlds. For this you do not need knowledge of mathematics and programming - the Alchemist will do everything for you.

name: MovieWriterPro
short_description: MovieWriterPro was designed to increase screenplay writing speed without taking care of script formatting.

name: Potionomics
short_description: You’ve inherited your uncle’s potion shop—and a huge debt. Better get brewing! Customize your store, hire heroes to gather ingredients, befriend (or romance) fellow vendors to learn new haggling strategies, and go head-to-head with competitors in this narrative-driven, deck-building shop simulator.

name: TOHU
short_description: Experience a brand new adventure game set amongst a world of weird and wonderful fish planets. Explore beautiful environments, solve intricate puzzles and discover the truth about a mysterious little girl and her mechanical alter-ego, Cubus.

name: Towerborne
short_description: Towerborne is a new kind of Looter Brawler, combining side-scrolling combat with action RPG loot progression and endless customization. Unite with other Aces and defend the Belfry, humanity’s last refuge. Explore, fight, and grow stronger – together.

name: Another Tomorrow
short_description: Another Tomorrow is a first-person point and click game. Trapped without your memories you’ll explore abandoned apartments, airfields, temples, and underground facilities to search for clues, solve puzzles, and unlock secrets to answer the question; who are you?

name: Lucky Tower Ultimate
short_description: Escape from an incredibly dangerous, randomly generated tower in a slapstick, roguelite adventure that looks like a cartoon and feels like a joke. Slashy slashy!

name: Guilty Loving Boxing
short_description: A 3D boxing game featuring female! You can also play mixed gender matches! In addition to choosing characters and rules and fighting, you can also watch CPU vs CPU or train without being counterattacked! Enjoy boxing in various costumes and situations! *Note: This is a single-player game only.

name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops III
short_description: Call of Duty®: Black Ops III Zombies Chronicles Edition includes the full base game plus the Zombies Chronicles content expansion.

name: Steam Marines 2
short_description: Steam Marines 2 leaves you in charge of the I.S.S. Delhi, ready to take back your space station.

name: World Wide Hack
short_description: Reveal company secrets while hacking and exploring their quantum simulation networks. Fights for control with other players, coop with your faction, gather best tools, build most secure servers, write scripts and webs, or choose to be solo hacker who makes the right choices to change the world.

name: Soccer Boss
short_description: Be the Boss of your own soccer club, choosing from clubs from the biggest leagues across Europe. Make decisions based on tactics, training, staff recruitment and player selection. Spend your transfer budget wisely during the transfer window whilst keeping the board satisfied with your performance.

name: Magic War
short_description: Game Features: - Beautiful Pixel Art - Dynamic Music - 30 levels - Hardcore

name: Travellers Rest
short_description: Craft, farm, build and cook! In Travellers Rest you will have to use all the available tools to become the best tavern keeper in the realm. Create unique dishes and drinks to please your customers as you discover the world and its colorful characters.

name: REFUGE
short_description: The third-person singleplayer rogue-like adventure - REFUGE, with an massive, handcrafted open-world and hardcore challenging action. Choose your fighting way through hordes of monsters. Unlock new loot, and find a way to survive and finish that path.

name: Dark Forest: The Horror
short_description: Dark Forest is an adventure horror game in which you have to find a way out of your prolonged sleep. Otherwise, you risk staying in it forever.

name: Baladins
short_description: Embark on a whimsical journey and bring joy to a bright fantasy world in this roleplaying adventure for 1-4 players. Craft your own story and solve quests how you like, but beware, for every time you fail the Dragon will send you back in time!

name: Dawn of the Ashen Queen
short_description: Dawn of the Ashen Queen is a classic grid-based dungeon crawler. Set out with your party to reveal the legacy of a millennia old curse in a narrative-rich experience. Explore the colorful world of Eshavon, unearth its many secrets and fight dangerous foes sent out to stop you in your mission.

name: JUMP KING QUEST
short_description: The most BRUTAL Platforming-Action-Multiplayer-RPG in THE WORLD with NO Game-Over, only falling down… Defy the fiends of The Heights TOGETHER or alone to rise as KING on your Quest to The Smoking Hot Babe at the Top!

name: Doloc Town
short_description: Doloc Town is a cozy pixel-art farming simulation set in a post-apocalyptic world. Build your dream farm from scratch and explore this mysterious wasteland. Harvest, plant, build, and uncover the untold stories of this forgotten land!

name: Realm of Ink
short_description: Realm of Ink is an Ink-style action Roguelite game. While pursuing the Fox Demon, the swordswoman Red, unexpectedly finds that her life is dictated by the 'destiny' within the world of the book. Only by breaking free can she unveil the truth of her existence and challenge the constraints of fate.

name: RTSM
short_description: Take charge of your army and conquer South Africa in this epic RTS game.

name: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game
short_description: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game is a hand animated JRPG adventure that draws from genre classics. Join Jae as he goes on a journey with his best friends to try and fix the past in a story full of laughs, tears, and Elemelons. Engage in silly battles that involve timed hits, meter, and teamwork.

name: DEEP FOG
short_description: Deep Fog is a single-player, 2D horizontal pixel horror/adventure game. Explore the strange events that occurred in Fog City. The game's 5 chapters will be released in phases.

name: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
short_description: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Viking Deities, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

name: Starless Abyss
short_description: Earth has fallen. Science and the Occult have united forces to brace for the arrival of the Eldritch. But will the efforts against this strange, alien race be enough? Play as one of many Proximae used to help defend humanity in this turn-based, roguelike, intergalactic deck builder.

name: SpaceKraft!
short_description: Gather crystals, repair/run crafting facilities, upgrade your spaceship, build machines, explore the open world, find your way back to mother earth.

name: Momodora: Moonlit Farewell
short_description: 'Momodora: Moonlit Farewell' is the latest installment in the Momodora series. Join Momo, High Priestess of the village of Koho, as she embarks on a divine mission to save her people from imminent destruction at the hands of the demon hordes summoned by a malevolent bellringer.

name: Sorcs: Siege Chronicles
short_description: Sorcs: Siege Chronicles is an indie 3D tower defense with: - Free positioning for towers - FPS mode - Configurable AI for towers - 4 skill trees - 25 levels with 3 difficulty modes - 20-25 hours to complete 100%

name: Move 78
short_description: Uncover the mystery behind each of the group's hidden motives and lost memories. What brings them together? What happened to the outside world, and who is The Botfly Killer that haunts their nightmares?

name: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead
short_description: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead is a single-player horror adventure game inspired by the critically acclaimed blockbuster movie franchise. Survive in silence.

name: Bionic Bay
short_description: A scientist uses a unique teleportation instrument to escape an ancient biomechanical world filled with imaginative technology, deadly traps, and hidden secrets.

name: Welcome to Maison Chichigami
short_description: Deep in the mountains, there is said to be a legendary hot spring: called the Spirit Spring. Becoming lost on the way to the spring, you are rescued by a mysterious, reclusive family. But what secrets does this family hide away in their manor?

name: Mollycoddle Mayhem
short_description: Mollycoddle Mayhem is a couch co-op game for up to four players where you work together to spoil and pamper babies that have been anonymously abandoned. Cook, clean, change diapers, and perform various other tasks before the little ones get too upset.

name: TOLD GOD - The legacy of cthulhu
short_description: This is a Cthulhu theme survival adventure game. You can play Vincent, the descendant of the survivors in 'The call of Cthulhu', and a mysterious woman of unknown identity, in a island in the South Pacific Ocean, experiencing the thrilling adventure that makes human beings become 'originer'.

name: Vain Riser
short_description: 'Vain Riser' is an AVG developed by Team Strrationalism. In the game, girls gather in the Victorian coastal town 'Gloden Sand Town' to realize their dream of flying into the blue sky step by step.

name: Traveler's Refrain
short_description: Wield your magical instrument and defy the mecha-goddesses of fate in this Song-Casting Story Driven Action-RPG. Explore a forbidden forest as Traveler. Help him reunite with his long lost love as you fight through abominations and solve mysterious puzzles, all while an ancient conflict unfolds.

name: Chroma Shift
short_description: CHROMA SHIFT is a cooperative, side-scrolling puzzle game, where the players utilize different colours throughout the environment to solve challenging puzzles. Players must uncover the secrets of the past and find a way to restore power to their home

name: Master of Chess
short_description: Play chess with help from your AI character, solve chess puzzles, build an unrivaled openings repertoire, and win tournaments worldwide. Become World Champion in the first and only chess career simulator!

name: AirportSim
short_description: AirportSim is an Advanced Airport Ground Handling Simulator with true-to-life visuals and operations, licensed planes and vehicles, real airports and live weather conditions. Enjoy the many tasks alone or with friends, making this experience unforgettable.

name: Tales from The Dancing Moon
short_description: Tales from the Dancing Moon is a life-sim RPG set in a parallel universe inspired by UK culture and fantasy novels. After the events of a shadow-beast invasion on a seaside town, complete villager quests and collect hidden diaries to understand your role in this mysterious character-driven story.

name: Pumpkin Days
short_description: Pumpkin Days is a traditional farming RPG. Pick one of three towns to start your farming adventure. Farm, fish, mine, catch bugs, raise animals, and more. Help fill out the museum to stop a factory from being built on the island. Unless you wish to side with the factory. The choice is yours.

name: Predestination
short_description: Predestination is a turn-based sci-fi 4X game set in the distant past of our own galaxy. Ships from countless races are flung back in time by a powerful hostile race known as the Revenants, and must now work to rebuild their empires and somehow stop the Revenants in the past.

name: Blades of Jianghu: Ballad of Wind and Dust
short_description: 'Blades of Jianghu: Ballad of Wind and Dust' is a single-player game that combines text adventure with turn-based combat and exploration. As someone aspiring to become a great hero, your journey through the martial arts world will not always be a solo endeavor.

name: The Fight Of Escaper
short_description: Humanity has lost sight of itself, blinded by the false prosperity of AI development. You, the protagonist, begin to break free from AI control to uncover the truth of this world. Torn between escaping and erasing your memory, you yearn to leave this city of mechas and reach the shores of freedom.

name: Unknown Number: A First Person Talker
short_description: An innovative voice-controlled adventure game, played through a series of interactive 'phone calls'. Join the heist and save the world... using nothing but your voice. Will you answer the call? *WARNING: THIS GAME CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS*

name: shapez 2
short_description: Dive into a factory-building game with the focus on just that – building huge space factories! Construct sprawling multi-level factories and satisfying production lines without limits. Tackle increasingly complex automation challenges at your own pace – you won’t have to worry about enemies.

name: Re:BF
short_description: When a world is overwhelmed by new monsters, it's up to a single apprentice adventurer to set out on a quest and bring peace back to the land in this JRPG with fully animated combat!

name: Fallen Worlds
short_description: Challenge the immortal god alongside a colorful cast of heroes in this co-op action rogue-lite, where you'll battle endlessly across Fallen Worlds in hopes of one day destroying the God that took everything from you.

name: Cerulean Days
short_description: On a seemingly idyllic island, the Internet is shut down. What will become of those unable to adapt? In 2018, a lethal biological attack claims a significant number of lives. While tragedy occupies people's minds to the brim, a controlling governmental plan is put into effect.

name: My Mad Scientist Roommate Turned Me Into Her Personal Robotic Battle Maiden?!?
short_description: After being inadvertantly transformed into a robotic battle maiden by their criminally insane roommate, Sam is dragged along on a ridiculous adventure in a dimension full of ravenous monster girls. Will Sam find a way out of this mess and return to their original body? Probably not, but who knows!

name: Gotham Knights
short_description: Batman is dead. It is now up to the Batman Family - Batgirl, Nightwing, Red Hood, and Robin - to protect Gotham City.

name: Business War: ERP Sandbox Simulation
short_description: A compulsory course in the School of Economics and Management at the university, featuring a super hardcore simulation business game. You will play the role of the chairman of a startup company, participate in market competition, and utilize limited resources to ensure the survival of your enterprise in the fierce market competition.

name: Inhuman Resources: A Literary Machination
short_description: A literary machination about corporations, conspiracies, and the unspeakable horrors you’ll commit for minimum wage.

name: Smirkers
short_description: This is a happy simple game.

name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 9 Empires
short_description: A new release in the Empires series, featuring a mix of thrilling action and country capturing simulation. Experience the human drama of the Three Kingdoms in a way only Empires can provide. Fight exciting Castle Sieges and manipulate the country's Politics. Welcome to the Empires experience!

name: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS
short_description: The beloved block-building RPG, DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS, is bringing its handy crafting features to Steam! Weave your own tale as you build your own unique buildings and towns to restore Alefgard to it's former glory!

name: Goliath
short_description: Welcome to a mysterious world filled with strange creatures, giant monsters and warring factions. You won't last long here on your own. Fortunately, you know how to build giant robots! Find the plans, gather the resources, climb inside your giant robotic creation and start punching monsters in the face!

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky - Enhanced Edition
short_description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky is the prequel chapter of the Legends of the Zone Trilogy. With the ability to directly influence the balance of power through Faction Wars, step into the boots of Scar — a seasoned mercenary, able to somehow survive deadly Emissions.

name: Counter Operation Online
short_description: Counter Operation Online ( COO ) revived by the hurricane team game COO, includes maps, weapons, game modes, as well as an incredibly realistic confrontation with terrorists.

name: Pixel Art Academy: Learn Mode
short_description: Learn how to draw pixel art with a video game! Start from zero and develop real art skills in a relaxing way. Complete interactive tutorials, draw pixel art sprites, and play the games you create. Everyone can do this!

name: Persona 5 Tactica
short_description: Join the Phantom Thieves as they lead an uprising of the heart! Assemble an all-star team of heroes in a brand-new story in this thrilling combat adventure set in Persona’s iconic universe.

name: Mysteries of the Undead
short_description: Demystify the zombie island and break the ancient curse!

name: Minds of Nations
short_description: Grand Strategy Game. How does reincarnation affect the evolution of a state ? Control the material well-being of your country with a backbone of spiritual growth. Religion. Economy. Diplomacy. War. Souls. Karma. Ideology. Tech. Stories. Single-Player. MMO.

name: Gardener: Master of Trees and Flowers
short_description: Cultivate unique gardens, timelapse seeds to blooming orchards in seconds, design procedurally generated plants, nurture ecosystems and discover rare genetic traits in wild flora, to create ultimate species, in state-of-the-art botanical simulation.

name: Interkosmos 2000
short_description: Go to space. Save the Future. Try not to Die. Welcome (back) to the world of Interkosmos for an even wilder, weirder and more wondrous adventure.

name: Dungeon Mercenaries
short_description: Dungeon Mercenaries is an endless replayability RPG. Every time you wake up, it's a new start, procedurally generated map, randomly generated characters,explore the dungeon with different mercenaries, get reasure chests, gold coins, mercenaries, potions, food, and glory!

name: Adopted Passion Realize Your Dream
short_description: Enjoy a massive first-person adventure to become the greatest racer ever!!! Buy, collect, build, personalize and maintain your vehicles with hundreds of parts to achieve maximum style and performance! All while trying to survive the elements of life's daily requirements.

name: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC)
short_description: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) brings one chapter of the series to a close. Travel to exciting new Disney and Pixar worlds, and prepare for the final showdown.

name: Valiant
short_description: Valiant is a first person shooter game. Currently in development using Unreal Engine 5.2.

name: Citadel Stormer 2
short_description: Blast your way through a world of deadly robots and monstrous machines in this explosive run-and-gun action platformer inspired by '90s classics!

name: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
short_description: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue features 3 magical experiences, all leading up to KINGDOM HEARTS III.

name: War of Wizards
short_description: Draw & cast your spells! Sharpen your magic skills with other players in VR! War of Wizards is a competitive VR MOBA game, where you fight in battles with other players by drawing magic spells. The bigger and more accurate you draw them, the stronger they are!

name: Apocryph: an old-school shooter
short_description: Apocryph is an old-school fantasy shooter inspired by Hexen, Heretic, Painkiller and Strife.

name: The Gallery - Episode 2: Heart of the Emberstone
short_description: Embark on the sci-fi epic that started it all at the dawn of modern VR, setting standards for roomscale movement and interaction for years to come. Winner of over 30 awards including 'VR Game of the Year', The Gallery is VR's premier adventure series.

name: First Dwarf
short_description: Pilot a dwarven mech and fly a dragon as you build and defend outposts across a shattered magical realm. Craft, explore, and survive the dangers of floating islands corrupted by the Taint in this action-packed survival RPG with base-building and co-op.

name: Police Scanner Radio - Real Live Audio - Happening Now!
short_description: Police Scanner Radio gameplay is free world racing and exploration behind the wheel of a luxury sports car while listening to Police Scanner Radio live audio feeds of real police and fire radio streams!Drive your luxury sports car to find easter eggs and hidden surprises.

name: Gold Hunter
short_description: Have you always dreamed of searching for gold? Then start your own adventure now - alone or together with friends. Explore a huge map and dig for gold using a variety of methods, vehicles and wash plants.

name: Tactical AR
short_description: Tactical AR is a training platform for firearms skills in virtual reality. We make training engaging, and accessible to help individuals be prepared to protect life.

name: Pro Strategy Football 2023
short_description: NOT THE LATEST VERSION - Be sure to also look for Pro Strategy Football 2024!

name: Nikoderiko: The Magical World — Director’s Cut
short_description: Jump into adventure in Nikoderiko: The Magical World - Director's Cut, a love letter to platformers! Play in single-player or couch co-op, and enjoy 8 colorful worlds, classic platforming challenges, and music by legendary composer David Wise.

name: Citizens Unite!: Earth x Space
short_description: Unite the Citizens to save the timeline in a hilarious action-packed adventure!

name: DEAD
short_description: They who control the beast, control the land.

name: Sea of Thieves: 2025 Edition
short_description: Sea of Thieves is a smash-hit pirate adventure game, offering the quintessential pirate experience of plundering lost treasures, intense battles, vanquishing sea monsters and more. Dive in with this revised edition of the game, which includes access to digital bonus media.

name: Get Together: A Coop Adventure
short_description: Two lost beings and you are the only bond... Play with a friend to guide and reunite them on their journey in this communication-based coop puzzle adventure. You play on two devices with no connection except your voice!

name: Ruff Ghanor
short_description: Ruff Ghanor is a Deckbuilder game with Roguelite elements, where each collected card represents a crucial action in your journey. Build the perfect deck, strategize, and create powerful synergies as you progress to face your destiny.

name: Stay Out of the House
short_description: Can you escape the home of a cannibal serial killer? It's only a matter of time until you're dinner!

name: Versus.
short_description: Fight side by side with your friend against a rival team or let your friend be your worst enemy! Check your skills on your own statistics. Modify your weapons according to your own specifications and test them on your shooting range!

name: Alnico Smithery
short_description: Alnico Smithery is a hand-drawn, physics-based forging simulator. Mine for ore, smelt ingots, discover alloys, forge tools, and rebuild the smithery your grandfather left behind.

name: Airlock Arena: Profit or Perish
short_description: Strap in, space slugs! Join forces with up to three buddies in this chaotic multiplayer roguelike. Dodge treacherous asteroid fields, outsmart the authorities, and secure precious cargo. Survival is optional, profit is mandatory. Are you ready to risk it all for the ultimate haul?

name: TOGETHER BnB
short_description: Through the development of the plot in the game, you will gradually cultivate feelings and trust with female tenants, and gradually develop a deeper and intimate romantic relationship, but the crisis behind will also emerge gradually...

name: Muspell
short_description: Muspell is a fantasy sandbox where you build your fortress and fight monsters in an infinite procedural world made of blocks. Collect loot and improve your base to unlock better equipment from random daily merchants.

name: Jurisdiction
short_description: Take control of a metropolitan police department and run it your way. Recruit, train, and equip officers, then send them to the streets to fight crime and keep peace in the city of Freemont.

name: Old Retro Shooter
short_description: A shooter inspired by old shooters like Doom, Heretic.

name: Princess Evangile All Ages Version
short_description: This romantic visual novel has you joining a financially struggling all-girls' private school as one student's example case for gender integration. The two of you try to prove that going co-ed could save the school, while the story explores themes of traditions, change, family, and relationships.

name: Immortal Legacy: The Jade Cipher
short_description: Delve deep into the origins of a sinister Chinese legend, and unearth the secrets of an island’s forgotten past in this pulse-pounding adventure.

name: Fast and Low
short_description: Fast and Low is a VR Tactical Shooter mixed with a traditional FPS. Players can play solo, locally via asymmetric multiplayer or play together online to breach rooms, neutralize hostiles, and rescue civilians. 'Cause when the bad guys gotta go...you gotta hit 'em Fast...and you gotta hit 'em Low.

name: SimAirport
short_description: Build & Manage Your Airport. An International Hub or a Regional Masterpiece -- it's up to you. Buy more land to scale out, or escalators to scale up with MULTIPLE FLOORS. You're in full control in this modern business management tycoon!

name: TRANSFORMERS: EARTHSPARK - Expedition
short_description: Battle and explore as courageous Autobot, Bumblebee, in an exciting action adventure to stop his nemesis, Mandroid, from becoming the ultimate evil cyborg.

name: Find Me: Horror Game
short_description: 'The malign spirits always try to manifest themselves'. Host one of these demons through its summoning. Does finishing the ritual is the solution to your problems? 3:00 AM, the ritual begins; hide out and survive to the hide and seek game with a possessed doll. Do you dare to play?

name: Axon Hero
short_description: Axon Hero is more than just a puzzle game - it's a creative playground where logic meets imagination. Build, code, and conquer your way through many hand-crafted challenges, each one more mind-bending than the last.

name: Singularity Survivors
short_description: Survive in the heart of a post-apocalyptic realm where the very essence of survival is put to the test in a vast, open-world environment. An independent Multiplayer game that demands will, and strategy, you’re not just fighting to live — you’re crafting a new world from the ashes of the old.

name: Nevermind
short_description: Nevermind ushers you into dark and surreal worlds within the minds of trauma patients. When played with supported biofeedback technology, Nevermind picks up on indications of fear—lashing out if you allow your feelings of anxiety to get the better of you.

name: Pets & Stuff
short_description: Pets & Stuff – a cute, fun and relaxing game where you become a skilful groomer and veterinarian using a variety of tools, meds and stylish accessories. Let your imagination run wild!

name: Psycho Patrol R
short_description: FPS/mecha hybrid europolice sim with emphasis on interacting with NPCs and different gameplay systems.

name: The Inner Friend
short_description: Descend into an eerie world made of scattered memories and unresolved traumas and explore a nightmarish landscape where you will come face to face with childhood fears and nightmares.

name: Junkyard Builder
short_description: In Junkyard Builder, you’re the proud owner of a once-forgotten junkyard, now brimming with endless potential. Dive into the satisfying world of restoration, recycling, and raw hustle as you transform trash into treasure and rise to become the ruler of the junk empire!

name: Devil's Deck
short_description: It is a Roguelike card game which owns interesting honeycomb and original combat rules. Whether adventures or combats, have rich variety of options.

name: Marauders
short_description: Marauders is a tactical first-person multiplayer looter shooter set in a sci-fi universe. As a space pirate, work solo, or in a squad with up to 3 other players to navigate a hostile battleground, hunt for loot, craft new weapons and gear, and salvage what you’ll need to survive.

name: Lake Ridden
short_description: Lake Ridden is a story-driven, first-person puzzle game! A cozy supernatural adventure where you unravel a mysterious past, trying to find your sister. Luckily, you are not alone...

name: Lord of Dwarves
short_description: Gather resources, craft weapons, and build a castle. Then defend your castle against monsters who will try to siege, sap, and smash their way in. All in a procedurally generated 3D block world that allows for extensive crafting and total construction and destruction of the terrain.

name: Tales of Cosmos
short_description: Tales of Cosmos is an old-school point-and-click adventure game set in a huge open world planetary system. Pilot your rocket across space, land on planets and moons, solve puzzles, and unravel a cosmic mystery with the help of a genius monkey and a wondrous talking dog.

name: Wild Game Hunter VR
short_description: Grab your rifle, get outdoors, and bag some wild game! In this immersive virtual reality hunting experience, you'll get only a few chances for the perfect shot. Dropped into a 360 degree woodland, you're surrounded by critters & nature while you play through multiple levels hunting for *wild game*!

name: Silica
short_description: Silica blends FPS and RTS in epic, photorealistic battles. Choose to fight on the ground or command from above as humans or aliens. Dive into thrilling multiplayer combat or master strategic command. Are you ready to survive and conquer?

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat - Enhanced Edition
short_description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat follows the story of special service agent Major Degtyarev as he investigates the fate of a lost expedition.

name: Dungeon Inn
short_description: This is a cozy strategy management game where you manage an inn placed cleverly at the mouth of a dungeon. Juggle visits and business from 2 rivaling guilds, maximize profits, but keep your double-dealing a secret! Keep everyone happy and watch your inn thrive!

name: COVID Kawaii!
short_description: COVID Kawaii! is the cutest pandemic tower defense this side of the partition glass. Using the power of common sense and cleaning products, defend your personal space from the oncoming virus hoard. Can you go the social distance?

name: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord
short_description: A strategy/action RPG. Create a character, engage in diplomacy, craft, trade and conquer new lands in a vast medieval sandbox. Raise armies to lead into battle and command and fight alongside your troops in massive real-time battles using a deep but intuitive skill-based combat system.

name: Going Medieval
short_description: Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.

name: Creature Keeper
short_description: Creature Keeper is an action-adventure RPG where you Befriend Creatures and fight alongside them in real time. Explore a mysterious world and uncover the truth behind a strange sickness spreading across the land. Power up your team, fill out your Bestiary, and embark on your journey of destiny!

name: Captain of Industry
short_description: Land your crew of survivors on an abandoned island and survive! Mine raw materials, grow food, build factories, manufacture products, research new tech, and trade with others. Become an industrial superpower! But this is no easy task, you will be put to the test to keep your settlement alive.

name: Cave Runner
short_description: It's not just 'another game,' it's a challenge, and I'm throwing it to you!

name: BouncyBoi in Puzzle Land
short_description: A colourful tile based puzzler, now with added bounce!

name: Magic Blast VR
short_description: 'Have you ever wanted to fight with magic?' 'Magic Blast VR' is an action game to fight with magic in VR! In this game you can create original magic, and fights a lot of enemies. This game features 'Magic Form' system. It can set your own form and shoot magic!

name: Touhou: Dreamland of Infinity
short_description: 'Help construct my dreamland, and you can take away an artifact of your choice from the dream...' To help Doremy Sweet, the Master of the Dreamland, use different Gensokyo girls and their magnificent projectiles to face the challenges of the endless challenges!

name: Songs of Silence
short_description: Lead armies, rebuild fallen kingdoms, and rise to greatness! Embark on an epic journey of strategy in an Art Nouveau-inspired fantasy world. Fight intense battles and uncover a captivating story.

name: Dr. Dungeon's MADMAN!
short_description: Dr. Dungeon's MADMAN! is a large old-school fantasy RPG that features turn-based combat with a strange new world to explore, with towns, dungeons, forests, deserts, swamps and great icy regions.

name: Hell Road VR
short_description: Turn your motorcycle into a beast made for mass slaughter and equip yourself with an arsenal of varied weapons to make your way through the hordes of enemies that will cross your path! Throughout your experience, you will face increasingly intense challenges with Irene as your sole objective.

name: Time Hacker
short_description: Time Hacker is an addictive VR game where your creative ability is what gets you through the levels. Your only weapon is the power to stop time. That means, like Marvel’s Quicksilver, you can enjoy playing with the scene while your enemies are effectively frozen.

name: Bounty: Drag Racing
short_description: Bounty: Drag Racing is the most complete online drag racing experience on the market. Race the fastest and most varied types of dragsters in the world. Customize and fine tune your cars to achieve maximum performance and hop online for the closest type of racing!

name: Hookbots
short_description: CRAFT BOTS & BATTLE FRIENDS! 99 ways to customize your bots & 14 game modes. From knights and dinosaurs, to bounty hunters and space warriors. Choose, customize and crush tons of different bots.

name: Pixel Game Maker Series MEDIUM-NAUT
short_description: There is no right answer to choose. Will you be able to solve the mystery of the crashed pioneer ship?

name: A Fox and His Robot
short_description: Become a fox and escape the grip of powerful Artificial Intelligences in a 2D action-platformer. A young fox and his robot search for meaning in a beautiful yet dangerous world.

name: Dig Deep: Race To The Core!
short_description: It's about to go down! All the way down! Challenge your friends and see who'll come out on top as you race to the centre of the Earth through a series of chaotic puzzles and challenges!

name: World of Motors
short_description: The World of Motors. game designed to suit your requirements. The new challenge makes you collect money to buy new cars and unlock new levels.

name: Azuran Tales: Trials
short_description: Azuran Tales: Trials offers challenging combat, beautiful levels and merciless enemies to overcome. Journey across the World of Azuran as you discover its many environments, lore and history in a game that blends platformers with RPG elements.

name: Sigh of the Abyss
short_description: Embrace the monster within in this dark fantasy visual novel with inclusive romances. Befriend charming allies, defy bitter rivals, fall in love. Your choices will save or condemn mortals, shaping the fate of a city as beautiful as it is cruel.

name: Fleeting Iris: Alansya Chronicles Ren'Py Edition
short_description: Ayame travels to Heaven City, USA to be with her fiancée but all is not what it seems. How will Ayame's life unfold in this updated release now built in Ren'Py!

name: BAYANI - Fighting Game
short_description: BAYANI is a 1-on-1, indie fighting game that is heavily inspired by the Philippines’ rich history, culture, and mythology. The game features a combination of 2D fighting and full 3D graphics and simplified 6 button controls with fast-paced gameplay.

name: The First Berserker: Khazan
short_description: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pell Los Empire, who overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

name: Franchise Hockey Manager 3
short_description: Franchise Hockey Manager 3 is the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy game you can find! Now officially licensed by the NHL®, so you can take the reins of your favorite franchise, FHM3 includes real 2016-2017 rosters for 22 playable leagues, a new gameplay mode that makes the game much more approachable, and tons of other new...

name: Director Simulator
short_description: You, who lack talent, always have strange dreams. Until one day, all kinds of beautiful women from dreams entered your life one by one. You will experience an unprecedented legendary journey from a first person perspective.

name: Annwn: the Otherworld
short_description: Annwn is an abstract stealth strategy game of tension and relief, across a series of mysterious procedural islands.

name: POPUCOM
short_description: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

name: Monster High™ Skulltimate Secrets™
short_description: Save Monster High and join the Boo Crew by creating your authentic monster self in this spooktacular mystery adventure!

name: New ZhaoYun
short_description: Our Zhao Yun will take you to a brand new world, truly realizing that people play games instead of playing games with people. Our main focus is on making my own game! I hope the new version will bring you more fun!

name: Dungeon Kingdom: Sign of the Moon
short_description: Dungeon Kingdom: Sign of the Moon is a modern real-time dungeon crawling RPG. Immerse yourself in a fantastic adventure in the lands of Pohe Fakesys and investigate the cause of the returning chaos and darkness.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 8
short_description: Plan your next game night! Jackbox Games is back with 5 hilarious new party games including Drawful Animate, Job Job, The Poll Mine, Weapons Drawn, and The Wheel of Enormous Proportions.

name: Golf Pro VR
short_description: Golf Pro VR is a fun and challenging golf game built from the ground up for virtual reality and motion controls. Practice your game by hitting targets at the driving range or roam the rolling fairways while playing 18 holes.

name: Orbital Strike VR
short_description: Orbital Strike VR is a tactical space combat sim that places you and up to 3 friends as pilots for Starfall's forward fleet. Fly through space using unique hand-jet thrusters, command powerful fire support, and open a path for your capital ships in this thrilling sci-fi adventure.

name: RetroRealms Arcade
short_description: The RetroRealms Arcade connects select RetroRealms games with other titles in the series that you own (games and DLC sold separately) to unlock new access and abilities and create the ultimate mash-up of horror legends!

name: Heart's Medicine - Hospital Heat
short_description: The long awaited sequel to 'Heart's Medicine - Time to Heal'. An intense, but also funny, medical drama that deals with a lot of life-changing decisions. Become an aspiring doctor at Little Creek Hospital!

name: Pursuer
short_description: You are a pursuer, and your job is to catch a criminal who has more than 20 victims.

name: Slime Dungeon
short_description: Slime Dungeon: 2D action-adventure. Play as Gubby, duck warrior. Save world from evil slugs. Find artifacts, beat bosses. Unforgettable smiley-faced slime battles.

name: Holoception
short_description: HOLOCEPTION is a new type of hybrid VR game allowing you to incarnate a character in 3rd and 1st person view. Explore a cartoonish Universe where everything is fully physics-based and where you have a lot of control and freedom to move and fight!

name: Halls of Watershot
short_description: A deck-building ARPG in a dark fantasy setting. Find powerful items, wield elemental magic, and battle dangerous monsters as you explore a dark and twisted castle. Combines the decision making and variety of a card game, with the fast paced combat of an ARPG.

name: Eternal end
short_description: This is a space exploration game.

name: Upside-Down Dimensions
short_description: Upside-Down Dimensions is a highly visual game that combines action, hack n slash, RPG, stealth, platform and puzzles to create a unique and amazing gameplay experience. Play as two characters separated into different dimensions. Flip between these worlds to stop the nefarious Dark Shogun.

name: Real Anime Situation! DT
short_description: I’m Shun, and I have a talent for crushing romance flags—in real life! Featuring even more eye-popping art, nuanced animations, plus a fresh-faced cast of DT-obsessed heroines, this Moe Game Awards-winning comedy franchise also received its own hit anime adaptation.

name: Door Kickers 2: Task Force North
short_description: Command military Special Ops Teams in gripping tactical combat against a Middle East-based terrorist network. Sequel to RockPaperShotgun's 'Best Tactics Game of 2014'.

name: Mini-Market Simulator VR
short_description: Run your own mini-market, starting from a humble corner shop and growing into a bustling retail hub. Stock shelves, assist customers, and manage your store in an immersive VR environment.

name: Abatron
short_description: Abatron is a multiplayer action strategy shooter. It's galactic dominance with controlled combat. First build your base and troops in Commander mode. Then jump into any unit at any time in First Person or in Third Person mode and confront your enemy head on.

name: Ascent - The Space Game
short_description: Ascent is a PVE sandbox space MMO with 270 BILLION star systems and an emphasis on strong Sci Fi. It encourages Exploration, Colonization, Research, Asteroid mining, Farming, Trading, and Combat. Outside the tutorial sector, everything in-game has been built by players.

name: Galactic Federation
short_description: Classical 3D space combat simulation with unique 100% dynamic destruction engine, allows you to realistically damage and burn through your enemies exactly where you hit them with blasters, causing their onboard systems and armor to melt away and fall apart. Made by solo developer.

name: Last Kids on Earth: Hit the Deck!
short_description: The Monster-Zombie Apocalypse means no homework, no parents, and no rules! Become zombie-fighting, monster-bashing heroes in this action-packed rogue-like strategy card game.

name: Derelict (DO NOT BUY)
short_description: DO NOT BUY... A massive Space Station was found after 20 years of being lost, your mission is to walk among the infested interior in order to carry out your mission. Dangers beyond comprehension lurk in the shadows, be ready...

name: CricVRX - VR Cricket
short_description: Virtual Cricket requires real batting talent to play. Ideal for Home and Arcade use.

name: Kitsune Tails
short_description: Run, jump, and dash across a land inspired by Japanese mythology and untangle the love triangle between three young women on a journey of self discovery. Explore the complicated relationships between kitsune and humans through classic platforming action.

name: Codex Lost
short_description: The new open world, spellcasting action-RPG. The grimoires have been stolen, civilisation is in ruins. Rise, Curator! Craft ancient elemental magics and challenge the great lords who threaten to fracture reality itself.

name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition
short_description: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas: It’s the early ’90s. After a couple of cops frame him for homicide, Carl ‘CJ’ Johnson is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

name: Neptunia: Sisters VS Sisters
short_description: With Gamindustri on the brink of destruction, Nepgear and the Candidates must band together and restore order!

name: Gatedelvers
short_description: A dungeon-crawling, world-hopping roguelike adventure! Grab your friends, stick dynamite to your sword, throw candles at your foes and die in various exciting ways!

name: CrisisActionVR
short_description: CrisisActionVR is a multiplayer co-op FPS VR game. Competitive confrontation, team adventure, cooperative survival and a series of different games to meet the FPS VR game different fantasy. Invite your friends, take up arms, fight together!

name: The Lost VR
short_description: The Lost is ultimate FPS VR game. You must defend yourself from enemies with various guns. The Lost is only available in single mode, and you can gradually clear the stages according to the difficulty. Take over best teleport spots and choose proper guns strategically to defeat enemies!

name: Sailing alone:Aftermath
short_description: 'Sailing alone:Aftermath' is a hardcore and realistic post-apocalyptic nautical survival game where players sail ships through an infinitely large and seamless world, explore oceans and lands, play as any character, and write their own life stories.

name: Creature in the Well
short_description: Unlock the power of an ancient facility and face the ominous, all-seeing Creature in this unique pinball-inspired hack & slash!

name: Atomic Space Command
short_description: Manage your ship, build a fleet, and conquer the galaxy with your friends in Atomic Space Command’s solar arena!

name: Thriving City: Song
short_description: In 960 AD, the new Song Dynasty needs you! As magistrate, build a prosperous city from scratch. Develop bustling streets filled with businesses and entertainment, while navigating hidden crises of political strife and foreign invasions. How will you lead through these challenges?

name: River City Girls Zero
short_description: Join Kunio, Riki, Misako, and Kyoko for bone-crunching, 16-bit, co-op beat-'em-up action - newly translated and released outside of Japan after 28 years! The original 1994 graphics, soundtrack, and gameplay are augmented with new motion-comic cutscenes, a new animated intro, and new music!

name: Return from Core
short_description: Mine, build, and explore with Monster Girl companions in this underground sandbox adventure. Uncover lost tech, automate production, and forge bonds with allies as you fight to survive and journey back to the surface.

name: Bookbound Brigade
short_description: Bookbound Brigade is about beating the hell out of historical and literary characters you studied in school by leading a dream team of real and fictional heroes through a 2D side-scrolling platform-adventure.

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat
short_description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat is the direct sequel of the S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl. As a Major Alexander Degtyarev you should investigate the crash of the governmental helicopters around the Zone and find out, what happened there.

name: Win That War!
short_description: Win That War! is a massive scale real-time strategy game, putting thousands of players at the heart of a single campaign of fierce galactic conquest. Discover new planets. Develop your arsenal. Strive to be the best to extend the domination of your corporation.

name: Frozen Synapse 2
short_description: Frozen Synapse 2 is the sequel to the award-winning turn-based tactical game. Command your squads in a vast procedurally generated city: enter any building, perform any mission, execute any strategy.

name: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries
short_description: The year is 3015. The battlefields are dominated by war machines known as BattleMechs. Level entire cities and decimate the enemy in your BattleMech. Follow a quest for glory and revenge. Manage an expanding mercenary company. Fight alongside your friends with a four-player PvE co-op.

name: Anomaly Collapse
short_description: Command a squad of adorably fierce warriors in Anomaly Collapse, a turn-based Roguelite strategy game that offers a fresh twist to an old formula! Face off against otherworldly beings and uncover the dark secrets of supernatural calamities. Immerse yourself in a story where every move counts!

name: HereSphere VR Video Player
short_description: HereSphere is a cutting edge VR video player that enhances immersion. Features include an autofocus depth algorithm, software IPD adjustment, head-tracking, spatial audio, lens distortion and alignment corrections, online video streaming, and video tagging with advanced search features.

name: Adam
short_description: Adam is a realistic sci-fi themed game that combines the Rogue-Like and FPS genres. As a betrayed soldier, the player fights for revenge against his enemies. Enjoy a new genre by killing all enemies in your path with the perfect blend of rogue-like with FPS mechanics.

name: Fairytale Solitaire. Witch Charms
short_description: Solve the most mystical layouts you've ever seen!

name: Hotel Magnate
short_description: Have you ever wanted to design and manage your own hotel, rundown motel, or elegant resort? With a ridiculous amount of customization tools to wield, a host of facilities to build, and a wide variety of guests to impress, Hotel Magnate has it all. Let your inner hotel manager shine!

name: Yarimono
short_description: The protagonist's life takes a turn after their partner Yarimon learns the ultra-invincible move, the 'Cheat Tackle'. While challenging various trainers to participate in the Yarimon tournament, the protagonist unexpectedly discovers the secrets of this world.

name: 3D PUZZLE - Modern House
short_description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

name: LithoBreak
short_description: LithoBreak is a survival factory-builder grounded in real physics and engineering. Build and automate a lunar colony, explore in first-person, and survive constant orbital threats – all while you Play with Science

name: Down and Out
short_description: Fight for fame and fortune! Down and Out is a first-person Brawler blending freestyle combat with seamless open-world exploration in the immersive universe of VR. Fight to survive- and for riches and power- as you rise from nothing to become the undisputed king of the streets!

name: False Myth
short_description: The story is set in the city of Lylan on an isolated island. Everything seems peaceful until a mysterious aura approaches...

name: Battle zombie
short_description: This is a large-scale shooting game with real military battlefields and modern military equipment. Different shooting gameplay challenges your limits!

name: The Eden of Grisaia
short_description: The final chapter in the Grisaia series, featuring The Seed of Blanc Aile, the overarching story's grand conclusion and Prologue De La Grisaia, a prologue set before Yuuji's arrival at Mihama.

name: ELDORANTE
short_description: Shipwrecked on an unfamiliar island with no money or goods to pay for a ride home... What's a merchant to do? Explore the Dungeon and make her way to the golden land of Eldorante, that's what!

name: Kaet Must Die!
short_description: This is the hardest, most challenging, horror puzzle game you will ever play. 30+ hours of sanity-testing puzzles over the course of 10 horror filled levels. You are Kaetheran, an extremely powerful psionicist with a flair for cyberpunk style. You have awoken in a dank sewer without your mind powers.

name: Invercity
short_description: Invercity is a puzzle-platformer that features the action 'Handstand'. A handstand looks like hanging when you look it upside down, doesn't it? This game really makes it look that way. A reporter who loves doing handstands follows a mystery while reporting the 'Invercity Phenomenon” in the city.

name: Gary Grigsby's War in the East 2
short_description: War in the East 2 is the most comprehensive, most realistic, and most advanced wargame modeling Eastern Front warfare in World War Two.

name: Never Stop Sneakin'
short_description: The Department of Sneakin' is the world's most elite stealth agency. Your mission: stop time-traveling master criminal Amadeus Guildenstern.

name: DYSTORIA
short_description: Taking to the stars in this six-axis arcade shooter, your ship flips at every angle, tackling enemies and mazes in a race to be the best that humanity has to offer. Collect the orbs and blast your way through 360° of pure synthwave action. Upgrade your craft and make your mark as the top starfighter of all time.

name: Enspell
short_description: “Enspell” is deck building-RogueLike game based on a medieval fantasy where you unravel secrets and explore to seek treasures. While you fight against monsters in dangerous dungeons, you can collect relics and make your own deck.

name: Primordian
short_description: These are the last days of the first planet, experience a vast ancient world and civilization as you travel through the twisting story mode. Strange and unique weapons, creatures and characters from the dawn of time and beyond.

name: 18 MINUTES
short_description: 18 Minutes is a single player FPS that combines stealthy precision with heart-pounding action. Engage in intense firefights, strategically infiltrate enemy base, and make split- second decision to outmaneuver enemy. Get ready for a gaming experience that offers the best of stealth and FPS action

name: Kardboard Kings: Card Shop Simulator
short_description: Open your own Card shop by the seaside! Buy, trade and sell Cards, OR keep them for your own collection! Earn reputation with customers, beat your shop goals, unlock new decorations, and host exciting events to bring everyone to the best Card shop in town!

name: Go-Go Town!
short_description: Thank god you’re here Mayor - you’ve got LOTS of work to do! In this city building sim, you’re responsible for the layout, logistics optimisation, population growth - all whilst navigating the everyday chaos of infrastructure, worker management and dynamic challenges to make your dream town.

name: Once Upon A Tile
short_description: Once Upon A Tile is a rogue-lite strategic dungeon-builder, where you don't control the hero! Instead, you cleverly place dungeon tiles to guide your hero to victory - or to their demise, if you are careless. You will need to be tricky and clever in this dungeon-building puzzle game!

name: Gal Guardians: Demon Purge
short_description: In order to save their school after it turns into a massive demonic castle, two 'Demon Hunter' sisters slash and shoot their way through this 2D action adventure. Players can swap between control of both characters on the fly, each with entirely different skillsets.

name: Emission VR
short_description: Kill as many zombies, go through as many corridors can be possible. And all this in virtual reality!

name: MahJong
short_description: MahJong generates random tile arrangements that gives you infinite game possibilities for this Chinese-inspired favorite.

name: Hunt the Night
short_description: Hunt the Night is a dark fantasy action-RPG where you play as Vesper, a Stalker fighting to reclaim a world annihilated by horrors. Slash through dungeons, endure brutal bosses, and wield forbidden powers in a relentless struggle against the Night itself.

name: Reality Break
short_description: Rewrite the universe! Break reality to change your fate, and use your powers to stop sinister forces from altering existence itself. Discover the origin of your new abilities in a fast-paced ARPG Loot Collection Roguelite where you will bend, break, and change the laws of the universe!

name: IAIDO
short_description: Iaido is a VR First-Person Action Game. The core gameplay is the animate iaido lash simulation. You will fight the enemies with your katana and sheath, Dodge and block the attack of enemies precisely and use iaido slash in the dedicatedly moment is the most fun part of the game.

name: Doomsday Room
short_description: A fictional geopolitical game set during a fictional Cold War.

name: Slimekeep
short_description: In a world becoming corrupted by the evil Slime King, KILL or CAPTURE various slimes to grow stronger and save Slimetopia! Venture through procedurally generated levels in this fast-paced roguelike, if you're tough enough to not get slimed...

name: Kitten Burst
short_description: Kitten Burst is an Adventure/Racing Game about a Flying Cat set in the year 200X. Explore Sites on the Web, Race through Circuits, & Battle Bullet Hell Bosses to Save Cyberspace.

name: Games Advent Calendar - 25 Days - 25 Surprises
short_description: In GAMES ADVENT CALENDAR, immerse yourself in that fantastic Christmas spirit, an exciting new game, every day for 25 days!

name: Hello, Goodbye
short_description: 'Toubu Kaito' That is the fake name assumed by a young military officer from the United Provinces of Japan. He has been tasked with infiltrating Tenshudo Academy, located in Special District Morino, impersonating a transfer student. He is to cast aside his former identity, and 'become' Toubu Kaito.

name: Lavender
short_description: Lavender is a community-driven social sandbox. There are no limits on performance, physics or scripting. If you want to make it, you can. Come imagine with us.

name: Radical Dungeon Sweeper
short_description: Explore every floors. Find the key. Find the door. Escape. And make sure to use the safest path. Monsters are everywhere.

name: SpaceBourne 2
short_description: Embark on a journey to greatness. Get ready for adrenaline-fueled battles and a chance to claim your place in the galaxy. Grab the controls of your ship, gear up for the fight, and unleash your ambition to conquer and build a new empire in the vastness of space.

name: Eleven Table Tennis
short_description: We're obsessed with creating the most realistic VR table tennis simulator the world has ever seen. After 5 years and countless hours of hard work, we believe that we have accomplished that goal.: : : [Play over Oculus Link/AirLink/Virtual Desktop Not Recommended: the tracking will be much worse]

name: MMORPG Tycoon 2
short_description: MMORPG Tycoon 2 is a single-player world-builder game about creating the greatest MMORPG of all time – yours.

name: Dead End City
short_description: A post-apocalyptic arcade shooter. Collect fuel and dodge enemy fire as you fight back against the evil Scorpio gang. Mixes cars, shmups and themes that would have been right at home in 80's anime and arcades..

name: Aartform Curvy 3D 4.0
short_description: Curvy 3D 4.0 is an innovative sculpting program for Windows, ideal for first time 3D artists. Drawing is Fast: Curvy brings new speed to 3D modelling by letting you draw shapes straight into 3D. Sculpting is Easy: Shapes are easy to work with using Curvy's artist friendly tools.

name: Tiani
short_description: Virtual reality meets the world of old school role play where the powers good must fight and triumph over an evil power intent on the destruction of your lands magic and the death of your people.

name: From Hell
short_description: From Hell is a third-person action survival horror. Explore an ancient manor in the late 1960s, fight ghouls and all kinds of monsters from the mythical underworld. Survive, craft items, solve puzzles and unlock secrets in the hunt for secret of your missing old friend.

name: Gnome Online
short_description: Gnome Online is an innovative, Real-Time, fast-paced, PvP, Sandbox MMORPG.

name: Supermarket Security Simulator
short_description: Welcome to your first day of work as security in our supermarket.In this job you will have to prevent theft, check tickets, monitor cameras, prevent robberies and keep an eye on the carts.Be attentive and efficient, manage your family and don't mess up.To the top team leader!

name: Doki Doki Literature Club Plus!
short_description: Welcome to the club! Write poems for your crush and experience the terror of school romance in this critically-acclaimed psychological horror story.

name: G.I. Joe: Wrath of Cobra
short_description: Yo Joe! Cobra returns once again with its most fiendish plot yet and it's up to G.I. Joe to defeat them once more! Pick one of the real American heroes, gear up, and get straight into the fight in this retro side-scrolling beat 'em up - and make Cobra RETREAT yet again!

name: Iris.Fall
short_description: Iris.Fall is a puzzle adventure game featuring striking visuals and a spellbinding theme of 'light and shadow'.

name: Hamidashi Creative
short_description: Tomohiro Izumi, recognized by himself and those around him as an introvert, is spending another quiet day in his little corner of his classroom… or so he thought.

name: DESYNC
short_description: DESYNC is an intense single-player first person action game that begs you to play dangerously and creatively. Eliminate your opponents as you perform violent attack sequences using the explosive digital weaponry and lethal side-arms at your disposal.

name: Slopecrashers
short_description: Slopecrashers is an arcade snowboard racer starring a wild crew of animals on a globe-trotting quest to become champions — but someone’s out to ruin their plans! Race solo or with friends, pull off stylish tricks, and use wild power-ups to take down rivals in chaotic, fast-paced action.

name: cherry blossom fleet
short_description: cherry blossom fleet　is a 2D shooting game set in the Japanese Navy of World War II.

name: Dungeon Core
short_description: Dungeon Core is a roguelite top-down shooter where you get to explore the sewers and beyond to ultimately reach an old underground research facility. Old nuclear waste has caused dangerous mutations in creatures due to a failed experiment. You set out to destroy the abandoned nuclear core.

name: Thunder Helix
short_description: Pilot deadly helicopter gunships, battle enemy forces and complete dangerous missions within a thrilling desert warzone!

name: Airranger
short_description: Airranger is a bow and arrow multiplayer game. Nothing in usual in the realm of conventional gaming, sure, but it makes for one of the best VR game with a headset donned. You can move around or fly to the sky, as well as use your unique weapons to defeat all your opponents in your own way. only the last one standing can win.

name: NeveRossa Remaster
short_description: That day, the sky was also snowing scarlet— Classic PC game from Firedog Studio in 2005 'NeveRossa~Mille e una notte' Remastered! Nurture a pretty girl Lilies, the 'Goddess Seed', through trainings, adventures, and battles, into a true Goddess within a thousand nights!

name: Dancing Arrow : Beat Smash
short_description: Dancing Arrow, VR rhythm game where you can enjoy dance games with K-POP music. Dance while listening to your favorite music!

name: Assassin's Alliance
short_description: It is an immersive storyline puzzle game designed specifically for players who love rich storylines.

name: Heathen - The sons of the law
short_description: Indie game inspired by the novel 'The island of Doctor Moreau' by HG Wells.

name: Peripeteia
short_description: Peripeteia is a first-and-third-person role-playing stealth game taking place in alt-history cyberpunk Poland. Inspired by immersive sims from Ion Storm and Looking Glass Studios, Peripeteia expands on the formula with new ideas and an original setting.

name: Within the blade
short_description: Bloody stealth platformer, about the ninja in which you cut the enemies into pieces.

name: Picklock
short_description: Join exciting adventure of escaping from cops. Be tricky and use your skills to complete your missions in green town. If you’re successful, you can enjoy well-deserved vacation at the seaside.

name: Gnomes Garden Lifeseeds Collector's Edition
short_description: The subjects came to the Gnomes Queen with alarming news. All gardens, forests and meadows began to fade. And so throughout the gnomes land!

name: ChessBase 17 Steam Edition
short_description: ChessBase is a personal, stand-alone chess database that has become the standard throughout the world. Everyone uses ChessBase, from the World Champion to the amateur next door. It is the program of choice for anyone who loves the game and wants to know more about it.

name: Horizon Forbidden West™ Complete Edition
short_description: Experience the epic Horizon Forbidden West™ in its entirety with bonus content and the Burning Shores expansion included. The Burning Shores add-on contains additional content for Aloy’s adventure, including new storylines, characters, and experiences in a stunning yet hazardous new area.

name: Muv-Luv Alternative
short_description: Playtime's over. Time for despair. Experience the definitive version of a masterpiece in the Muv-Luv trilogy's thrilling conclusion. Note: therapy not included.

name: Railroad Corporation 2
short_description: The 20th century heralds the new age of electrification for the railroad, and a new opportunity to make your fortune. Build your corporation carefully, as you deploy modern electric and diesel locomotives, lay new tracks, transport goods and passengers, and stay ahead of the competition.

name: VVAV ONE
short_description: VVAV ONE is a keyboard rhythm game where you challenge your limit, play and compete with others while enjoying various music.

name: Pinball
short_description: 3D Pinball game with an amazing feature: a Table Editor for you to create and play your own tables.

name: Santhai
short_description: This is a legendary game. come back for everyone to join again The great adventures of the same boy. and so many activities that await now.

name: Horizon Chase Turbo
short_description: Thrilling arcade racing game, inspired by the super-fun-straight-to-the-point classic racing games from the 90s.

name: Rotwood
short_description: The world has been thrown into chaos, and it's up to you and your friends to battle the corrupted beasts of the Rotwood. Upgrade your gear, choose your preferred weapon, and hone your skills to defend your safe haven.

name: APOX
short_description: A Real-Time Strategy game with First-Person Shooter tactics.

name: The Nameless: Slay Dragon
short_description: The Nameless: Slay Dragon is like a mix of CRPG and JRPG. In short - how to slay the immensely powerful and cunning evil dragon? You will play as a young man having a bloody feud with a dragon, and face powerful, sinister and tricky enemies with friends....

name: 22 Racing Series | RTS-Racing
short_description: The fastest physics based racing game on Steam? Yep. The most complex strategy racing game on Steam? Yep. Easy to just 'pick-up-and-play'? - Nope. Not really. If you want an *easy* challenge - Then this isn't for you. Thanks

name: Second Front
short_description: Second Front is a tactical WWII turn-based strategy game. Craft & share your own scenarios and maps or use your strategic prowess in 48 scenarios set in iconic locations. Command over 40 types of infantry and 216 tanks, vehicles and guns. An infinite tactical sandbox experience.

name: Pax Augusta
short_description: Pax Augusta is probably the most authentic ancient city-building simulation. Build flourishing cities and look after your citizens. Earn gold with production and trade of goods and build impressive monuments. Strengthen your influence and become a Roman emperor!

name: Steam Squad
short_description: Steam Squad - a classical tactical wargame with honest physics simulation of battles set in an alternative universe during the First World War. Players acting for the 3 of the superpowers - the Holy Roman, British and Tianxian Empires complete 30 missions with squads of up to 8 units.

name: Rise of Keepers
short_description: Rise of Keepers is a mix of the best Old School RPGs and Tower Defense games. Explore a huge map, get resources, build structures, fight powerful enemies, loot and the most important. Protect the Crystal!

name: Dusk City
short_description: A flourishing civilization had sunk into the sea. The night never dawns...... and a sense of apocalypse hangs over the world. You'll land on an island in such a world, and as you explore the town and ruins, you'll come into contact with fragments of the world's mysteries.

name: Stars
short_description: 《Stars》is a VR game about stars. you can completely relax, look up at the sky and listen to the story of each constellation.

name: The Stormy Islands
short_description: Survive mother nature, prepare for the different seasons protecting yourself from cold, heat, hunger and thirst. Beware of Tornadoes, Storms, Tsunamis and predatory animals, on a variety of islands where each one will have to adapt to its limited resources.

name: Jorel’s Brother and The Most Important Game of the Galaxy - Complete Edition
short_description: “Jorel’s Brother and The Most Important Game of the Galaxy” is a point-and-click adventure about an eight-year-old boy who lives with his eccentric family in the shadow of Jorel, his handsome and popular brother. Based on the award-winning Brazilian animation “Jorel’s Brother”.

name: STORY OF SEASONS: A Wonderful Life
short_description: Put down roots on your new farm in the peaceful town of Forgotten Valley. Bring life to the land by cultivating crops and raising animals, find love among the town's friendly folk, and make lasting memories with a family of your very own.

name: Reverence: The Ultimate Combat Experience
short_description: Experience real sword fighting in Reverence.With total control over your body, you carve your own destiny in this first and third person, multiplayer, combat experience. With the Muscle Memory System you can intuitively control all your limbs and even tweak your muscle memory to create a unique style.

name: Little Reaper
short_description: Slash, dash and reap through Little Reaper as Ollie, the Grim Reaper’s tiny assistant in this colourful adventure platformer game. Ollie accidentally shatters a jar of souls while Death is on holiday. Now he has to travel the world to retrieve them, or else suffer the wrath of Death. Or worse… get fired!

name: Lumina
short_description: As an archaeologist, unlock the secret of the ancient pyramid and solve complex puzzles using lasers to escape alive!

name: Sword Art Online: Hollow Realization Deluxe Edition
short_description: 2026, Sword Art: Origin, a new VRMMORPG has emerged. Kirito meets a mysterious NPC and receives a cryptic message. This game is definitively not the same as the one he escaped years ago…

name: The Sapling
short_description: The Sapling is a short simulation game where you design your own plants and animals, and put them in a world together. Or you turn on random mutations, and see what evolution does to your ecosystem!

name: Hospitalize
short_description: Find the most effective way to construct and manage a hospital. Build your hospital smart and avoid excess time and resources consumed by examining your patients unnecessary. You can choose to micromanage your patients or hope that your doctors are able to identify the cause of their symptoms.

name: Akumi Wars
short_description: Calling all Bounty hunters! Akumi Wars is a turn-based RPG. Build your own party of irresponsible misfit heroes and delve into an epic world story with the ultimate goal of... avoiding needing to work retail. Armed with guns, magic, and a distracting amount of leg, hop on your ship for adventure!

name: Murderous Muses
short_description: Solve a sinister murder by spending three reality-shifting nights in a haunted art gallery. An infinitely re-playable murder mystery blending deduction, exploration, puzzles, collectibles and FMV.

name: Rogue Waters
short_description: Rogue Waters is a Pirate Tactical Turn-Based Rogue-lite. Play as Captain Cutter, commanding your ship and crew through procedurally generated encounters to seek revenge. Recruit, train, and upgrade crew, use powerful sea creatures, and engage in dynamic naval and melee combat to gain the upper hand.

name: Rage of the Dragons NEO
short_description: Engage in intense tag team battles in Rage of the Dragons NEO! Play the cult-classic among the fans of Fighting Games with brand exclusive content!

name: Don't Look Down
short_description: Don't Look Down is the original VR climbing platformer. Climb and fling past anything in your way. Smash robots and snag power-ups as you race to the top. Can you save the world from the robot you created?

name: Metaverse
short_description: In Metaverse you will dig, discover, design, deploy, and defend. Explore, build upon, or tear apart your own procedurally generated voxel planet. And now in the early stages of our multiplayer implementation, help conquer or build the planets of others.

name: Vane
short_description: In a ruined desert, a strange golden dust transforms a free-spirited bird into a determined young child, setting off a chain of events that will reshape the world itself.

name: Araka~JK Exorcist Horror RPG
short_description: Manipulate the main character with power of telepathic, looking for the trace of Araka, an Exorcist imprisoned in the other world.

name: DragonScales 1-7 Collection
short_description: All seven parts of the famous tile-matching and strategy game! Connect tiles of one color to vaporize rows. Use powerful spells and receive bonuses, fight evil bosses and enjoy all seven parts of the 'DragonScales' serial with over 900 levels!

name: Submachine: Legacy
short_description: Submachine is a hand-drawn puzzle adventure game. You find yourself in a vast network of desolate locations containing puzzles, secrets, notes and items to collect to help you along the way. Follow the story of a banished lighthouse keeper to discover his descent into ruins.

name: In League
short_description: Tactical multiplayer shooter built from the ground up for VR. Team up with other players wielding a wide array of realistic guns, grenades and melee weapons in Hunt or Hostage mode. Winning takes strategy and teamwork as you fight through rich interactive environments.

name: Panzer Knights
short_description: Panzer Knights is a single-player, story-driven tank shooter where you, a German Tank Commander, lead your platoon of tanks across Europe circa WWII. Experience battles spanning the entire war as you strategize, battle, and best your enemies!

name: Voidship: The Long Journey
short_description: Design your battleship and fight your way through unforgiving space. This is a tale of a lone spaceship on a centuries-long mission. As the captain, you´ll make strategic decisions, explore unknown sectors, meet allies and enemies, gather resources, technology and crew. To battle stations!

name: Be Hero
short_description: Be Hero is a farming/crafting RPG about an aspiring hero who arrived late to the final battle and needs to work in a tavern to be able to return home.

name: Existensis
short_description: Explore the world of Eré for artistic inspiration, so that you may reach the meanings of life and complete your artistic opus! Many branching paths will take you to every corner of the globe as you explore this peaceful and colorful world.

name: The Forgettable Dungeon
short_description: The Forgettable Dungeon is an ONLINE co-op top down action roguelike that takes place in a procedurally generated destructible voxel world.

name: The Wickie : Journey of a Lighthouse Keeper
short_description: The Wickie is a first-person thriller set in the 1930s Outer Hebrides. Explore handcrafted islands, uncover cosmic horrors, and survive deadly dangers. With no weapons or maps, rely on wit and courage to solve mysteries. Rich in story,art, and Lovecraftian dread, Will you uncover the truth?

name: Killsquad
short_description: Hack and slash? Check. Twin-stick-shooter? Check. 4 player coop to slay hordes of aliens & bosses with your friends? Check. Skills, upgrades, weapons, gears, talismans and more to make you stronger? Check. Wake up, bounty hunter. We have a mission for you. Time to clean up the scum of the galaxy.

name: FLASHOUT 3
short_description: FLASHOUT IS BACK! Where high speed meets high stakes. Where unforgiving combat, loud electronic music and addictive boosts of adrenaline mix up to separate winners from losers. Where gravitation is nothing more than an empty word. Take part in an exciting, head-to-head fight to the finish!

name: Linked Mask
short_description: Kill the deities that have been abandoned in the towers created by people, a KAIZO LIKE EXTREME CHALLENGING PLATFORMER video game that aims to make you become a god in Linked Mask.

name: Shredders
short_description: Break into the snowboarding event of the year in the hope of scoring a wildcard entry to an exclusive invitational. To prove you’re up to the challenge, master the art of park riding, buttering, rails and massive kickers and earn your place in the world of snowboarding.

name: Shieldwall Chronicles: Swords of the North
short_description: Shieldwall Chronicles: Swords of the North is a gripping, tactical RPG that lets you build a powerful band of adventurers and partake in a grand adventure.

name: Damage Inc. Pacific Squadron WWII
short_description: Take to the skies in one of over 30 accurately represented aircraft and defend the Pacific Theatre from invading enemy forces.

name: EVIL BELOW™
short_description: Take the role of a mother searching for her child in a mysterious world filled with dark creatures blinded by faith and greed. Prepare to run, hide, kill and survive.

name: Heli-Cats
short_description: Dual elevation horizontal 2D arcade shoot 'em up co-op helicopter action!

name: Pineview Drive - Homeless
short_description: Join former Army soldier Miles Roberts as he wanders into the old estate at the bottom of Pineview Drive on a stormy night. From here begins a nightmare, from which it is necessary to escape.

name: News Tower
short_description: Develop your newspaper and become New York’s new media mogul! In this tycoon, build and manage your newspaper from printer to toilet. Create your editorial line and lead your journalists through unique 1930's stories and dig out the latest scoops!

name: Button Button Up!
short_description: 'Button Button Up!' is a platformer party game. Players need to use limited resources to help their partner passing different laser obstacles. The bros are going share their weal and woe to complete a fantastic adventure by the lead of Mr. Bunny.

name: The Expression Amrilato
