short_description: Survival: Fountain of Youth is a challenging single-player open-world adventure game set on the Caribbean islands. Survive as a shipwrecked 16th-century explorer, craft tools and shelter, and uncover the secrets of both an ancient civilization and your own fate.

name: Virtual Idea Area
short_description: Virtual Idea Area brings the benefits of working digitally to whiteboards. Undo mistakes, change the color of your boards, spread your ideas over a thousand different whiteboards, ... VIA makes it all possible!

name: Atlantis Adventure VR
short_description: Atlantis Adventure is an Action Adventure VR Game.The game can run on both PC and VR platforms.Hunting monsters from different ages in search of Atlantis treasuresJoin the Great and Immense Adventure !!!!!

name: Alone in the Dark
short_description: Return to Derceto Manor in this reimagination of Alone in the Dark, a love letter to the 90’s cult classic horror game.

name: ZiDouQianWen
short_description: I am a destiny question and answer game based on Zi Wei Dou Shu, a Chinese astrology system. Come and explore the mysteries of destiny with me!

name: The Trail: Frontier Challenge
short_description: Are you ready to discover the undiscovered? Are you ready to climb the tallest mountains, wear the finest clothes, and earn a fortune beyond compare? Then welcome to the New World! Welcome to The Trail: Frontier Challenge!

name: Last Epoch
short_description: Uncover the Past, Reforge the Future. Ascend into one of 15 mastery classes and explore dangerous dungeons, hunt epic loot, craft legendary weapons, and wield the power of over a hundred transformative skill trees. Last Epoch is being developed by a team of passionate Action RPG enthusiasts.

name: Qubicle Voxel Editor
short_description: Qubicle is a professional voxel editor optimized for the easy creation of 3D models with a unique, blocky charm.

name: Goblin Times
short_description: In this joyful Steampunk world, Goblins are the absolute dominators. They have their own ways of living. Money and power is what makes this world go around and also every goblin’s ultimate pursuit. Some goblins who are good at making money become leaders of the pack.

name: Total War: WARHAMMER III
short_description: The cataclysmic conclusion to the Total War: WARHAMMER trilogy is here. Rally your forces and step into the Realm of Chaos, a dimension of mind-bending horror where the very fate of the world will be decided. Will you conquer your Daemons… or command them?

name: The Alchemist of Ars Magna
short_description: The main character enters a school and gains experience in research, study, and love. This is the adventure story of an alchemist who grows through encounters and experiences and paves the way.

name: DAEMON MASQUERADE
short_description: An anime-inspired supernatural detective game. Uncover the identities and powers of your adversaries using a conspiracy board full of evidence.

name: Hidden Map
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Bakemono - Demon Brigade Tenmen Unit 01
short_description: Bakemono is an anime themed VR mech simulator.

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Succubus
short_description: When Sumire is summoned to another world by a powerful succubus, she must learn to master her new powers to return to her world.

name: Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days 2
short_description: 'Cardfight!! Vanguard,' has newly come to digital game! Over 3,000 cards for the Standard format! A brand-new original story shares the world of anime series unfolds! Enjoy your own cardfight experience!!

name: Warehouse Simulator: Forklift Driver
short_description: Manage specialized equipment used in warehouses and become a professional in your field. And the well-developed mechanics of the movement of specialized warehouse equipment allows you to experience the sensations of working in a warehouse without leaving your computer.

name: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
short_description: 'Tokyo Xtreme Racer' is a racing game set in a blocked-off future Tokyo, where players aim to be the fastest by driving their best cars on the highways that weave through the city.

name: HAELE 3D - Feet Poses Lite - Drawing References
short_description: The Lite version of HAELE is a versatile 3D feet poser and customizer app It is an easy to use foot anatomy drawing reference tool for the artist, with a wide palette of detailed options and poses to create highly realistic feet and edit its environment.

name: MetaPhysical
short_description: Supernatural phenomena are on the rise. In MetaPhysical you and up to 5 other friends can go on the hunt for eerie creatures to put an end to their sinister activities! Whether it's an ordinary ghost or a demon, your task is to identify the rumbling creature and then finish it off.

name: Recordbooks
short_description: Survive in Toxic Gas and Fights . Kill First or Die First . Experience Bodycam Game First time Ever . Play as a secret agency agent at Mysterious Area whose duty is to solve Complex and Mysterious cases of duty area .Your Detective and Tactical skill is needed to solve these complex cases.

name: VJmachine
short_description: VJmachine is the plug & play Full HD VJ software music visualizer and music video creator e.g. YouTube. Install VJmachine on your computer or notebook. Connect your music & screens and you're ready to start your party! Custom videos & pictures as well are automatically synced to the music.

name: System Shock
short_description: A first-person fight to the death in the depths of space!

name: Mad Streets
short_description: Mad Streets is a hilarious multiplayer party game with an emphasis on brutal yet comical fist fighting throughout a multitude of modes, local and online, where players battle it out in wild physics driven chaos to determine who is the baddest player in town!

name: Just Death
short_description: Just Death is an “Open-World Sandbox Crime Game” set in procedurally generated cities. Just Death features an Online Open City mode, Vigilante, Bank Heist, and Gang War modes. Join in the development today!

name: Escape The Mad Empire
short_description: Escape the Mad Empire is a party-based, rogue-like dungeon crawler with intense and deeply tactical combat. Overcome the challenges as a band of heroes, and preserve their lives and sanity by managing resources and growing your base. Can you Escape the Mad Empire?

name: Hell is Others
short_description: Hell is Others is an extraction top-down shooter combining roguelike elements. Outside the safety of your apartment lies the noir hellscape that is Century City. A city of endless night that straddles the line between reality and insanity. Explore, hunt, and loot in a place where blood is currency.

name: Vertical Kingdom
short_description: There's nowhere to go but up! Vertical Kingdom is a card-based city builder roguelite with a twist - you can only build vertically, literally reaching for the sky with each city. Lead expeditions to gather resources, construct metropolises, and build ever upwards!

name: Firekeep
short_description: Firekeep is a minimalist, relaxing strategy game about building a tiny, sustainable city in the cold void of space. Build, combine and upgrade dozens of unique buildings to overcome procedurally-generated islands and keep your fire burning.

name: Arizona Sunshine® Remake
short_description: Arizona Sunshine® Remake elevates the original, award-winning game, completely rebuilt with GORE-geous VR graphics and next-gen VR combat and weapons. Face the undead alone or with up to three fellow survivors in a post-apocalyptic southwestern America overrun by zombies.

name: Wild Country
short_description: Wild Country is a cozy-competitive card game with city-building elements! Collect cards, construct buildings, explore Big Sky, and challenge friends in this one of a kind strategy game.

name: Monster Master
short_description: Monster Master makes RTS fight versus FPS. Be the horde or survive together in this asymmetric reverse horror multiplayer

name: MechNest
short_description: MechNest is a 3D bullet hell shooter developed by a single person. As you progress through the map, which changes with each challenge, collect reinforcement items and defeat powerful enemies with flashy shooting! Combine your skills freely and rampage through the hive of mechs!

name: Smith & Dungeon: Crafting the Legendary Weapons
short_description: 'Smith and Dungeon' is a hack-and-slash roguelite game, where you play as a blacksmith exploring dungeons, battling monsters, collecting materials, and crafting powerful weapons!

name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
short_description: Join Snufkin in this musical adventure about restoring harmony and balance to Moominvalley, protecting it from the industrious Park Keeper.

name: Umbra: The Last Summoner
short_description: As the sole Summoner, save Umbra from a demon invasion by summoning 60 unique heroes. Engage in strategic, turn-based battles against 150+ monsters, explore 15 vast areas, and conquer challenging quests and colossal bosses. Your epic RPG journey awaits!

name: LOST CAVE
short_description: At an old cave where ancient ruins lie, an unknown life slowly lurks beneath. Put on your gear, become an adventurer, and explore the caverns filled with many secrets.

name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 25
short_description: Hit like you mean it with FieldSENSE™ powered by BOOM Tech. Experience how the new physics-informed dynamic tackling system unlocks realistic collisions & new gameplay animations on both sides of the ball.

name: EARTHLOCK
short_description: Earthlock is an indie developed, adventure RPG inspired by the classic 3D RPGs of the late 90's, with a fresh take on turn based combat and character progression.

name: Rhythm Doctor
short_description: Save patients with your rhythm mastery! Rhythm Doctor is a rhythm game where you heal patients by defibrillating in time to their heartbeats. Learn each patient's unique heartbeat and defeat boss viruses trying to sabotage your rhythm, all set to heart-pumping, soul-soothing music.

name: Marble Odyssey
short_description: Marble Odyssey, a high octane adventure, as your marble rolls across 40 levels of devilish island courses, each requiring quick thinking, dexterity and outright speed. Marbly adventures await!

name: NINJA KIDZ: TIME MASTERS
short_description: America's most popular online ninja family's first video game is here! NINJA KIDZ: TIME MASTERS is a colourful action adventure for the whole family where you can play alone or together with friends. Rescue the 3 greatest martial arts masters kidnapped by Dr. Disaster.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
short_description: Survive five nights of terror in this chilling adventure game. Travel between time periods to solve puzzles, gather clues, and outrun the threat relentlessly pursuing you. Move swiftly and stay hidden, and you may just survive. But be careful—it's not just your own life that’s on the line this time.

name: Jousting Manager
short_description: Jousting Manager allows you to play a sports management game from a new angle. Take control of a medieval jousting team and handle all aspects of the club as you compete to reach the top.

name: Synergy
short_description: An ecosystem City Builder in a unique world. Build your settlement, manage your workers and optimize your resources. Analyzing your environment, spreading new plants, and harvesting them are key to prosperity.

name: Clover Day's Plus
short_description: Bottled-up emotions... An everlasting oath... Heartfelt desires... An enduring regret... And a childhood promise. Yuuto was abandoned by his parents and raised in an orphanage in Britain before a trading merchant by the name of Takakura Yoshiomi adopted him and brought him to Japan.

name: Fit It
short_description: Participate in the TV show „Fit It“ where you will have to test your stamina, flexibility and even math knowledge to fit through the walls that will be coming right at you!

name: Break Chance Memento
short_description: Break Chance Memento is a story about family bonds across time and involves time travel, tracking down a serial killer, and potential gay romance. Can Shuuki save the people he cares about by traveling through time? Whether or not he makes it through to a happy ending is completely up to the player's decisions.

name: Rise - The Vieneo Province
short_description: Rise is a persistent science fiction sandbox strategy MMO set on Vieneo, an exomoon about 225 LY from Earth. Use ground, air, and space vehicles to explore this vast open world of 100 million square kilometers in size! You are helping establish a living, breathing world with virtually no boundaries!

name: Treasure Hunter
short_description: While searching for treasure in an ancient castle, an explorer is chased by shadow knights and skeletons and tries to survive.

name: Lightning Fast
short_description: Lightning Fast is a sandbox survival game. Playing as a leopard, the adventure starts from your tough childhood. You must struggle to turn yourself from a vulnerable cub into the dominator of Divach Plain, in order to survive the law of the jungle and encounter the challenge brought by the poachers.

name: Slinger VR
short_description: Slinger VR is an action adventure game, where you climb, fly and leap through vast spaces and abstract twisted structures formed inside your mind. Defeat enemies and activate transmitters to unlock portals that lead on and on.

name: Ferret Scoundrels
short_description: Let loose your inner swashbuckler with this Open World Adventure Pirate Game. Sail into unknown waters in search of grit, glory and gold. Become an infamous pirate, prolific tradesman, or respected general. Which discoveries, alliances, and treasures await you is your choice, captain.

name: Ocnus Theory
short_description: Ocnus Theory is a challenging sandbox platformer that will test your creativity, reflexes, and ability to rise from a painful fall. Explore the mysteries of this open environment, shape your Ocnus to match the current challenge, and ascend to the peak! Just don't look down.

name: Hidden Magic Town
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Secret Agent
short_description: The family of our protagonist -- Mikage Jin -- are descendants of a line of ninjas responsible for national security since the Edo era. Jin was born and raised to follow in the footsteps of his secret agent mother as a ninja in training. He's been ordered to infiltrate Touka Academy undercover...

name: Medieval Arms
short_description: Medieval Arms is thought as a sandbox'y action/ combat game, where you run around and fight untill time or points run out.

name: Hira Hira Hihiru
short_description: 'Hira Hira Hihiru' is a visual novel set in a fictional Taishō Era. It tells the story of its two protagonists' struggle against Aerodema, a terrifying disease which brings the dead back to life.

name: Cosmic: A Journey Among Shadows
short_description: Embark on a journey through a land of darkness to save your lost shadow. With the help of a mysterious beast’s shadow, master new abilities, outsmart enemies, and uncover hidden truths in your quest to reclaim what’s been taken.

name: Danger Zone 2
short_description: Danger Zone 2 takes the crash action out of the Test Area and onto real public roads. A high speed driving game featuring speed, boost, traffic and crashes.

name: Dyad
short_description: Experience a mind-bending, psychedelic sensory overload in Dyad! Blast through a reactive audio-visual tube creating a harmonious synthesis of color and sound as you Hook, Graze, and Lance enemies to master Dyad's 27 unique levels.

name: Star Trek™ : 25th Anniversary
short_description: Beam aboard the USS Enterprise to join Captain Kirk and his intrepid crew in this classic adventure game. Eight original missions, each styled as episodes of an imagined fourth season of Star Trek: the Original Series, featuring the voice talents of the original actors!

name: Victory At Sea Ironclad
short_description: Victory at Sea Ironclad is the exciting game of naval RTS combat set during the American Civil War. Bringing an epic approach to real time strategy war gaming, search and destroy enemy fleets across an open world sandbox in a desperate attempt to change the course of history.

name: SpyParty
short_description: SpyParty is a competitive espionage game about subtle human behavior. A Spy hides in plain sight at a fancy cocktail party, trying to accomplish missions while blending in with the other guests, while a Sniper with a single bullet looks inward, searching for the Spy.

name: Lost Artifacts Mysterious Book Collector's Edition
short_description: The team of experienced treasure hunters rushes off to meet adventure once again!

name: Sky Is Arrows
short_description: Real-time tactical roguelike where every second counts. Control a hero and 5 armies, make snap decisions, and adapt to escalating threats. Draft items, counter enemy comps, and survive as long as you can before the Final Boss returns. Time is your enemy.

name: Demon Hunter
short_description: Demon hunter it is a kind of virtual reality RPG game ，player acting as a warrior who use teampistol,bow or double blade to fight against magic monsters，it can show you a shocking war scene by using VR equipment.
developers: Beijing Skyline Interaction Technology Co., Ltd.

name: Automation
short_description: PLC Ladder Logic programming simulator.

name: Gimbal
short_description: Gimbal is the multiplayer shooter with buildable vehicles. Customize your weaponry, engines, and accessories, and then take to the skies against other pilots in real time.

name: This Bed We Made
short_description: This Bed We Made is a third-person mystery game in which you play as a maid in a 1950s hotel and snoop around strangers' rooms to uncover their deadly secrets. Discover what links guests together in this tale of love, heartbreak and murder!

name: KreatureKind
short_description: Magic will disappear forever, unless you save it! In this wholesome and approachable card game, you debate monsters, recruit friends, and start a world-changing movement. Balance your team and your decks carefully, and use your debate skills to convince fantastical opponents to join your side!

name: Prehistoric Hunt
short_description: Dive into intense dinosaur hunting adventures with your friends. Complete hunting contracts for Preton Corporation. Gather rewards, improve your equipment and become a master hunter. Are you the hunter or the hunted?

name: Mecho Tales
short_description: An all-new adventure in the world of Mecho Wars! Run and shoot through chaotic platforming levels filled with spikes, bottomless pits and an army of deadly robots. Go it alone or team up with your friends in 4-player local multiplayer. Directed by Luc Bernard.

name: Amairo Chocolate 2
short_description: Yunagicho, a town lined with Western-style homes. The previous autumn was when Yuzuki came to this town and met the animal eared girls and started working with them at Cafe Setaria.

name: Stratus Blade Clear
short_description: Stratus Blade Clear. A game about an dark anime character in a light fantasy setting.

name: JDM: Japanese Drift Master
short_description: Discover Japan’s legendary car culture in JDM! Take on challenging mountain roads, visit Japanese legendary drifting spots in licensed JDM cars and immerse in the story about second chances told through manga pages. Explore an open world where every turn invites you to master the art of drift.

name: BattleJuice Alchemist
short_description: BattleJuice Alchemist is a complex alchemy RPG that adds a unique item and skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on isometric combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, build a tower and craft potions to fight the demonic hordes of Samhain.

name: Airtone
short_description: Airtone is a brand-new type of VR rhythm game that allows you to enter a virtual world along with the main character, Neon. The spectacular music and visuals make for an all-new arcade rhythm game experience!

name: PowerBeatsVR - VR Fitness
short_description: PowerBeatsVR is a high-intensity VR fitness game where you box, dodge, and squat to the rhythm of upbeat music. Choose between official songs with leaderboards and dozens of professional workouts or train with your own music using the generator. See those calories burn and your pulse racing.

name: Mojika - Truth Rears Its Ugly Head
short_description: Haunted by the ability to read minds, Suteru embarks on a journey of revenge against those who wronged him. Uncovering the secrets of his tormentors, he must confront his demons in a story that explores the depths and darkness of the human mind.

name: Hidden Flowers
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon
short_description: Step into a dark reimagination of Arthurian legends in this first person, open world RPG. Explore a world stuck in everlasting autumn, witness falling legends and make meaningful choices woven into a complex, branching storyline.

name: Don't Die, Minerva!
short_description: Help Minerva survive her adventure in a haunted house full of sinister ghosts! This spooky rogue-lite features heaps of procedural dungeons, ghosts, and loot.

name: Alpha Response
short_description: From Gooseman, creator of the original Counter-Strike mod - Alpha Response delivers intense police action in dynamic, real-world environments. Fight solo or with friends against diverse enemies in high-stakes missions that demand fast reflexes, teamwork and split-second decision making.

name: JWildfire
short_description: Explore the infite beauty of flame-fractals in a playful way

name: New World: Aeternum
short_description: Experience a thrilling action RPG set on the supernatural island of Aeternum. Forge your destiny on an adventure filled with danger and opportunity.

name: Grand Theft Auto III – The Definitive Edition
short_description: It all starts in Liberty City. With revolutionary freedom to go anywhere and jack anyone, Grand Theft Auto III puts the center of the criminal underworld at your fingertips, if you have enough guts to take it.

name: Lost Skies
short_description: Chart a course in a breathtaking, but fractured world. Explore ancient ruins, master advanced technology, and craft your very own skyship to brave nature’s fury and colossal threats in Lost Skies. Team up with friends or go it alone in this awe-inspiring cooperative survival adventure.

name: Hairy Little Buggers
short_description: Build a Dwarven Fortress. Dig tunnels, forge iron, & fight battles! Grow, dig & build!

name: Wizordum
short_description: Wizordum is a retro FPS that puts you in the role of a Mage on a quest to track down the source of Chaos. With a wide arsenal of spells and magic items, battle your way through the world of Terrabruma in this unique blend of classic 90s shooters and modern gaming elements.

name: DanSparkling
short_description: Music/Rhythm/Dance game play with just one PC camera. Of course, you can also use your phone camera. !!! Contact - project.doin@gmail.com

name: Songbringer
short_description: Imagine if the original Zelda game was set in a science-fiction galaxy. Explore this open-world, action RPG with roguelike and metroidvania elements. Mighty bosses lurk deep within procedurally-generated dungeons. Wield, vanquish, unearth, collect, craft, progress, trip, adventure.

name: Vienna Automobile Society
short_description: Arcade racing with strategy and reflexes. Control your car's driving line and gears to master the track and outmaneuver other drivers. Simple controls and abstract design recreate the high speed drama of circuit racing.

name: Cascading Failure
short_description: Lead your troops into battle first hand in an intense Sci-Fi world. Construct bases, build defences, construct bigger bases, build way too many defences and take the map with overwhelming amounts of infantry, mechs and firepower.

name: RPG Architect
short_description: Want to build a game, but not sure where to start? Focus on designing your game and let RPG Architect do the rest! We've abstracted most of the nitty-gritty stuff out so you can focus on building your next great adventure!

name: Unbound: Worlds Apart
short_description: Summon portals to overcome vicious beasts, devious puzzles and fiendish platforming challenges. Master the unique powers of each portal to stop the collapse of reality, while exploring lush, hand-drawn worlds and unraveling a deep narrative full of mysteries.

name: Touhou Luna Nights
short_description: Touhou Luna Nights is a Metroidvania title with a heavy emphasis on exploration and action.　 Developed by Team Ladybug, creators of multiple fantastic action games thus far.

name: WaggaSim
short_description: Take to the skies in the ultimate paragliding and speed-flying simulator. Experience lifelike physics, design or modify your own gear, and perfect your style: soaring, thermaling, acro, freestyle, and more. With soft-body wings that move like real fabric, the sky is no longer the limit!

name: Vaudeville
short_description: Vaudeville is an experimental whodunit game based on the latest AI technologies to generate dialogues in real time. This tale of murder, suspense and absurdity unfolds as you play, and you are the protagonist.

name: Vellum
short_description: Write on! Defend the books in Vellum, a co-op, literary roguelike! Harness class-defining colors, master an inspired spellbook, and influence the growth of your enemy! As a group or solo, you'll craft plot-twisting builds to rewrite the rules in Ink!

name: The Bradwell Conspiracy
short_description: Following a sudden explosion at the Stonehenge Museum fundraiser, you find yourself trapped in a hidden underground complex. Your only means of escape is by sending photographs of your surroundings to another survivor confined elsewhere. But before long, a disturbing truth begins to dawn…

name: The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation
short_description: Fear, anxiety, and laughter are the symbol of youth. Experience the true paranormal haunting with your friends from the first-person perspective and stay alive. The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation is an adaptation of a horror film, includes Taiwanese urban legend and an intriguing backstory.

name: Crunch Element
short_description: Raid destructible compounds using explosive gadgets and tactical weaponry in VR! Breach, clear, and dominate in high-intensity raids where destruction is your greatest weapon. Whether you're leading a squad or taking on the challenge solo, precision, strategy, and firepower will decide your victory.

name: Chronicles of Honor
short_description: What is won when HONOR is lost? 3rd-Person RPG Roguelike Shooter. Scavenge weapons and items. Defeat your enemies. You will not survive. Super Humans. Distant Future.

name: Cosmobreeder Yiffai
short_description: Travel to a forgotten world and study alien creatures in this authentic retro metroidvania!

name: Oblitus
short_description: Test your limits against a brutal and mysterious world as Parvus, a curious warrior with a heavy burden. Raise your spear and cast ancient spells as you battle hostile creatures and towering bosses in procedurally-generated 2D landscapes. Answer the call. Break the cycle. Change your destiny.

name: Plane Accident
short_description: Become an inspector examining causes of plane crashes. Visit the crash site, gather evidence and interrogate witnesses. Explain whether the accident was caused by independent factors or human errors.

name: Fight Crab 2
short_description: Clash claws and flip opponents belly-up in physics-based crab battles! Combine dual-wielded weaponry with multiple fighting stances to create a custom fighting style. Bash, blast, scoop and pummel enemies onto their backs to achieve victory!

name: Bargain Hunter
short_description: Know a bargain when you see one? Sift the gems from the garbage - and you could make it big! Play as an up-and-coming bargain hunter looking to make his or her fortune turning 'trash' into cash! Start with a few bucks and aim to become fabulously wealthy... or go bust trying!

name: Cross Concerto
short_description: 《交汇协奏曲》是由日本知名美少女游戏集团品牌Applique为纪念品牌创立十周年而制作的和风传奇题材作品。由名作《月影魅像-解放之羽-》与《黄昏的禁忌之药》的原班人马打造。游戏剧情层层剥茧，路线结局众多，是一部拥有很高完成度的作品。

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles
short_description: Spin a new tale of the Jura Tempest Federation together with all your favorite characters from the animated series!

name: Harem in Another World
short_description: In Harem in Another World, you play as your normal everyday pervert, who is suddenly transported to another world. Explore this open and mysterious place through different lands to try and find your lost friends. Meet all manner of people and characters, from ghosts, to goblins, to giants and more!

name: Road Maintenance Simulator
short_description: Experience the everyday life in a German street maintenance service and complete a variety of realistic tasks in the area of road construction and maintenance! For your work you will have unique vehicles and various usable tools at your disposal.

name: NEW MONOPOLY®
short_description: MONOPOLY® is back with a fresh look and an improved game experience. Buy, sell, trade properties, and grow your empire in a fully animated 3D city that transforms from sunlit days to stormy nights as you play.

name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
short_description: A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

name: Dark Invasion VR: Doomsday
short_description: A terrifying, brutal horror VR shooter adventure with quests, zombies, mutants, and guns! At the onset of the apocalypse, you find yourself inside an old bunker. You must fight your way with full force through the ranks of the undead army of the Dark Invasion to find a way out of that forsaken place

name: Cryptic Route
short_description: 'Cryptic Route' begins with the protagonist driving through a rainy night forest. Relying on navigation, each choice influences the outcome of the journey. The multiple ending system offers various results, immersing players into a tale of mystery and horror.

name: Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise
short_description: Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise is an open-world survival horror video game serving as both a sequel and prequel to the original Deadly Premonition: The Director’s Cut.

name: Messiah
short_description: Bob is an angel ordered by God himself to go and clean up the putrid world of the future. He has been given the power of possession so that he can sneak up on any person, animal or genetically engineered being and leap right into their souls! The rules are up to you - enjoy the freedom.

name: Ghost Parade
short_description: There’s something spooky in the woods... And it needs your help! Team up with 30 ghostly companions, each one lending a unique ability. Explore this spine-tingling scrolling action adventure and work together to get everyone safely home.

name: Mirror War - Reincarnation of Holiness SA
short_description: [Mirror War-Reincarnation of Holiness SA] is a 3D arcade shooting RPG with tremendous volume of quests according to epic scenario.Choose one of the sections aiming for hegemony on the world, and lead the race to victory with legendary items and super controls!

name: Beard Blade
short_description: Run and jump through tropical 16-bit locales as you fend off foes with the power of Branson's shapeshifting beard. Visit the barber to toughen your scruff with new abilities and confront the thieving Smuglins.

name: FARAWAY TRAIN
short_description: Some folk call these barren plains the narrow space between this world and the next. The final place for souls to find a measure of peace. A train travels through endless landscapes. You seek clues about the fleeting life of Empress Roxelana. Finally, the train arrives at ...

name: Farewell North
short_description: Play as a border collie and restore color to your human’s world in an atmospheric journey through the northern isles of Scotland. Explore land and sea, uncover hidden paths, herd animals and free wildlife to bring color back to her world, while revealing an emotional story about saying farewell.

name: Everafter Falls
short_description: Rediscover the simple life. Farm, fish, forge and fight to restore the peace in an all-new farming adventure. Features split-screen coop, a helpful pet, automated drones, resourceful pixies, a card-eating progression system, and dangerous dungeons to delve into!

name: A-Spec First Assault
short_description: Fly corvette-class warships. Engage in combat operations against fighters, frigates, cruisers, and more dangerous foes. Choose the ships, weapons, and improvement modules, your group will deploy with. Use tactical command decisions to overcome dangerous encounters with unrelenting enemies.

name: Empire of Ember
short_description: Become a battlemage, build a city, and command your troops in this fantasy warfare simulator. Jump into the fray and use your might, magic, and wits to fight enemies in battles of up to a hundred units and fully destructible city siege combat. The fate of an empire is in your hands.

name: Dark Stone: The Lightseeker
short_description: A rogue-like deck-builder where you play as the Recruiter. Set up your team wisely and choose the order in which they will fight carefully. With an expanding army under your control and different paths leading to new encounters, each run will offer a unique experience.

name: StarDrive 2
short_description: StarDrive 2 is an exciting and evolutionary step forward for the StarDrive franchise. In this eagerly anticipated sequel, the core mechanics have evolved to incorporate a turn-based strategic layer, featuring spectacular realtime battles.

name: City 20
short_description: Survive in a living post-apocalyptic city. Build trust or spark conflict with NPCs and factions, uncover mysteries, and watch the world change with your every choice.

name: Atomic Heart
short_description: In a mad and sublime utopian world, take part in explosive encounters. Adapt your fighting style to each opponent, use your environment and upgrade your equipment to fulfill your mission. If you want to reach the truth, you'll have to pay in blood.

name: Movavi Video Suite 2024 Steam Edition
short_description: Create awesome video projects easily in your do-it-all video-making bundle: a video editor, media converter, screen recorder, and more. Elevate your video creation experience with a wide set of tools that’ll make your content stand out.

name: Evochron Mercenary
short_description: The life of an independent mercenary is rarely without excitement. Your spacecraft awaits and your adventure begins in the Sapphire star system.

name: Super Lumberjack
short_description: There was Jack, just a lumberjack....

name: FPS Tactics
short_description: Control a group of special agents, find a monster on the map and place the agents so that they can defeat the monster

name: Angels on Tanks
short_description: Take command of ground and air forces in strategic turn-based battles across more than 100 battlefields. Collect and upgrade unique commanders. Construct your ultimate battle deck to defeat your opponents.

name: Skript
short_description: The popular words board game playable in six different languages: English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Spanish.

name: Albedon Wars
short_description: Albedon Wars combines the depth of a strategic card game with the immersive enjoyment of a multiplayer role-playing game. Form a group of companions, unlock cards and abilities, build your deck and join one of two factions in a war that is ravaging the planet Krenus.

name: Volcanoids
short_description: A base-building open-world survival shooter that replaces your typical base with a giant drill. Alone or with friends, explore an island plagued by eruptions, upgrade your drill, and fight robots to uncover what's been hiding beneath the surface.

name: Redemption of Liuyin
short_description: This is a 3D ancient style fantasy, multi ending action role-playing game. As the third installment of the Ryukyu Hidden series and the Ryukyu Hidden Nine Absolute Reincarnation Chapter, the game is designed with the principle of promoting offense and hesitation to defeat in its combat system.

name: Tetris® Effect: Connected
short_description: Tetris® Effect: Connected adds an all-new robust multiplayer expansion to the huge variety of addictive and innovative single-player modes that Tetris Effect is known for, with all-new co-op and competitive online and local multiplayer modes!

name: Distortion VR
short_description: The world of Distortion exists in a Cyberpunk mega city in the near future. It is a world where technology is being abused and the citizens are being controlled by thought from birth. What's real is uncertain.

name: Beat Slayer
short_description: Beat Slayer is a roguelite hack n’ slay game like no other. Instead of just being in the background the music takes centre stage. Join Mia, a badass music lover and crafty tinkerer, as she battles hordes of robots in a dystopian 90s inspired Berlin. There’s only one rule: Stay on beat!

name: Horse Riding Deluxe
short_description: Explore a beautiful open world, full of horses and other animals. Or just enjoy the beautiful view while riding. In the world of Horse Riding Deluxe you and your horses have no limits. But train and care for your horses well because the various races will demand everything from you!

name: Ghost of a Tale
short_description: Ghost of a Tale is an action-RPG game in which you play as Tilo, a mouse and minstrel thrown into a perilous adventure. Through stealth and cunning you’ll be able to explore the secrets of Dwindling Heights Keep and navigate its dangers.

name: Cthulhu's Catharsis
short_description: You are Cthulhu. Crush other eldritch horrors that dare to rival Your power. 'Gift' Your creatures with mutations, summon forth new lands in Your image, and harvest Your human subjects for power. Outwit other Gods--in these strange aeons, even Death may die.

name: Four Horsemen
short_description: An ambitious life sim about the parts of the immigrant experience everyone pretends to forget.

name: Chronicles of Vaeltaja: In Search of the Great Wanderer
short_description: Experience the classic feel of adventuring in Chronicles of Vaeltaja, a deep grid-based 1st person dungeon crawler role-playing game set in the kingdom of Twin Falls, a lush and colourful fantasy world full of quests, dungeons and secrets.

name: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap
short_description: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap combines chaotic third-person combat with devious trap-laying strategy. Enjoy endless replayability as your War Mage grows stronger through roguelite progression. Repel relentless orc hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

name: Armoured Onslaught
short_description: Armoured Onslaught is a fast paced Top-Down Shooter and Tower Defence hybrid. You will need to make use of both strategy and skill as you fight your way through near endless hordes of deadly foes.

name: Deadwalker Chronicles
short_description: Can you survive the ultimate zombie apocalypse? Build your deck and take on a customizable Encounter Deck made from Mission, Zombie, Danger, and Location cards. Every choice matters as you face relentless threats in a collapsing world. Adapt, strategize, and prove your survival instincts!

name: Trench Tales
short_description: Trench Tales is a third-person action game set in a strange, war-torn world. Inspired by early 20th-century themes, it offers open-ended exploration, scattered combat encounters, and glimpses into a broken land shaped by endless conflict.

name: L.A. Noire: The VR Case Files
short_description: L.A. Noire: The VR Case Files places you directly in the shoes of Detective Cole Phelps as you solve brutal crimes, plots and conspiracies inspired by real cases from 1947 Los Angeles, one of the most corrupt and violent times in L.A. history.

name: SYNTHSPACE
short_description: Synthspace is the ultimate virtual synthesizer. It combines the familiarity of real instruments with the possibilities of virtual worlds. A room full of synths for the price of a nice lunch. *mic drop*

name: REMNANT II®
short_description: REMNANT II® pits survivors of humanity against new deadly creatures and god-like bosses across terrifying worlds. Play solo or co-op with two other friends to explore the depths of the unknown to stop an evil from destroying reality itself.

name: Neon Echo
short_description: Neon Echo is a 3D side-scrolling action Roguelite game with an anime and tech-wear style. In a world that has been corrupted by 'noise', 'electronic music' has become the only means to resist the power of 'Strepification'. Now, let's follow the beat of electronic music to fight!

name: COMBAT INSTINCT
short_description: Fight like hell in this real-man fight and adventure game dedicated to hard-core action gamers. Get prepared for lots of deaths, and see whether you’re the talented fighter the galaxy has been waiting for.

name: Blasteron
short_description: Dash attack and blast swarms of enemy ships in this boss fight centered insane bullet hell frenzy. Combined with a heavy metal sound track and a hardcore difficulty curve, this twin stick arcade space shooter will definitely bring out the Shoot 'em Up beast in you.

name: Church Era
short_description: 'Church Era' is a fast-paced worker-placement strategy game set in a medieval fantasy land Tigris. Place your units to acquire new areas, attack your enemy, and reveal the story behind this world through your victory.

name: Hidden Build Top-Down 3D
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Civitatem
short_description: Civitatem is a medieval city builder where you help your villagers raise a new settlement in dangerous lands by making use of their skills and available world resources.

name: Utawarerumono: Prelude to the Fallen
short_description: The first game in the Utawarerumono trilogy of story-rich tactics RPGs. Into a world filled with verdant nature, populated by folk with fluffy ears and fuzzy tails, awakens Hakuowlo, a man of masked mien and missing memory.

name: Endzone 2
short_description: Endzone 2 is a post-apocalyptic survival colony builder, where you embark to secure humanity's survival after a cataclysmic disaster. Discover and repopulate the last habitable grounds, while the survival of your people hinges on your wits, foresight, and resilience in a harsh and unforgiving world.

name: Universal Character Generator
short_description: Assemble, recolor, reposition, and export image files, fast! This program allows for any image sizes, and an unlimited number of layers to customize your images.

name: Mind the Vikings
short_description: Start with nothing and build up your viking settlement in harsh Nordic climate in this survival strategy town building game. Start with nothing and prepare for winter. Set forth on raids on other viking settlements and defend yourself from them.

name: Alcyone: The Last City
short_description: Alcyone: The Last City is an interactive sci-fi novel where your choices can lead to the salvation or destruction of the last refuge of civilisation in the universe. Immerse yourself in a branching narrative of diverse characters, intrigue, and world-altering decisions.

name: DIRT 5
short_description: DIRT 5 is a fun, amplified, off-road arcade racing experience created by Codemasters. Blaze a trail on routes across the world, covering gravel, ice, snow and sand, with a roster of cars ranging from rally icons to trucks, to GT heroes.

name: RECONNECT - The Heart of Darkness
short_description: Prove yourself against a real machine learning AI that learns as you play! Build your base grid-free and defend it against a swarm of AI-controlled drones that get smarter with each attack. Reconnect the enemy base to get your own drones, train and command them in the final battle AI vs AI.

name: No Plan B
short_description: Carefully plan your team's tactics in close quarters battles. Use the timeline to synchronize each door breach, grenade throw and room entry with precision. Watch your team execute your plan autonomously in epic cinematic replays. Take on challenging roguelike campaigns or standalone missions.

name: Sonic Origins
short_description: Experience the collected adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog in Sonic Origins Plus! With 16 legendary Sonic titles, including 12 Game Gear games, new playable characters, modes, challenges, behind-the-scenes content, and more, this is the definitive way to play these classic games!

name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
short_description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes is designed to bring players a modern take on a classic JRPG experience. Get ready to lead 100+ playable characters through a war-torn world only you can save.

name: TeamTower
short_description: As a prophet of the Secret Church, you will lead a team of characters with unique characteristics. Gain loot through events and battles, use them to enhance the team, and finally complete the great sacrifice.

name: ShadowStorm
short_description: Discover a chaotic future where the intensity of battles reaches unparalleled heights. Get ready for action and join the battlefield (up to 16 players in multiplayer) or take on bots in solo mode. ShadowStorm: strategy and boldness will lead you to victory!

name: Healing Animal
short_description: Healing Animals is a game where you help out adorable animals on a relaxing journey, and escape from the dark reality with a blind girl called Anna. Find the puzzle pieces to solve problems in animal town to help Anna heal her emotional wounds.

name: Miolhr
short_description: {Save the World} of Miolhria from the 6 overpowered DoJo Sensei's and all other challenges as you make your way through each Biome. Battle tons of Zombies, Bandits and Mio-la-mon along the way! Thankfully, you are not alone in your plight. There are others in the same situation. Will you survive?

name: Fraymakers
short_description: Fraymakers is the ultimate customizable platform fighting game, featuring a cast of some of indie gaming's biggest icons. Duke it out with up to 4 players and call on assists to help out in the heat of battle. Create and play custom characters, stages, modes, and more for infinite fun!

name: Kharon's Crypt - Even Death May Die
short_description: Metroidvania dungeon crawler about Death & Grief full of puzzles, secrets & challenges. Inspired by old GameBoy Color games with Retro Pixel Art Aesthetics but with challenging boss fights & Lore-Rich

name: Ambient DM
short_description: A DM tool to make sound boards that enhance your tabletop gaming sessions. Ambient DM contains 99 Full Songs, over 1100 sound effects, and more than 700 voice elements. Bring your D&D and Pathfinder game sessions to life!

name: Abalon: Roguelike Tactics CCG
short_description: Abalon is a roguelike adventure that fuses tactical turn-based combat and card strategy. Choose your summoner and explore a tabletop world to discover its secrets. Build the perfect deck, outsmart your enemies and become legend!

name: Peglin
short_description: Peglin is a Pachinko Roguelike - Fight enemies by collecting special orbs and popping pegs to deal damage. Acquire special relics that radically change the game and ensure no two runs are the same. Aim carefully to survive in this unique turn-based RPG!

name: Multiverse Loot Hunter
short_description: This is a brush treasure adventure game across the heavens. The protagonist awakens his powers and freely passes through different planes such as Xiuxian, history, Wuxia, magic, and future. Collect equipment, spirits, characters and cheats distributed across all planes through battle.

name: VR Pianist
short_description: VR Pianist is a VR music game where you can play on virtual piano. Enjoy unique 'line-art' graphic style together with contemporary, classical and orchestral music. Maybe you are the hidden talent waiting to be discovered!

name: Utawarerumono: Mask of Deception
short_description: You awaken in a field of snow with no memory of even your name. The local monstrosities nearly devour you before you meet your rescuer, a beautiful girl named Kuon—who has animal ears and a tail. She names you Haku⸺ The Japanese hit tactics-RPG visual novel series returns to PC at last!

name: Blood Engine
short_description: Blood Engine: Immerse yourself in an action-packed third-person open-world experience. Race against time to thwart the relentless Red Swarm. Will you emerge victorious, or succumb to the biomechanical onslaught? The fate of humanity rests in your hands.

name: HARVESTELLA
short_description: HARVESTELLA, an all-new life-simulation RPG from SQUARE ENIX! Lead a life of self-sufficiency with your vibrant house as a base and cooperate with allies to overcome various threats.

name: fullybroKEN - A Unique Mix of 4X / Post-Apocalypse / RPG / Roguelike
short_description: Play as single character in a 4x game. Survive. Thrive. Die. Unite the country of Mir. Kill, make hard choice, become anything you want in this unique post-apocalyptic game. Die. With ideas from 4X, Match-3 RPGs, Traditional RPGs and roguelikes, fullybroKEN offers an experience unlike anything else.

name: QUESTSCAPE: Survival
short_description: On a secluded medieval, awake in a small village surrounded by wildlife nature and bandits and many challanges. Evolve your land in search of new adventures.

name: Quench
short_description: Quench is a story-driven puzzle game set in a colourful, lo-fi world. Become shepherd, an avatar of nature, and guide herds of animals on their difficult journey. Help Shaman, the young Elephant leader, convince the other animal tribes to join her.

name: Anime Play Life: Unlimited
short_description: Anime Play Life: Unlimited is an adventure and second life simulation game, where you are able to do quests with your character created in the 'Character Creation' in any location, find a job and work there, buy, place and customize your own houses, fish on any lake or sea and much more...

name: MXGP 24: The Official Game
short_description: After a 3-year break, the official game of the MXGP is back. Experience the full 2024 MXGP championship with its 20 official tracks and over 50 MX1/MX2 riders. Immerse yourself in the MXGP with a full and deep career mode.

name: Cardinal Cross
short_description: When small-time Raider Scavenger Lana Brice meets her mysterious client, her life takes a wrong turn in the worst way possible. Cardinal Cross cannot be stopped… But will Lana emerge as hero or villain?

name: Pro Cycling Manager 2022
short_description: Recruitment, budget, strategy: you make all the decisions. Explore the new system for detecting young potential, new options for customising your experience, a peloton that is more aggressive and much more.

name: RealFlight Trainer Edition
short_description: RealFlight Trainer Edition is the perfect way to learn radio control flying on your PC. With 8 aircraft from Horizon Hobby (more are unlockable) and flying lessons from experienced RC pilots, you'll be ready to solo in no time. When you're ready, an upgrade to RealFlight Evolution is also available.

name: Influence, Inc.
short_description: Manage a digital influence agency in this strategy-simulation game about modern-day propaganda and advertising. Manipulate social media and the mainstream news to promote celebrities, market products, and even sway elections. Research, share, leak, and target your way to influence.

name: Soul Reaper
short_description: Reap souls by besting your foes in turn-based combat, then summon them to fight by your side! Arrange souls on a 3x3 grid for battle, or attach them to loot pieces to amplify their effects! Travel through The Vault in search for rare treasure, and slay the impostors claiming to be the Soul Reaper!

name: Dungeon Munchies
short_description: Hunt down monsters to cook and eat them! You’ve been revived in a massive underground complex and you must leave this bizarre facility. Aided by the undead Necro-Chef Simmer, you must stay safe, get fed, find a way to get out

name: hackmud
short_description: hackmud is a retro cyberpunk RPG where you play a digital persona in a chaotic, unpredictable, and often goofy abandoned internet. Enter a 90s hacker movie filled with scripts, scams, and sabotage. Explore the world of digital secrets and forge your legacy through cunning, creativity, or disruption.

name: Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero
short_description: Join Marona and her Phantom friends on a mission to defeat the sinister Shipwreck Fleet! Recruit Phantoms, bind them to objects, combine them with Gadgets, and even merge them with Marona herself in this Play-It-Your-Way RPG.

name: DICEOMANCER
short_description: DICEOMANCER is a roguelike deck-building game. Though you long for a peaceful life, you're forced to embark on an adventure. In this world of swords, magic, and guns, make good use of your dice and deck to find a way back to tranquility! What can the dice be used for? To change... anything.
developers: 超厚皮猪猪 Ultra Piggy Studio

name: legend of love
short_description: This is a road racing game that allows you to engage in passionate racing on the road.

name: Wand Wars VR
short_description: Wand Wars VR is an innovative roguelike magic action adventure VR game with easy style by Unreal Engine 4, single mode has 8-10 hours play time to experience the whole world.

name: Medieval Blacksmith
short_description: Medieval Blacksmith is a blacksmithing simulation set in a magical medieval world. Play as a blacksmith with no past, craft legendary weapons from daggers to spears, and forge your path to becoming the world’s greatest. Dive into a story filled with adventure and endless creative possibilities!

name: A Wake Inn
short_description: Put your VR goggles on to explore dark corridors of an abandoned hotel using realistically controlled wheelchair, and face strange army of living dolls. But you won't be alone - mysterious voice will accompany you via shortwave transmitter. Just make sure, who really pulls the strings in this world.

name: Approaching Infinity
short_description: Approaching Infinity is a turn-based space RPG in the spirit of the sci-fi classics, with endless progression and exploration. Fight tactical battles or use diplomacy. Seek powerful artifacts. Quest, mine, trade, and craft. Level up forever or attempt 10 victories in hardcore or adventure mode.

name: ZombieFight VR
short_description: This is a real experience, the screen realistic, operating fever-level exciting, slightly terrorist elements VR shooting game.

name: Painting VR
short_description: Take a break from the stress of daily life with this must-have virtual painter’s studio. Even if you think you’re not a creative person, Painting VR might prove you wrong. Be amazed by what you can create with unlimited supplies of paint, canvases, and all the tools you need.

name: Orebound
short_description: Orebound is a voxel, factory, automation game set in a first person open-world. The King has tasked you to locate the elusive Emberstone. Go forth and use your Dwarven prowess and knowledge to mine, craft and automate through anything standing in your way - Build up or dig down! How far will you go?

name: Select Oblige
short_description: Select Oblige is the latest title from the popular Japanese visual novel brand Madosoft. It features character design and artwork by renowned illustrator Hiyo Yuzuna, with the story crafted by Shoukei Wakaba. The main heroines are voiced by Hana Akino, Kanau, Ren Sagami, and Yuuka Nanakusa.

name: Geo-Political Simulator 5
short_description: The new 5th edition of the hyperrealistic global simulator game where you play as the Head of State or as the opposition or the president of a large multinational company, with a completely redesigned interface, a new ultra-detailed map, complete control of companies and new scenarios for 2024.

name: Operation: Harsh Doorstop "Closed Beta"
short_description: This version of Operation: Harsh Doorstop is updated nightly with all 'work-in-progress' features that are currently being developed for the game. Our development team uses this to organize exclusive playtests for our paid supporters. You can gain access to these events by purchasing the game here.

name: Pro Basketball Manager 2024
short_description: Welcome to Pro Basketball Manager 2024 - the best basketball management experience, offering unparalleled depth and authenticity across 175 elite basketball competitions. Show the world you're the ultimate basketball manager!

name: Bear Simulator
short_description: It's a game where you play as a bear and explore stuff.

name: Talent Not Included
short_description: Set in the fantasy land of Notthatmuchfurther, Talent Not Included tells the story of three actors, ready for anything, in order to give the performance of their life even if that means facing mechanical soldiers, animals, hardheaded monsters as well as rotating cylinders at their feet. Break a leg, you'll need it !

name: Rainbow Yggdrasil
short_description: In a white world tree, the rainbow world tree stands... Color-changing game series from Otora Kobo! This time we present color change x roguelike!

name: Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX
short_description: A legend returns in stunning new detail with Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX! Fire up your power bracelet and relive a platforming classic alongside new modes, levels and features!

name: Katana Kata
short_description: Indie souls-like with innovative fight system where you practice your Katana on the path for endless improvement; again and again.

name: Soviet City
short_description: Soviet City is a game made up of quick game plays, where building and control is essential. We take a lot from classic city builders. The player takes the role of mayor of the city. Soviet law and economy have their own laws. Every building influences a terror bar. Be careful, because excessive terror level leads to a rebellion.

name: SWORDY
short_description: Swordy is a local party brawler with chaotic physics-based action. Master the weapons of war, using momentum and timing to fight for your life in a world built on the bones of a ruined empire.

name: Overworld - Map Keeper's Realm
short_description: Overworld - Map Keeper's Realm is hex-based world building software that utilizes procedural generation to create highly detailed maps. Alternatively, import your own map and begin sculpting your world and writing your lore. Become a Master Keeper!

name: Sunderfolk
short_description: Rediscover game night in this tactical RPG where clever teamwork and shared strategy shape every turn and build lasting memories. One copy is all you need. Friends join using their phones, which become their character sheet, guidebook, and controller. Play the first 4 missions for free.

name: Super Powered Battle Friends
short_description: SUPER POWERED BATTLE FRIENDS is a platform fighter for up to 4 players!

name: 1001 Jigsaw: Earth Chronicles 7
short_description: 1001 photos of our fantastic planet! Discover the breathtaking beauty of our world alongside 1001 Jigsaw: Earth Chronicles 7!

name: Monstrous
short_description: Monstrous is a melee combat oriented action adventure game featuring Gothic horror characters entangled in fragile alliances and settling rivalries; played in a free roaming city amidst industrial revolution.

name: Pioneers of Pagonia
short_description: Rebuild hope in a world that was lost in the fog. Lead your Pioneers across the isles of Pagonia, unite scattered tribes, raise thriving communities and discover the history of your people as you reclaim your world in the new story campaign.

name: DEEMO -Reborn-
short_description: DEEMO -Reborn- is Rayark's classic game DEEMO, reborn in a whole new way on Steam. The fully 3D immersive journey will intoxicate you with the elegant sounds produced by you on the piano, as well as with the adventures you discover in this fairytale world.

name: BattleGroupVR
short_description: BattleGroupVR is a first person real-time space strategy where you lead a fleet of powerful warships into battle from the bridge of your own flagship. Assemble your fleet, upgrade your load-outs, train your captains, engage the enemy and secure the sector. Try not to go down with the ship.

name: Pizza Titan Ultra
short_description: Pizza! Giant robots! Lasers, destruction, evil cyborgs! Arcade action in a fully customizable mech with a pizzeria in its chest.

name: The Persistence
short_description: Survive aboard a doomed deep space colony starship, overrun with horrific and murderous aberrations. Explore, evade and fight your way through the depths to bring the ship back to Earth. Gather resources, upgrade abilities and fabricate an arsenal of weapons in this sci-fi horror roguelite.

name: Lamplight Station
short_description: Lost on massive space station, you’ll need to act fast to overcome radiation, cold, heat and the station's less-friendly inhabitants in order to survive.

name: Argonauts Agency: Chair of Hephaestus
short_description: Argonauts Agency—See how a regular chair can be the beginning of a whole investigation and amazing adventure!

name: Citadelum
short_description: Citadelum is a city builder set in legendary Ancient Rome. Build your own settlement, gather resources and evolve it into a magnificent city. Explore the world, trade and lead your mighty legions in epic tactical battles. Earn the favor of the Gods or challenge them, if you dare.

name: Selaco
short_description: Selaco is a brand new original shooter inspired by classics, featuring thrilling action set pieces, destructibility, smart enemies and a fleshed out story taking place within an immersive game world.

name: After Shadows
short_description: After Shadows is a metroidvania with roguelike elements. Get into a distant post-apocalyptic future, where all of humanity became extinct. Explore the abandoned Fortress, look for traps and hide from Dark Monster who is chasing you.

name: God of War Ragnarök
short_description: Kratos and Atreus embark on a mythic journey for answers before Ragnarök arrives – now on PC.

name: Best Served Cold
short_description: Can you mix a cocktail while eye-to-eye with a criminal? Find out in Best Served Cold, a murder mystery set in a bustling speakeasy where you serve customers, make friends and enemies, and solve crimes. At the Nightcap bar, prohibition is a killer… and so are some of your customers!

name: Ys IX: Monstrum Nox
short_description: While imprisoned in Balduq, Adol is cursed and becomes a Monstrum. With his newfound powers, he must stop the Grimwald Nox from consuming the city.

name: Incantation
short_description: A mother, searching for her lost daughter, stumbles into a strange cult village. 'Incantation' is a first-person horror game. It reveals the chilling story behind the 'Chen Family Village'. What are the consequences of crossing dark boundaries?

name: Keylocker | Turn Based Cyberpunk Action
short_description: In a silent world where music is outlawed, play as a singer to shatter the strings of fate and sing the melody of freedom in this unforgiving Turn Based Rhythm JRPG.

name: Club Dance Party VR
short_description: - Exciting dance time for those who are tired of work! Experience the real rhythm through realistic rhythmical VR! New conceptual club dance party within your home! - Club Dance Party VR –

name: World of Goo 2
short_description: Build bridges, grow towers, terraform terrain, and fuel flying machines in the stunning followup to the multi-award winning World of Goo. The world is beautiful, dangerous, and evolving.

name: BAKERU
short_description: Bakeru's adventure begins in this Japan-esque Wild Action Game!

name: Perfect Jump
short_description: This is a relaxing casual game, you need to operate the character to keep jumping to get points

name: Disgaea 6 Complete
short_description: Join Zed on his quest to destroy the God of Destruction in the newest installment of the SRPG series, Disgaea! Join the zany cast for one HL of an adventure and use specialized abilities like Super Reincarnation to battle your way to victory! Disgaea 6 Complete includes all previously released DLC!

name: Neighborhood
short_description: Design a charming neighborhood, care for the unique residents it attracts, and observe a world of emergent stories come to life in this cozy, creative building game.

name: NeoSprint
short_description: The exhilarating Atari racing classic “Sprint” series returns! NeoSprint zooms back to life as a single screen arcade racer for up to 8 players, paired with a robust track builder and intuitive sharing tools, ensuring a racing experience that satisfies speed demons and architects alike.

name: City Sniper
short_description: This is a first person shooting game. The player plays a soldier,Players are surrounded by enemies, and they are free to explore the surrounding areas,Players can dodge the enemy's attack, or kill the enemy to survive as much as possible.

name: Legend of the Tetrarchs
short_description: Free the light of courage to rip through the darkness! A fantasy RPG with turn-based battles and dungeons in beautiful pixel art!

name: Panda Choice Mahjong
short_description: The panda has made her choice! Follow her into the wonderful world of the most ancient game.

name: Harvest Moon: The Winds of Anthos
short_description: Explore the wide world of Anthos with the help of your wacky inventor friend Doc Jr. and many others! It’ll be up to you to revive the Harvest Goddess and the Harvest Sprites, as well as reconnect all of the villages of Anthos with each other! Farm all around Anthos using the improved Expando-Farm!

name: Diablo® IV
short_description: Join the fight for Sanctuary in Diablo® IV, the ultimate action RPG adventure. Experience the critically acclaimed campaign and new seasonal content.

name: Tiger Trio's Tasty Travels
short_description: Not again?! Tons of wrong orders.

name: Block Buster
short_description: Destroy cities with your bare hands! Toss tanks! Grab – and eat – people! This is Block Buster, the game where YOU are the Kaiju. It’s all about raw destruction – and a healthy helping of cosplay in this arcade action scavenger hunt. Pick from five monsters to destroy cities across the globe.

name: Project Temporality
short_description: Experience the mind bending power of single player cooperation. Project Temporality is a third person action/puzzle game built around the concept of allowing the player to play with time. Thanks to our propriety engine Sparta 3D we make the fourth dimension as available as the other three.

name: Autobahn Police Simulator 3
short_description: Autobahn Police Simulator 3 lets you play as a rookie officer who just resumed their position after a serious car accident left them incapacitated for a while. Work diligently and take on missions to become a capable police officer and keep the autobahn safe.

name: Neon Tail
short_description: Neon Tail is an open world roller skating game where you follow a young girl’s adventures and save the streets of Bluepulse City from dimensional disaster.Get a jobs, go shopping, get Super Powers, fight a dimensional invasion, become a skating superstar, and drink bubble teas.

name: The Message
short_description: First person shooter in setting of 80th years. You need to kill everyone in the house. Use guns on levels, be fast and kill without doubt.

name: Sea of Craft
short_description: Hello! Captain! “Sea Of Craft” is a sandbox ocean-building game with realistic physics simulation. In “Sea of Craft”, you can build your exclusive ship with hundreds of materials, and explore intriguing stages on planet Beella as well as adventures of wonders in the great ocean!

name: LUNA The Shadow Dust
short_description: LUNA The Shadow Dust is a fully hand-animated Point&Click puzzle adventure, brought to life through wordless storytelling, beautiful cinematics and a breathtaking original soundtrack.

name: Lethal League Blaze
short_description: Banging beats and mad style, Lethal League Blaze is the most intense ball game you can play online with up to 4 players.

name: VR RHYTHM ACTION SEIYA
short_description: VR RHYTHM ACTION SEIYA is not your average rhythm game where you just keep beat with the song -- it's a virtual reality music game where you can actually play the melody.Punch the melody into existence by hitting the lyrics and stars flying at you to the beat of the music on your own personal grand stage!

name: RetroGunX VR
short_description: Miss playing those 8-bit, button-bashing, classic arcade-style cabinet and cartridge games from the 70s and 80s? Ever wanted to experience the intense action from the point of view of the hero within the game? Now you can, in VIRTUAL REALITY.

name: Buzludzha VR
short_description: Embark on an immersive Virtual Reality adventure and discover one of Europe’s most iconic, abandoned structures. Fly the helicopter, play the grand piano, climb the 70m high tower, mess around with a wine gun, all while you uncover the secrets of this UFO-shaped communist legend.

name: Nearly Dead
short_description: Nearly Dead is a 2D open world survival game. It's a game about survivors who try to remain alive in a situation where demons from a different dimension have turned most humans into zombies.

name: Handball Manager 2021
short_description: Finally state of the art handball management. Prove yourself as a manager and trainer in the daily business of professional handball.

name: Heretical
short_description: Die. Adapt. Strike back. Climb Sanctora in this brutal Rogue-lite where every death unlocks powers, heroes, and paths to vengeance.

name: The Magical Mixture Mill
short_description: Gather exotic ingredients, brew complex mixtures, and expand your magically automated production lines -- keeping your shelves stocked, your customers happy, and your pockets full.

name: The Use of Life
short_description: The Use of Life is a multi-ending adventure book style JRPG. The main character’s various attachments change in accordance with the choices the player makes, and the ending changes depending on “the use of life” you choose through your journey.
developers: だらねこげーむず/Daraneko Games

name: God of War
short_description: His vengeance against the Gods of Olympus years behind him, Kratos now lives as a man in the realm of Norse Gods and monsters. It is in this harsh, unforgiving world that he must fight to survive… and teach his son to do the same.

name: Magic Nations - Card Game
short_description: Jump into a fantasy world of the Magic Nations - turn-based strategy card battle game. Grab your card deck and fight against opponents from all over the world. The gameplay is based on tactics and adapting your game to battlefield conditions. Collect, sell, expand.

name: Save Scream and Run
short_description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

name: Raw Metal
short_description: Infiltrate the depths of an exoplanet mining facility to scavenge for gear and challenge a corrupt megacorporation. Utilize gadgets and equipment in high-stakes stealth, and hone your fighting skills in breakneck combat in this stylish stealth-action dungeon crawler.

name: VAR: Exterminate
short_description: The fight is here, humanity’s fate is in your hands! Match up different offensive and defensive upgrades between waves and fend off the onslaught of zombies. Level up and strengthen core abilities and progress to new areas where strains of the virus have evolved.

name: Sailwind
short_description: Sailing simulator featuring realistic sailing physics and a vast open world to explore. Embark on cargo delivery missions, customize your boat, try fishing and cooking. A relaxing day sail, or an epic ocean voyage? Your sailing adventure starts here!

name: Typing Simulator
short_description: Typing Simulator is not a game, it's the future. Learn to type. Get fast. High scores, leader-boards and speed running, all in VR.

name: Rugby League Team Manager 4
short_description: The fourth instalment of “The Number 1 Rugby League Management Game”. The biggest leagues and competitions. Take full control of managing your own Rugby League club. Training schedules, coaches, physios, scouting, finances, sponsors and more. MUCH MORE!

name: Hidden Lands
short_description: Find the land elements and animals that are hidden on the map.

name: Front Office Football Nine
short_description: Put yourself in the Front Office with Front Office Football, the professional football simulation from Solecismic Software. Manage your roster through trading, free agency and the amateur draft. Create game plans, organize depth charts and watch your franchise thrive for decades.

name: VenusBlood HOLLOW International
short_description: War hangs like the sword of Damocles over Helvetia, a land ruled by four Dark Lords. In this age of blood and strife, Leonhardt Arknoah, a war hero and leader of the Varganian Empire's secret task force, steps onto the battlefield once more, the flames of ambition burning brightly within him.

name: Dr. Cares - Family Practice
short_description: Which is most important - the family you're born with, or the family you choose?

name: DressMaker Pro
short_description: Dressmaker Pro is now available! It's now available with more features than ever!

name: [TDA01] Muv-Luv Unlimited: THE DAY AFTER - Episode 01 REMASTERED
short_description: The epic saga of Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After continues! In the aftermath of Operation Babylon, only a few inhabitable places remain on Earth. Follow the Japanese survivors in Seattle as they struggle to rebuild their lives — and defend themselves from the BETA.

name: Finding Frankie
short_description: Finding Frankie invites YOU to a true experience of terror as you compete in a terrifyingly twisted parkour show. Stealthily navigate around horrifying characters and swing through challenging parkour courses. This is one game show you won’t want to miss!

name: Movavi Video Editor Plus 2022 - Video Editing Software
short_description: Montage in Movavi Video Editor Plus is easy, fast, and fun. Creating thematic clips, experimenting with sound, and adding special effects are all in reach, even if you have no video editing experience. You can be uploading files directly on YouTube in 20 minutes, so embrace your creative self!

name: New Arc Line
short_description: Take a stand in the eternal conflict between Arcane Magic and Steampunk Revolution and tip the uneasy balance between sorcery, elves, dwarves and mysterious monsters on one side and steampunk gadgets, zeppelins, and tesla guns on the other in this single-player, party-based, story-rich RPG.

name: Deadlink
short_description: Get ready to put a sizable dent in the profits of megacorporations in Deadlink, a guns-blazing cyberpunk FPS with roguelite elements. Your mission is to conduct covert ops while piloting a humanoid combat shell. And no, 'covert' doesn’t mean 'quiet.'

name: Onward
short_description: Onward is the most immersive tactical VR shooter. Join your squad for a wide variety of competitive PvP, co-op PvE, and solo game modes, including intense multiplayer battles or 4-player co-op missions. Realistic weaponry and combat mechanics will push your survival and combat skills to their limit

name: Genso Manège
short_description: Follow Emma as she fights to reawaken her magical powers in order to aid a unique cast of characters, all of whom are trapped inside a travelling amusement park. Having lost memories from youth, Emma must rediscover her past through love and friendship in this stunning dream-like fantasy otome.

name: UnEpic
short_description: Daniel was just an average guy. He was a great videogame player, a big fan of sci-fi movies, and a novice RPG player. In the midst of an RPG, he was teleported to a castle. At first, Daniel believed that he was having a massive hallucination.

name: Far Lands
short_description: Far Lands is an open-world survival game. Fight mercenaries, steal their loot and vehicles. Build and defend your base from zombies. Gather resources, craft better gear and loot different points of interest. Want to play with friends? Join them on Co-op!

name: XR22-SEAGUARD
short_description: XR22-SEAGUARD is a PC and VR game that reimagines the classic grid-based game of Battleship. This immersive PC and VR game puts you in the heart of a dynamic 3D industrial environment, where you'll strategically place and sink ships using state-of-the-art weapons and defenses.

name: Dyson Sphere Program
short_description: Build the most efficient intergalactic factory in space simulation strategy game Dyson Sphere Program! Harness the power of stars, collect resources, plan and design production lines and develop your interstellar factory from a small space workshop to a galaxy-wide industrial empire.

name: Crystal Guardians TD
short_description: Crystal Guardians is a tower defense game with rogue-like elements. Fight of waves and defend the world crystal. Gear up your towers with a powerful combination of items for your strategy. In an ever expanding map, find hidden powers and conquer the enemies.

name: TERMINAL VR
short_description: Experience Earth's final descent into Armageddon in Virtual Reality as extreme weather violently spreads destruction, death, and a twisted virus across most of the planet.

name: MaJiang
short_description: Sichuan Mahjong, also known as Chengdu Mahjong, or Bloody Mahjong, is popular in Sichuan, Chongqing, and Guizhou, and is a form of entertainment. The core is to hit the door, wind and rain, count, fight to the end, check the bargaining, check the pig.

name: Abdicate
short_description: This game captivates players with its distinctive pixel art style, crafting a fantastical realm where yellow earth meets a blue sky.

name: Small Saga
short_description: Beneath the streets of London, an angry mouse seeks revenge against the god who stole his tail. An epic RPG of miniature proportions!

name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure
short_description: Embark on a cozy, open-world adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends. Befriend beloved characters as you explore and restore a mysterious island, solve ancient puzzles, cook delicious dishes, customize yourself and your cabins, and so much more.

name: Modbox
short_description: Modbox is a multiplayer game creation sandbox for Desktop+VR

name: The Eternal Castle [REMASTERED]
short_description: The Eternal Castle [REMASTERED] is a remake of the original 'ETERNAL CASTLE' from 1987, with additional game mechanics, sophisticated sound design, polished 2-bit CGA animated graphics, and modernized game design.

name: This Land Is My Land
short_description: Experience the frontier as a chief of a Native American tribe and resist the onset of the settlers. Explore the vast world full of hostile humans and animals while defining your narrative through the decisions you make.

name: Rise and Fall: Bronze Age
short_description: Rise & Fall: Bronze Age is a Grand Strategy game set in the Bronze Age between 3400BC and 1150BC. Expand your power by diplomacy and war and manage your troublesome elites.
